title: Real-time SQL Plan Management in Oracle
summary: Consistent query performance is essential for mission critical database applications, yet SQL execution plans can change due to factors such as database upgrades, DML changes, new indexes, etc. While plan stability mechanisms such as stored outlines prevent regressions by freezing execution plans, they also inhibit performance improvements by disallowing plan evolution. We introduced SQL Plan Management (SPM) in Oracle 11g to address this trade-off by maintaining a set of accepted execution plans and allowing plan evolution only when new plans demonstrably outperform existing baselines. However, prior implementations of SPM primarily rely on background performance verification processes, delaying regression detection and recovery. This issue is amplified in autonomous cloud database systems, where several automatic actions that could cause plan change driven regressions are performed with limited customer control. Timely detection and remediation is paramount, but the constrained background resources on cloud may not keep pace. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Real-Time SPM in Oracle 26ai, a novel extension of SPM that performs foreground verification of new execution plans during user query execution. Real-Time SPM leverages runtime session context to immediately validate plan changes, enabling rapid adoption of superior plans while promptly detecting and preventing regressions. This paper presents the architecture and design of Real-Time SPM - including technical challenges like reliably comparing performance of previous plans - and contrasts it with traditional background plan evolution.

AI.tldr: Oracle 26ai引入实时SQL计划管理（Real-Time SPM），将计划验证从后台迁移到用户查询执行的前台，通过运行时会话上下文即时验证新执行计划，加速回归检测并快速采纳更优计划。
AI.motivation: 传统基于后台验证的SPM在云数据库环境中存在显著缺陷：1）后台任务资源受限，回归检测与恢复延迟；2）无法可靠复现用户执行环境（如VPD谓词、环境设置差异）；3）无法验证长时间运行的语句；5）云环境中频繁的自动操作（补丁、自动索引、自动统计信息收集）会引入回归。这些问题在自主云数据库中尤为突出。
AI.method: Real-Time SPM采用前台性能验证架构，包含四个子模块——测试计划检测、参考计划检测、测试计划性能验证、反向验证。核心创新包括：1）使用两个位向量高效识别候选测试计划，避免对Auto STS的频繁查询；2）成本健全性检查（cost-sanity checks）确保历史参考计划在当前环境下仍然有效；3）当测试计划性能优于参考计划均值则接受，反之则接受参考计划并标记测试计划进行反向验证；4）反向验证机制在后续执行中重新评估先前被拒绝的计划，应对成本健全性失败或绑定值敏感场景。计划状态包括ACCEPTED/VERIFIED等四种，通过游标失效强制下次执行重新选择计划。
AI.result: 在20,015个生产测试数据库上观察了959,911次验证事件（涵盖463,395个唯一SQL语句），其中190,588次潜在回归被阻止，仅1,380次通过反向验证改变了原始决策。与Auto SPM对比实验中：Auto SPM后台任务需8小时接受63个计划基线，而Real-Time SPM在约4小时20分钟内接受217个计划基线。CPU时间从462分钟降至443分钟，缓冲区获取也相应减少。引入自动索引场景下，整体工作负载缓冲区获取减少约11%、CPU时间减少约3%。OLTP工作负载（39,000个查询）从高OFE降级到低OFE时，Real-Time SPM能将性能恢复到基线水平。编译开销可忽略（编译缓冲区获取增加约2KB，相对超过1200MB的工作负载执行缓冲区获取）。
AI.conclusion: Real-Time SPM在Oracle 26ai中成功部署，通过前台验证机制即时检测并解决计划回归，相比传统后台验证在云原生和本地环境中均提供更快、更可靠的性能保障。该机制在采用新访问路径的同时防止性能回归，保护了计划的稳定性。Real-Time SPM与参数化查询优化（PQO）、自适应查询执行（AQE）、ROME等多计划并行执行、Plan Stitch算子级重组等技术形成互补关系，为企业级RDBMS平台的自适应、用户响应式SQL计划管理奠定了基础。

title: ANCHOR: A Vision for Secure Persistent Key-Value Stores in Disaggregated Data Centers
summary: Persistent key-value stores (PKVS) are increasingly deployed in disaggregated settings that split compute, memory, and storage across separate server pools. This shift redraws the trust boundary: data that would remain within a single machine is now transported, cached, and rewritten across multiple hosts, expanding exposure to both network attackers and intra-infrastructure adversaries. This paper presents ANCHOR, a vision for end-to-end integrity and freshness in disaggregated PKVS. ANCHOR proposes a two-part semantics-aware architecture: 1) Persistence path: ANCHOR outlines encrypting and authenticating PKVS persistent files and preventing rollback with manifest versioning. 2) Volatile path: ANCHOR treats caches, indexes, and filters as untrusted hints unless accompanied by verifiable provenance, enforced by a TEE-resident policy. Finally, we outline key invariants and discuss enclave-friendly batching and asynchronous I/O to amortize verification without undermining disaggregation's performance and elasticity benefits.

AI.tldr: ANCHOR提出了一种面向解耦数据中心中持久键值存储(PKVS)的端到端安全愿景，通过语义感知的双路径架构（持久化路径与易失路径）保护数据机密性、完整性和新鲜性，并以TEE（可信执行环境）中介为核心强制执行版本绑定验证。
AI.motivation: 解耦架构将计算、内存和存储拆分到不同服务器池，扩大了攻击面（网络攻击者、不可信后端、受损计算侧软件），传统安全机制（TLS+静态加密+TEE）与解耦的性能/弹性优势冲突；现有安全LSM-KVS设计（如TWEEZER、PLDB）假定单一可信引擎，不适用于解耦场景。
AI.method: 以LSM-KVS为载体提出两阶段协同设计：(1)版本绑定持久化——将manifest/version descriptor作为状态根，WAL采用流式认证（记录级），SSTable采用块粒度认证并绑定版本描述符，manifest采用仅追加演化规则防止回滚；(2)受约束的内存执行——将缓存/索引/过滤器视为不可信hint，需携带TEE中介认证的来源标签才可准入，并采用异步I/O（io_uring）与批处理分离不可信提交与可信验证，最小化飞地切换开销。
AI.result: 作为愿景论文，未给出完整系统实现结果，仅提供初步微基准证据：(a)不同分组大小下AES-CBC/GCM/CTR与ChaCha20的吞吐量差异，支持按语义选择加密粒度；(b)io_uring异步提交在提高IOPS和控制尾延迟方面优于同步提交，支撑批验证设计。作者指出已在SHIELD（Thakkar等，2025）中迈出第一步。
AI.conclusion: ANCHOR将版本演化时间线作为完整性的根，将派生内存状态视为需验证的不可信hint，使小型TEE中介能在保持解耦性能优势的同时执行"使用前验证"。未来工作包括量化工件感知保护的代价、压缩准入控制的来源元数据、支持飞地友好的验证与压缩卸载。

title: DBRepro: Automated Database Synthesis via a Hybrid Constraint-Solving Approach for Reproducing Slow Queries
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, and 3 tables. Accepted for publication in the Industry Showcase Track of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary: Slow queries frequently cause severe performance bottlenecks in database management systems. Diagnosing their root causes online risks exacerbating resource contention, while data privacy regulations often prohibit copying production data to test environments. Synthesizing a proxy database from non-intrusive metadata that induces the query optimizer to generate the same physical execution plans is therefore critical for offline diagnosis. High-fidelity reproduction requires preserving global statistical distributions while enforcing exact local cardinalities. Existing data-driven and workload-aware approaches cannot satisfy both requirements simultaneously. We present DBRepro, an automated end-to-end framework that formulates database generation as a constrained distribution synthesis problem. DBRepro initializes a global distribution from lightweight column statistics, extracts execution constraints from target queries, and progressively adjusts the distribution to satisfy these constraints while preserving the global distribution. Experiments on TPC-H and SSB show that DBRepro reduces cardinality error by up to 20.3% over a data-driven baseline while maintaining identical plan consistency. Compared with a workload-aware baseline, it reproduces 15% more consistent execution plans and reduces latency proportion error by 21.5%. We further validate DBRepro on a nearly 1 TB real-world dataset managed by KingbaseES, where it reproduces the execution performance of complex slow queries with high fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DBRepro，一个端到端自动化的数据库合成框架，通过混合约束求解方法从非侵入性元数据合成代理数据库，用于离线复现慢查询。其核心思想是将数据库生成建模为约束分布合成问题：以轻量级列统计初始化全局分布，通过启发式概率推断与分布融合（IPF）满足选择基数约束（SCCs），并通过Scaling Factor增强的约束规划（CP）模型解决非主外键连接的基数约束（JCCs），从而在保留全局统计分布的同时严格满足局部基数。在TPC-H和SSB基准以及近1TB的真实工业数据集（KingbaseES）上的实验表明，DBRepro相比数据驱动基线可将基数误差降低20.3%，相比工作负载感知基线可多复现15%一致执行计划并将延迟比例误差降低21.5%。
AI.motivation: 慢查询严重影响数据库性能，但在线诊断会加剧资源争用，且数据隐私法规禁止将生产数据复制到测试环境。因此需要从非侵入性元数据合成代理数据库，使查询优化器生成与生产环境相同的物理执行计划，从而支持离线诊断。现有方法存在根本缺陷：数据驱动方法无法保证严格局部基数；工作负载感知方法严重扭曲全局分布，导致优化器选择偏离的执行计划。核心挑战在于同时满足全局统计分布与局部基数约束这一矛盾需求。
AI.method: DBRepro将数据库合成形式化为约束分布合成问题。整体流程包括：(1) 运行时上下文捕获器从生产环境非侵入地提取模式、列统计、慢查询及其物理执行计划；(2) 分析器将物理计划转换为带参数化谓词的注释查询计划（AQPs），并提取基数约束，分为选择基数约束（SCCs）和连接基数约束（JCCs）；(3) 数据分布管理器将MCV与直方图统一为累积分布函数（CDF），构建初始全局分布D_init；(4) 混合约束求解：对一元基数约束（UCCs）使用启发式概率推断（MCV匹配与CDF逆查找），冲突时通过迭代比例拟合（IPF）进行分布融合得到D_fused；对算术/逻辑约束采用后生成采样与元组绑定；对PK-FK JCCs使用PF规则，对非PK-FK JCCs引入Scaling Factor机制建模扇出效应，统一构建CP模型由CP-SAT求解器求解得到外键分布D_final；(5) 元组生成器依据D_final物理生成代理数据库。
AI.result: 在TPC-H（22查询）和SSB（13查询）基准上，DBRepro与数据驱动基线RSGen的计划结构一致性相当（18/22、13/13），而工作负载感知基线明显落后；基数误差最高降低20.3%；延迟比例误差降低21.5%，多复现15%一致执行计划。在20个LLM合成的未见查询上，DBRepro在高复杂度查询中保持最佳计划一致性与最低基数/延迟误差。统计保真度（NDV、直方图、MCV）接近PostgreSQL采样参考基线，范围查询误差在所有选择性下均优于工作负载感知方法。在近1TB、5个模式、约200张基表的真实工业数据集（KingbaseES）上对6个平均耗时超100秒的复杂慢查询进行测试，SCC、JCC、延迟比例平均误差分别为0.11%、3.27%、4.71%，所有查询计划结构完全一致。代价是离线生成时间约为Mirage的2倍，但因在线提取开销与数据量无关，整体效率比RSGen和Mirage分别高约1.5倍和3倍。
AI.conclusion: DBRepro通过统一数据驱动与工作负载感知方法，在保留全局统计分布的同时严格满足局部基数约束，实现了高保真慢查询离线复现。其基于IPF的分布融合与Scaling Factor增强的CP模型有效解决了统计与基数冲突及非PK-FK连接的扇出问题。在开源与商业CBO数据库上的广泛验证证明了其在结构、基数与延迟层面的优越复现能力，具备工业级实用价值。

title: VeriTS: Verifiable Model-Enhanced Time-Series Queries on Blockchain Systems
summary: Blockchain data is temporal. Every transaction carries a timestamp and the chain imposes a total order, so on-chain data forms per-source time-series streams. However, existing systems support only basic lookups on blocks and transactions, and cannot answer time-series queries such as time-range retrieval and windowed aggregation. Offloading queries off-chain restores expressiveness, but the off-chain query layer is untrusted, so results must be verifiable. To this end, we propose VeriTS, the first verifiable time-series query framework for blockchain systems. It supports efficient range and aggregation queries without altering blockchain storage structures. VeriTS maintains an off-chain query layer that represents each stream through an authenticated aggregate interval tree. The tree serves as the query index and as the authenticated data structure at once, so a windowed aggregate is answered by folding a logarithmic number of node aggregates. VeriTS verifies completeness through a minimum covering set and soundness through aggregate folding. It extends both guarantees to an approximate path over model segments, redefining completeness and soundness under bounded error. Miners validate a model's residual rather than replay its computation, so even an adversarial encoder can inflate proof size and answer width but never correctness. Experiments offer evidence that on windowed aggregation, VeriTS improves verification efficiency by more than two orders of magnitude over per-record proofs. Range-query proofs shrink by up to 14.5x.

AI.tldr: VeriTS提出首个面向区块链的可验证时间序列查询框架，通过认证聚合区间树实现对数复杂度的范围查询与窗口聚合验证，并引入基于模型段的近似路径在有界误差下支持延迟敏感查询。实验表明验证效率较逐记录证明提升两个数量级以上，范围查询证明缩小最高达14.5倍。
AI.motivation: 区块链数据天然具有时间序列特性，但现有系统仅支持块级和交易级查找，无法高效回答时间范围检索和窗口聚合等查询。链下查询层虽能恢复表达力却需要验证结果完整性，且引入学习型模型表示后还需解决有界误差下的可验证语义与信任问题。
AI.method: 构建三层架构：区块链层由BFT共识锚定双树根摘要；查询层以认证聚合区间树(AIT)同时充当查询索引与认证数据结构，通过最小覆盖集(MCS)与边界记录验证完整性、通过聚合折叠验证可靠性；近似路径采用分段区间树(SIT)对模型段认证，矿工仅校验残差而非重放编码器，再定义有界误差下的模型完整性与ε-可靠性，并利用到达位沿模型闭形式解析窗口边缘。
AI.result: 在五个以太坊与波场流上验证：精确路径验证效率较基线提升超两个数量级(范围查询证明缩小达14.5倍)；滑动窗口delta VO较独立验证缩小1.90倍；900次伪造全部被检测；108,000次区间检查在对抗性编码器下均包含真实答案；Learned分配策略在适配信噪条件下将区间宽度压缩至均匀分配的0.23-0.31倍。
AI.conclusion: VeriTS是首个无需改动区块链存储的可验证时间序列查询框架，统一了查询索引与认证结构，并通过精确路径与近似路径的组合在保持端到端可验证性的同时支持延迟敏感型监控查询。未来可扩展至模式匹配、top-k与可验证预测等更丰富的查询类型。

title: No Silver Bullet: Boosting GaussDB Performance on the 30TB TPC-H Workload
summary: GaussDB is Huawei's premier database system, designed for large-scale deployments and the most demanding workloads. It is a distributed shared-nothing system, capable of handling all types of workloads. This paper outlines a series of modifications to GaussDB aimed at improving its performance on large-scale and complex analytical workloads. After these changes, its performance on the TPC-H workload exceeded the best published result by 40% at 30 TB. The key enhancements to achieve this elite performance include adopting a pipeline execution model, a faster and more scalable inter-node data shuffle, exploiting a unified bus and unified remote memory access. We also expanded the support of cost-based Bloom filter placement and implemented several Bloom filter streaming strategies, enabling their use across nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了华为云原生分布式关系数据库 GaussDB 在 30TB TPC-H 工作负载上取得领先性能（QphH@30TB = 39,508,107，超出此前最佳公开结果 40%）所做的一系列优化。核心改进包括：采用管道（pipeline）执行模型替代火山（Volcano）模型以提升 CPU 利用率；设计两级邮箱（two-level mailbox）机制以解决 shuffle 的可扩展性问题；利用华为统一总线（UB）与统一远程内存访问（URMA）加速节点间数据传输；扩展代价感知的 Bloom 过滤器以支持 MPP 环境，并通过 HLL 概要检测近外键约束以辅助优化器决策。这些改进虽然多数基于已有技术，但在 GaussDB 架构中被适配与整合，最终在 ARM 架构上取得了业界最优的分析性能。
AI.motivation: 在大规模（30TB）TPC-H 分析负载下，传统 Volcano 执行模型、shuffle 可扩展性瓶颈以及 TCP 网络开销等问题制约了 GaussDB 的性能。论文旨在通过对执行模型、shuffle 通信、Bloom 过滤器优化和统计信息等多方面的协同改进，使 GaussDB 在大型分析负载上达到业界领先水平。
AI.method: 1) 管道执行框架：在原有 Volcano 引擎旁构建 pipeline 引擎，将查询计划分解为线性 pipeline；pipeline 内部采用 pull 模型管理 VectorBatch 内存所有权，pipeline 之间采用 push 模型；通过无锁本地交换缓存（基于 cache_status 位位与 __builtin_ctzll）实现高效的本地数据交换；采用事件驱动的自调度机制管理任务状态转移。2) 可扩展 shuffle：设计两级邮箱（c-mailbox 含 sub-c-mailbox + p-mailbox），将配额管理从分区级提升到节点级，使通信连接数随 DN 数量而非 DOP×DN 扩展；利用华为 UB 网络的 URMA 原语替代 TCP，并引入轻量级顺序保持机制。3) 分布式 Bloom 过滤器：在 MPP 环境下扩展代价感知 CBO 支持，比较 MPP-merge（网络流量 O(d²)）与 MPP-distributed（网络流量 O(d)）策略，根据分区键是否可用选择；采用 bucket Bloom 过滤器避免缓存行未命中，并对传输数据进行 LZ4 压缩。4) 统计与近外键检测：利用 HLL 概要比较两列的 ρ' 分布以检测包含依赖（近外键），用于支持提前聚合改写和剪枝冗余 Bloom 过滤器。附加优化包括 SIMD 自动向量化、Numeric 类型的整数向量存储以及 IMCV 轻量压缩。
AI.result: Pipeline 模型在 100GB TPC-H、Q21、DOP=32 下较 Volcano 快 28%，CPU 利用率更高、上下文切换更少；两级邮箱在 DNs=32、DOP=32 的 Q9 下较扁平邮箱提升 26.89%；UB 替代 TCP 在 8 节点 7.5TB 集群上整体提升 7.18%，对 shuffle 密集型查询（Q03/05/09/13/15/16/22）收益显著；MPP-distributed Bloom 过滤器在扩展性上明显优于 MPP-merge；BF-CBO 相比无 Bloom 过滤器可减少 50-60% 总执行时间。最终在 30TB TPC-H 上使用 32 台鲲鹏 BMS（128 DNs、5120 vCPU、64TB 内存），GaussDB 取得 QphH@30TB = 39,508,107，较此前最佳公开记录（Hologres）提升 40%，每 vCPU 性能达 7716 QphH/vCPU。
AI.conclusion: 通过管道执行模型、两级邮箱 shuffle、UB/URMA 网络通信、代价感知 Bloom 过滤器以及 HLL 概要近外键检测等多项改进的协同作用，GaussDB 在 30TB TPC-H 工作负载上取得了业界领先的分析性能，验证了系统级协同优化的重要性，也展示了 ARM 架构在大规模分析负载上的竞争力。论文也指出部分查询因 URMA 内核开销仍存在性能退化，未来将探索自适应通信模式选择。

title: Select, Don't Train: The Benefits of Modular Entity Disambiguation with LLM-Based Selection
comment: Accepted at the 25th International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC 2026), Research Track
summary: Entity Disambiguation (ED) is a key task for constructing and using knowledge graphs. State-of-the-art neural approaches commonly model ED as a single task, although it consists of two distinct subproblems: retrieving candidate entities and selecting the correct one given context. Dual-encoder models optimize for both within a shared embedding space, forcing representations to balance high-recall retrieval with fine-grained selection, and they require trained retrievers, which are costly to maintain as knowledge graphs change. While recent work has begun to combine retrievers with LLM-based selectors, the interplay between the two stages has not been studied systematically. In this paper, we present a systematic comparison of retrieval strategies for candidate generation under a shared LLM-based selection stage, combining sparse retrieval (BM25), Web KB search, and a state-of-the-art trained dense retriever with several open- and closed-source LLMs. We show that, once selection is delegated to a capable LLM, training the retriever provides only modest additional value: a fully training-free BM25 retriever paired with an LLM selector reaches a new state of the art on the ZELDA benchmark, raising inKB micro-F1 from 82.3 to 86.3 (+4); pairing the same LLM with a trained dense retriever reaches 88.5. Decoupling retrieval from selection also exposes a limitation of current ED systems: when the correct entity is missing from retrieved candidates, they are forced to predict an incorrect entity. In contrast, our framework allows for abstention when retrieval failure is detected. In an evaluation setting that rewards correct abstentions, the training-free BM25 + LLM pipeline reaches 90.7 F1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAISED框架,将实体消歧(ED)解耦为检索与选择两阶段,系统比较了BM25(稀疏)、VERBALIZED(训练密集)、Wikipedia API(Web)三种检索策略与多种LLM选择器组合,在ZELDA基准上发现:无需训练的BM25搭配LLM选择器即可达到新SOTA(inKB F1 86.3,放弃项评估下90.7),训练密集检索器增益有限(88.5),且模块化设计支持识别检索失败并主动放弃。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端双编码器ED模型将检索与选择耦合在同一嵌入空间中,既需兼顾高召回检索又需细粒度选择,且训练好的检索器随KB演化维护成本高;虽然已有工作开始结合LLM做选择,但检索与选择两阶段的交互缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: RAISED框架:1)检索器(BM25/Wikipedia API/复用的VERBALIZED双编码器)返回top-16候选;2)选择器(LLM,包括GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.4-mini、Qwen3-32B、Mistral-Small-24B,以及QLoRA微调的Qwen3-8B和Mistral-Nemo-12B)以多选题prompt形式从候选中选ID或输出"None of the candidates"放弃;3)评估采用标准inKB F1和放弃项感知F1(奖励正确的None-of-Candidates预测);在ZELDA基准9个数据集(AIDA-B、TWEEKI、Reddit、WNED-WIKI、WNED-CWEB、ShadowLinks三子集)上系统比较。
AI.result: 在ZELDA基准上:1)GPT-5.4-mini+VERBALIZED检索达88.5平均F1,显著超过端到端VERBALIZED基线82.3;2)完全无需训练的BM25+GPT-5.4-mini即达86.3,刷新SOTA;3)Wikipedia API检索表现最不稳定,在ShadowLinks-Shadow等高歧义集上召回严重不足;4)放弃项感知评估下,BM25+GPT-5.4-mini进一步升至90.7 F1;5)小模型QLoRA微调(1K样本)能部分缩小与32B零样本差距,在BM25+放弃项F1上Qwen3-8B(53.1)可匹配大模型(53.8);6)召回分析显示VERBALIZED在困难集上召回优势明显(R@1 82.0 vs BM25 65.7),但选择阶段可补偿部分差距;7)定性分析表明候选质量(而非纯召回)对选择至关重要,且overshadowing现象是选择问题,即使检索正确时仍会偏向流行实体。
AI.conclusion: 实体消歧的检索与选择可作为相对独立组件分别优化;强LLM选择器使轻量级、无需训练的稀疏检索(BM25)仍具竞争力,无需依赖紧耦合的密集检索器;模块化设计还支持显式检测检索失败并主动放弃,这是端到端双编码器无法做到的;但KB中的NIL实体处理仍待研究。

title: Credo: Reusable Declarative Primitives for Agentic Workflows
summary: An LLM application depends on both a model and a harness: the program that determines what each call sees, how many calls to make, and which answers to trust. Coding agents can now discover strong harnesses by searching over candidate programs, but the resulting artifact is an opaque block of imperative code whose logical steps, runtime signals, physical execution decisions, and prompt strategies remain implicit and task-specific, forcing subsequent tasks to start the harness search process from scratch. The potential for reuse, however, is substantial. A searched harness encodes significant knowledge, such as the logical steps that work, the signals that matter, the physical operator decisions that adapt execution, and the prompt strategies that are effective, yet this knowledge is buried in imperative code with no inspectable or reusable structure, nor does it carry any provenance or metadata. Credo addresses this problem by recovering a structured declarative description of a searched harness, tagging each extracted primitive with relevant metadata, and cataloguing all of it with provenance. A compiler can then bind stored primitives to generate harnesses for new tasks without having to start the search over from scratch. This paper provides preliminary results demonstrating the potential of our approach and lays out a related research agenda that the database community is well-positioned to tackle, including cost-based compilation over declarative catalogs and catalog maintenance under model and workload drift.

AI.tldr: Credo提出从编码智能体搜索得到的不透明命令式harness中恢复出结构化、可重用的声明式原语（skeleton骨架、beliefs信念、policies策略、prompt templates提示模板），将其编目并配备来源信息，使编译器能为新任务合成harness而无需重新搜索。初步实验在金融、法律、数学、推理四个领域验证了往返保真度与跨域复用效果，并勾勒了数据库社区可推进的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 基于编码智能体搜索得到的最优harness通常以一整块命令式代码存在，其逻辑步骤、运行时信号、物理执行决策与提示策略混杂且任务特定，令后续任务必须从头再次进行昂贵的harness搜索，造成大量可复用知识的浪费。类似问题在数据库领域中曾通过UDF内省与声明式恢复得到解决，论文主张对LLM harness采用类似思路。
AI.method: Credo包含三个组件：(1) Abstractor——从搜索得到的harness.py中提取四类声明式原语（skeleton DAG、beliefs含输入派生/中间结果/输出质量三种类的派生属性、policies基于信念选择物理实现的规则、prompt templates含可绑定槽位的NL模板）；(2) Level-tagger+Librarian——按转移作用域打标（L1功能性可共享、L2源特定），分两层（general/与specific/）进入目录并保留来源信息；(3) Compiler——为目标任务选择原语并绑定槽位生成可运行harness，未达标则回退到搜索。整套思想借鉴数据库的逻辑/物理计划分离与UDF声明式恢复先例。
AI.result: 在金融、法律、数学、polyreason四个领域，先用Meta-Harness各运行10轮搜索产生强harness，再用Credo往返编译：在分布内100题测试中，accuracy偏差≤±0.011，每题成本偏差≤±0.013¢，单次往返成本约\$2.3–2.8、几分钟，而原搜索花费\$43–72、数小时；跨域复用方面，retrieval族内finance↔legal可恢复约76%相对精度增益并保持低推理成本；reasoning族math→polyreason维持极低成本但精度低于基线，polyreason→math则借助answers_agree信念提升精度。还观察到搜索得到的harness存在分布内过拟合。
AI.conclusion: Credo展示了把已搜索harness视为可管理的声明式制品的可行性——通过原语编目与编译，可在不重新搜索的前提下产生跨领域可用的新harness，且显著降低成本。论文据此提出数据库社区可推进的研究议程：基于代价的编译、目录随模型/工作负载漂移的维护、执行上下文恢复、可插拔后端。

title: Are These Modules Worth Their Cost? A Paradigm-Level Accuracy-Cost Analysis of In-context Learning Text-to-SQL
summary: Recent advances in in-context learning (ICL) text-to-SQL have substantially improved execution accuracy on public benchmarks by assembling increasingly elaborate pipelines around the base generator, yet existing studies typically report aggregate end-to-end accuracy, without quantifying the marginal accuracy-cost contribution of individual design choices. Consequently, providing a unified, paradigm-level cost-accuracy quantification remains a critical challenge for understanding and configuring modern text-to-SQL. To address this, we instantiate 17 paradigm-level configurations across five recurring modules of the ICL text-to-SQL pipeline under a single controlled implementation, and attribute each paradigm's marginal contribution and incurred cost across all four backbones spanning diverse capability levels and reasoning styles. Our analysis reveals that execution-feedback refinement is the only paradigm whose benefit holds universally at consistently low cost, while most other modules help only under backbone-dependent conditions. Token accounting shows that input demand is more closely tied to pipeline structure, whereas output demand is more sensitive to backbone generation behavior. Cross-module analysis further shows that stacking improves accuracy on most backbones, although how the gains compose varies with backbone capability. We also find that a fixed budget is often better spent engineering a more elaborate pipeline over a mid-tier backbone than upgrading to a frontier model with a lean pipeline. These findings distill into an actionable, cost-aware tiered guideline that transfers to five additional backbones without per-paradigm search.

AI.tldr: 本文针对ICL text-to-SQL领域中现有研究仅报告聚合端到端准确率、缺乏对各模块边际精度-成本贡献量化的问题，进行了首个受控的范式级精度-成本评估。通过在统一实现下实例化5个模块共17种范式配置，并在4个主骨干模型上分析每个范式的边际贡献与成本，揭示了执行反馈精修（R₁）是唯一通用且低成本的范式，并发现固定预算常更适合用于在中端骨干上构建复杂流水线；最终提炼出一套可迁移到额外骨干的成本感知分层配置指南。
AI.motivation: 现代ICL text-to-SQL系统通过堆叠多个推理时模块（如示例检索、模式链接、生成策略、候选选择、精修）不断提升公开基准的执行准确率，但现有研究通常仅报告聚合端到端准确率，掩盖了各模块的边际贡献；同时，智能体式精修循环和多候选采样消耗的token和美元成本可达单次通过的数倍乃至一个数量级，却鲜有研究将成本与准确率联合考量。实践者难以判断哪些模块值得添加、流水线应推进到何种程度才停止带来正向收益。
AI.method: 将ICL text-to-SQL流水线分解为三个阶段五个模块（示例检索、模式链接、生成策略、候选选择、精修），共形成17种范式级配置。在统一受控框架下重新实现所有配置，采用单交换协议（仅替换目标模块，其余模块保持trivial设置）以隔离每个范式的边际贡献。在BIRD开发集上以GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Gemini-2.5-Flash、GPT-5.4四个主骨干进行评估，并在Spider上验证跨基准迁移。使用执行准确率（EX）、oracle候选召回（OCR）、成本每EX点（CPP）、输入/输出token数等指标，结合McNemar检验进行统计推断。最后提炼分层配置指南并在5个额外骨干上验证迁移性。
AI.result: 1) 执行反馈精修（R₁）是唯一在四个骨干上均带来显著提升且CPP始终低于0.30 USD/pp的范式，增益介于+1.83至+4.89 pp；2) 模式链接作为"能力假体"，其价值随骨干能力上升而下降；示例检索的E₂范式在非推理骨干上随基线EX增大而增益放大；3) 外部推理脚手架（CoT、分解）主要帮助非推理骨干，在三个推理骨干上均无一致增益；4) 候选选择受限于固定候选池召回天花板，oracle与最优选择器之间仍有高达5.74 pp差距；6) token分析显示输入需求与流水线结构关联更紧，输出需求对骨干生成行为更敏感；7) 跨模块交互呈骨干依赖性，堆叠在多数骨干上提升准确率但组合方式各异；8) 适度预算下，中端骨干上构建丰富流水线比升级到前沿模型运行精简流水线更具性价比——Gemini-2.5-Flash完整流水线在BIRD和Spider上均Pareto占优于GPT-5.4精简基线；9) 提炼的三级配置指南（T1裸骨干→T2加R₁→T3加E₂+S₂+骨干条件G*）在5个额外验证骨干上一致改善，T3增益范围+3.98至+7.63 pp。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将ICL text-to-SQL流水线视为模块化对象进行孤立分析，发现R₁（执行反馈精修）是唯一可作为安全默认的通用低代价范式；其余模块的收益呈骨干依赖性，其中输入侧脚手架与能力相关，生成侧脚手架与推理风格相关，候选选择受候选池多样性约束。关键洞察是固定预算下，中端骨干+丰富流水线常优于前沿骨干+精简流水线。最终将发现提炼为依赖骨干推理行为的分层成本感知配置指南，无需逐范式搜索即可迁移到新骨干，为实践者提供了基于精度-成本联合考量而非仅聚合精度的实用配置起点。

title: Time Capsule of Testable Human Knowledge: 41 Years of Jeopardy! in a Single Free Local Model
summary: In 2011, IBM's Watson was something like a sealed capsule of its era's queryable knowledge. Its DeepQA system defeated the strongest human Jeopardy! champions, but the knowledge that let it do so lived in a curated billion-document corpus running on a cluster of POWER7 servers, frozen at build time and impossible to move or copy. We show that the same kind of artifact, a snapshot of what a culture can answer, is now portable and essentially free. We evaluate a single 9 GB open-weight model (Qwen2.5-14B, 4-bit) against the complete open Jeopardy! clue dataset, 529,939 clues across all 41 broadcast seasons from 1984 to 2025. To our knowledge this is the first time a model has been run over the full corpus. The 41 years mark only how long the questions were collected. What they test is far older and broader: the accumulated body of human general knowledge a culture considers worth knowing, from ancient history and dead languages to science, literature, and geography, with a verified answer for every item. The model answers 67.0% of all clues under a strict forced-response protocol with exact and fuzzy matching, and exceeds 85% on factoid categories. We treat training-data exposure as something both systems share rather than a flaw unique to language models. Watson's case is in fact the more extreme one. Its corpus was assembled to contain Jeopardy answers and it was tuned on past clues, and it could not answer anything outside that curated distribution. The decisive test is whether a model can answer clues that did not exist when it was built. On clues aired after its training cutoff, the local model holds 65% and Claude Opus 4.8 holds 95%, while Watson by construction scores zero. The capability survives the move from a server room to a file you could seal in a time capsule, and unlike Watson it is not frozen to its own moment.

AI.tldr: 本文使用单个9 GB开源模型(Qwen2.5-14B 4-bit量化)在完整529,939条《Jeopardy!》题目数据集(覆盖1984-2025年41季)上进行评估,在严格强制回答协议下达到67.0%准确率,并证明现代小型语言模型在开放域问答能力上已接近2011年IBM Watson的水平,且具备Watson架构所缺乏的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: Watson代表了一个时代可查询知识的"密封胶囊",但其能力固化在服务器集群中且不可迁移。本文旨在回答:Watson级别的问答能力现在能以多小的代价复现?并严肃对待"预训练数据暴露"这一质疑,将其视为Watson与LLM共同面临的问题,进而探究哪种系统能回答训练时未见过的问题。
AI.method: 在完整Jeopardy!开放数据集(529,939条线索)上评估Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct(4-bit量化,9 GB),通过Ollama以32并发运行,使用贪心解码与词法匹配(精确+模糊,阈值88)评分。另外在5个开源Transformer(4.7-19 GB)上进行分层抽样对比,并设计训练截止后(2025年后)的线索作为分布外测试,以分离"记忆"与"可迁移知识"。
AI.result: 主结果:67.0%全语料准确率,事实类(科学88%、地点87%)远超85%,文字游戏类最低58%,Final Jeopardy仅48%。多模型分层结果:Qwen2.5-32B达73.9%,接近Watson的75.4%。分布外测试:Qwen2.5-14B在训练后线索上保持65%(仅下降2个百分点),Claude Opus 4.8保持95%(下降1个百分点),证明能力来自可迁移知识而非线索记忆,这是Watson架构因构建方式所无法进入的范畴。压缩比方面:18万亿训练token(约70 TB)压缩为9 GB权重,压缩比约8000:1。
AI.conclusion: Jeopardy!作为基准已"老化",因为其核心难度——理解间接措辞——已成为指令调优模型的默认能力,而非需要专门工程解决的问题。真正残留的难度集中在表面符号操纵(文字游戏、Final类)。作者提出"知识压缩"作为正确框架:文化可测试的问答知识现在可封装于一个足够小、可放在microSD卡或蓝光光盘上的文件中,既可永久归档,也可被"询问"——这使其在人类知识保存媒介谱系中(从亚历山大图书馆到旅行者金唱片)占据独特位置。

title: Rating the Raters: Rasch Measurement Theory for LLM Evaluation
summary: LLMs now sit on every side of evaluation: as examinees scored on benchmarks, judges of other models' outputs, and raters of human-generated content. Each paradigm can be viewed as a measurement problem, where a latent property of an object is probed with items from an instrument (e.g., benchmark) by raters. Standard evaluation practices often neglect the contributions of each core component to the end result, limiting our understanding of what is being measured. Rasch measurement theory (RMT) is well-suited to this kind of problem. RMT decomposes ordinal ratings into separable facets on a common scale. It further provides a battery of diagnostics that can identify miscalibrated measurements and rater biases. We present a case study of RMT applied to the LLM-as-rater paradigm using the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, whose construct was itself built under RMT. We fit a series of many-facet Rasch models to annotations from nine LLMs spanning families and capability levels. Our analyses show that LLMs systematically differ from human raters in severity, item-level calibration, question-order robustness, target-identity sensitivity, and rating scale use, which all would be obscured by standard evaluation practice. Overall, we argue that RMT belongs in the toolkit for evaluating LLM-as-examinee, -judge, and -rater paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文将Rasch测量理论（RMT）应用于LLM-as-rater范式的评估，通过多面Rasch模型诊断LLM与人类标注者在仇恨言论标注上的系统性差异，包括评分严重度、条目校准、问题顺序敏感性、目标身份敏感性及量表使用等方面，论证RMT应纳入LLM作为受试者、评判者和标注者三种评估范式的工具箱。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM评估实践通常将对象、条目和标注者的贡献聚合为单一分数，忽视了测量的多维结构。现有的心理测量方法多应用于LLM-as-examinee范式，而LLM-as-judge和LLM-as-rater范式缺乏原则性的测量工具。RMT作为一种成熟的测量理论，能够分解序数评分为可分离的facet并提供诊断工具，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用多面Rasch测量模型（many-facet Rasch model），以Measuring Hate Speech（MHS）语料库（50,070条评论，11,143名标注者，十条目工具）为基准，构建测量构念。收集9个主要LLM（涵盖不同家族与能力层级）及34个扩展LLM的标注，拟合三类测量模型：(i)仅人类模型，(ii)人类锚定模型（θ_n和δ_i锚定至人类基线），(iii)仅LLM模型。通过严重度参数α_j、条目-标注者交互项μ_ij、差分标注者功能（DRF，含问题顺序反转与目标身份分析）以及Rasch-Andrich阈值τ_k进行系统性诊断。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 所有9个LLM的严重度均低于人类中位数，表明LLM更倾向于将评论标注为仇恨言论；(2) 严重度与AA Intelligence Index显著正相关（r=0.52, p<10⁻³），更强大的模型严重度更高；(3) 90个条目-模型交互项中30个显著，Hate Speech项普遍呈负交互（LLM对此项不如预期严格），Dehumanize/Violence/Genocide项普遍呈正交互；(4) 问题顺序反转显著提高严重度，效应集中于低能力模型（如GPT-OSS 120B的odds ratio达1.84）；(5) 82/126的目标身份交互项显著，Muslim-针对评论普遍odds ratio<1（更低仇恨阈值），Gay-针对评论普遍odds ratio>1，Black-针对评论在高/低AA Index模型间呈现分裂；(6) LLM-only量表在量表低端（Sentiment/Respect/Attack）与人类量表相似，但在Dehumanize/Violence/Genocide高端呈现更大间隔；(7) Rasch-Andrich阈值显示Dehumanize/Violence/Genocide存在严重无序，需要更强的干预（如响应合并）。
AI.conclusion: RMT为LLM评估提供了原则性的量化框架，将散乱的观察统一到以明确构念为锚的单一框架中。LLM标注者与人类标注者存在系统性差异，包括更低严重度、特定条目的差异校准、量表使用不一致以及自行构建量表时条目位置的差异，这些发现挑战了直接将人类构念效度迁移到LLM标注者的做法。作者主张LLM评估应被视为测量问题，RMT应纳入LLM作为受试者、评判者和标注者三种范式的工具箱，尽管该方法带来构念理论化、工具设计和验证的开销，但对严谨性至关重要。

title: Not All Explanations Are Sought: Information-Seeking Psychology for Human-Centered XAI
comment: Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Human-Centered Explainable AI (HCXAI), CHI 2026
summary: This position paper argues that human-centered explainable AI (HCXAI) should incorporate insights from the psychology of information seeking. Drawing on Sharot and Sunstein's framework of information-seeking motives, we propose that people evaluate whether to engage with explanations based on three types of expected utility: instrumental (will it help me act better?), hedonic (will it make me feel better?), and cognitive (will it improve my understanding?). Each utility is estimated through a lens shaped by well-documented cognitive biases, including illusion of control, automation bias, unrealistic optimism, impact bias, overconfidence, and confirmation bias. These biases can lead to two failure modes: excessive information-seeking that fragments attention without improving decisions, and insufficient information-seeking that leaves critical risks and misunderstandings unexamined. This challenge is particularly acute for agentic AI systems, where explanations must support not just understanding a single output but anticipating cascading actions, assessing risks, and deciding when to intervene. By integrating information-seeking psychology into HCXAI, we advocate for a shift from making explanations available to making them sought: designing systems that account for when and why users actually want to know.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文主张将信息寻求心理学（基于Sharot和Sunstein框架）融入以人为中心的可解释AI（HCXAI），指出用户基于工具性、享乐性和认知性三类预期效用决定是否寻求解释，并受认知偏差影响，从而提出设计应从"使解释可获取"转向"使解释被主动寻求"。
AI.motivation: 当前XAI研究隐含假设用户想要解释并会在提供时参与，但实证证据（如LLM解释强化过度依赖、时间压力下无论解释质量如何都遵从AI建议、用户参与度差异巨大）表明"使解释可获取"不等于"使用户寻求解释"。论文旨在填补这一理论空白，特别是在智能体AI（agentic AI）场景下，用户是否寻求解释关乎级联行动的监督与风险评估。
AI.method: 采用立场论文（position paper）形式，基于Sharot和Sunstein（2020）的信息寻求动机框架进行理论综合与概念分析。将解释的预期效用分解为三类（工具性、享乐性、认知性），并映射六种认知偏差（控制错觉、自动化偏差、不切实际的乐观、影响偏差、过度自信、确认偏差），进而推导出两种失败模式：过度信息寻求与信息寻求不足。
AI.result: 提出了一个统一的理论框架：用三类预期效用（工具性——"能否帮我更好地行动？"；享乐性——"能否让我感觉更好？"；认知性——"能否提升我的理解？"）解释用户何时为何参与或回避AI解释；并识别了认知偏差如何扭曲这些效用评估，导致可预测的过度寻求或寻求不足模式。该框架能统一解释过度依赖、解释回避和异质参与度等HCXAI领域已观察到的现象。
AI.conclusion: 论文倡导HCXAI范式转变：从"使解释可获取"（making explanations available）转向"使解释被寻求"（making explanations sought），即设计需考虑用户实际何时何因想要了解的系统。这对于智能体AI尤其关键，因其涉及级联行动的预判、风险评估和干预决策。整合信息寻求心理学为理解用户行为提供了理论基础。

title: Retrieving Relations, Detecting Fallacies: A RAG Approach to Political Debate Analysis
summary: Fallacies are arguments that employ invalid reasoning, making their automatic detection critical in sensitive contexts such as high-stakes political debates, where public opinion is shaped. Spotting a fallacious argument requires contextual knowledge beyond its pure surface text. This entails world knowledge pertaining to the subject matter under discussion, as well as knowledge of the relationships that exist between arguments within the argumentative discourse. Prior work on fallacy analysis has shown that argumentative discourse structure can beneficially improve classification performance. However, such structure is typically encoded only as static classifier features, limiting its flexibility. Building on this intuition while addressing this limitation, we introduce a guided retrieval-augmented methodology for fallacy detection and classification that leverages argumentative relations of support and attack to dynamically steer the extraction of relevant documents. We evaluate our approach on the ElecDeb60to20 benchmark across 42 retrieval configurations and 14 models, performing retrieval over a 15GB knowledge base of collected political-related documents. Our approach improves macro-F1 up to 0.864 for fallacy detection and up to 0.725 for classification over non-retrieval baselines. These results show that incorporating external knowledge significantly enhances fallacy detection and classification when retrieval is argumentatively guided.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由论证关系（支持/攻击）引导的RAG方法，用于政治辩论中的谬误检测与分类。在自建的15GB时间敏感知识库上，通过42种检索配置和14个模型实验，在ElecDeb60to20基准上取得显著提升（检测macro-F1达0.864，分类达0.725），并在PROPAGANDA数据集上验证了方法的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 政治辩论中谬误识别需要超越表面文本的世界知识和论证结构知识。已有工作仅将论证关系作为静态特征使用，缺乏灵活性。该研究旨在通过动态检索增强的方式，将论证关系用于引导外部知识的获取，从而提升谬误检测与分类性能。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：(1) 查询生成——基于论证结构生成三种查询变体（仅句子、句子+关联成分、句子+关联成分+关系标签）；(2) 检索——使用Sentence-RooseBERT等稠密检索器与BM25，结合混合搜索和cross-encoder重排序；(3) 输入生成——融合检索证据与本地辩论上下文；(4) 模型预测。在15GB知识库（涵盖立法、人物、地理、历史、谬误定义、标注示例）上进行检索，并测试时间过滤效果。
AI.result: 谬误检测：ModernBERT+RAG达macro-F1 0.864（+0.100），所有编码器均获提升；谬误分类：macro-F1 0.725（+0.072），RoBERTa提升最大（+0.335）。消融实验显示论证关系查询贡献最大（检测+6.2点），Sentence-RooseBERT优于通用嵌入模型。解码器LLM均因长领域上下文而性能下降。附录验证PROPAGANDA数据集macro-F1从75.1提升至85.5（+10.4），证明方法可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 论证关系引导的检索增强能显著提升谬误检测与分类性能。检索查询的论证结构信息贡献最大，领域预训练的检索器效果最佳。检索对检测帮助更大（依赖时代事实上下文），对分类帮助较小（依赖修辞形式）。该方法可推广至其他论证任务，并为可解释的谬误解释提供基础。

title: LLM-Augmented Causal Discovery: Probabilistic Fusion of Edge Existence and Orientation
comment: Accepted as a poster at Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGM) 2026 Conference
summary: Bayesian network structure learning (BNSL) from observational data struggles with orientation identifiability, while large language models (LLMs) offer broad but often unreliable causal knowledge. We propose combining these complementary sources through a novel representation, termed Probabilistic Dependency Graphs (PDGs). In a PDG, each edge is associated with a distribution over directed, undirected, and absent states, enabling fusion via weighted averaging. We evaluate this approach on 26 benchmark networks, combining ensembles of three BNSL algorithms (FGES, Tabu, PC) with three LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT) across multiple prompts and random seeds. A simple 50/50 fusion improves F1 over the better of either source alone in 22 of 26 networks, with a statistically significant mean improvement of $0.056$ $(p<0.001)$. Analysis reveals that the two sources play complementary roles: BNSL contributes a high-recall edge skeleton (80\% vs 60\% for LLM), while LLM contributes accurate edge orientation (96\% vs 77\% for BNSL). Our results show that representing both sources as probabilistic uncertainty over edge existence and orientation is a practical and effective way to improve causal graph accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率依赖图（PDG）这一新表示，将贝叶斯网络结构学习（BNSL）算法和大语言模型（LLM）的输出统一为边存在与方向的概率分布，通过加权平均进行融合。在26个基准网络上的实验表明，简单的50/50融合在22/26的网络上优于任一单源，F1平均提升0.056（p<0.001）。BNSL提供高召回的边骨架（80% vs LLM 60%），而LLM提供更准确的边方向（96% vs BNSL 77%），二者形成互补。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯网络结构学习（BNSL）从观测数据中难以确定边的方向（orientation identifiability问题），而大语言模型（LLM）虽具备广泛的因果知识但可靠性不高。两种来源存在互补潜力：数据驱动方法擅长识别边是否存在（骨架），而基于知识的方法可能更擅长确定边的方向。然而现有方法多以LLM作为约束或先验注入BNSL，未能以统一概率表示融合两种不确定性来源。
AI.method: 核心方法为概率依赖图（Probabilistic Dependency Graphs, PDGs）：对每条边定义四元概率分布（p_none, p_fwd, p_bwd, p_und），将DAG、CPDAG、PDAG统一映射到该表示。融合通过MergeGraphs算法（加权平均各源的边概率）实现。提取DAG使用ToDagGreedy贪心算法（按存在概率阈值τ=0.3筛选，依次加入避免环）。LLM侧：通过Claude预处理生成"伪装"上下文（替换变量名为中性别名、模糊领域名），使用3个LLM（Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-4.1 mini）× 2种prompt详细程度 × 3次重复（温度0.7）构建18个LLM PDG，再融合为LLM集成PDG。BNSL侧：使用PC-Stable、Tabu-Stable、FGES三种算法，每个算法在3组各5个数据集上学习，再融合为BNSL集成PDG。最终以50/50权重融合LLM与BNSL PDG。
AI.result: 在26个离散变量基准网络（8-70个节点，涵盖医疗、生态、工程、金融等领域）上评估：BNSL平均F1=0.662，LLM平均F1=0.572，融合后平均F1=0.760。融合在22/26网络上优于二者中较优者，平均F1提升+0.056（Wilcoxon p<0.001，W=36.0）；相对BNSL提升+0.099（23/26胜），相对LLM提升+0.188（25/26胜）。互补性分析：BNSL边召回率0.802 vs LLM 0.603；LLM方向准确率0.96 vs BNSL 0.77；方向准确率增益与F1提升显著相关（Spearman r=0.51, p=0.008），证实LLM主要通过改善方向贡献。消融实验显示多样性（多LLM、多prompt、多BNSL算法）均带来正向增益，但数据量大小比样本多样性更重要（10K样本单用优于1K+10K混合）。Oracle加权分析表明每网络最优权重可再获+0.027增益。后置审计未发现基准识别或因果信息泄露与融合增益存在显著相关性。
AI.conclusion: PDG作为统一概率表示能有效融合BNSL与LLM两种来源的因果信息。50/50加权融合在多数基准上一致性地优于单源方法，且无需修改底层结构学习算法。核心发现是两种来源具有本质互补性：数据驱动方法贡献高召回骨架，知识驱动方法贡献准确方向。然而该方法存在局限——仅在离散、小至中型网络（≤70节点）评估；未检验概率校准；等权重并非最优（Oracle分析提示存在更好权重策略）；使用清洁合成数据可能高估真实场景下BNSL表现。未来工作方向包括：扩展PDG以包含bidirected边以表示潜在混杂；开发客观的BNSL/LLM加权准则；评估连续变量与更大规模网络；在含噪声、缺失数据、潜在混杂条件下的鲁棒性研究；以及构建更难被LLM记忆的新型基准。

title: Hypothesize, Evaluate, Refine: A Scientific Agent for PDE Discovery with Unknown Spatial Coefficient Fields
summary: Discovering PDEs in heterogeneous media requires jointly identifying the governing operator and the unknown spatial fields that parameterize it. These tasks are coupled: changing field placement changes the differential law, while a sufficiently flexible field can conceal structural error on a single trajectory. We present Hypothesize, Evaluate, Refine for PDE Discovery (HER-PDE), a scientific-agent framework that discovers compositional PDE structure together with nonparametric, time-invariant coefficient fields. The Agent analyzes two noisy trajectories generated by different excitations, proposes complete expression-tree hypotheses, and combines creative structural exploration with local candidate refinement. Its Hypothesis Evaluation Interface (HEI) estimates only the fields explicitly declared in each hypothesis, never adds missing terms, and scores structures by bidirectional cross-excitation transfer. The selected law is subsequently audited on a sealed temporal interval. Across five controlled two-dimensional systems observed with 5 percent relative Gaussian state noise, the Agent recovers the generating operator in all five cases, including equivalent signed-field and product-rule parameterizations. Across nine unknown coefficient fields, the recovered fields attain a median Pearson correlation of approximately 0.85 and a median relative L2 error of approximately 0.28. These results show that agent-guided hypothesis refinement can recover heterogeneous governing laws without prescribing a parametric form for their spatial coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HER-PDE框架，将科学智能体与符号PDE发现相结合，用于在非参数时不变空间系数场条件下联合发现偏微分方程结构与未知系数场。该方法在五个二维系统（含地下水流动、变扩散、反应扩散、对流扩散、正交扩散）上以5%相对高斯噪声恢复生成算子，9个未知场的Pearson相关系数中位数≈0.85。
AI.motivation: 异质介质中的PDE发现问题需同时识别离散算子结构与未知的时不变空间系数场。二者耦合：算子放置不同则规律不同，过度灵活的场还可能掩盖单条轨迹上的结构误差。现有方法要么固定结构库（如PDE-FIND、SINDy）、要么对系数施加参数化形式（如B样条、紧致解析式），缺少开放式的组合式PDE结构搜索与非参数场估计相结合的方案。
AI.method: HER-PDE包含三部分：(1) 候选语言以"完整表达式树"形式保留算子作用域、场放置、空间依赖与场复用，支持非线性耦合但对未知场线性；(2) 假设评估接口HEI用Savitzky–Golay张量积局部多项式估计导数冻结后，对每个候选仅拟合其显式声明的场（不补项），并通过双向跨激励传递误差评分，时间序列按40%/20%/20%/20%划分为拟合/开发/评分/密封四段；(3) 两阶段科学智能体——阶段I做数据理解并形成至少3个不同候选，阶段II采用全局独立构造与局部受控修订双通道搜索，由LLM（deepseek-v4-flash，温度0.7）驱动。
AI.result: 在5个二维受控系统（地下水流动、变扩散、反应扩散、对流扩散、正交扩散）中，施加5%相对高斯状态噪声，智能体全部恢复生成算子（含符号场与乘积律参数化等价形式）。9个未知二维系数场恢复的Pearson相关系数中位数≈0.85，相对L2误差中位数≈0.28。密封审计段（最后20%时间窗）证明最终定律未过拟合搜索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 智能体引导的组合式假设精化可以在不预先规定系数场解析形式的前提下恢复异质介质的控制律；HEI的双向跨激励传递提供了"共享机制 vs. 过拟合单条轨迹"的结构证据；评估发现最终定律的选取依赖于结构相干性而不仅是数值排名，扩展了从有限维符号形式到非参数空间异质性结构化方程的发现能力。

title: Class-Based Heuristic Selection for Solving the Flying Block Puzzle
summary: Heuristic search underlies planning in autonomous systems ranging from warehouse logistics to robotic navigation, yet generic heuristics fail to exploit the structural constraints that govern constrained spatial domains, causing search performance to degrade catastrophically on harder instances. We study this problem through the two-column Flying Block Puzzle, a rigorously NP-complete spatial planning microworld whose bottleneck geometry mirrors clearance-to-size constraints encountered in multi-agent path finding, autonomous vehicle navigation, and block relocation systems. We introduce the Class-Based Heuristic A* (CBHA*) algorithm, which integrates a General Move Constraint to capture minimum displacement costs when vacant units are scarce, a formal kinematic taxonomy partitioning the state space into seven mutually exclusive classes with provably admissible heuristics based on vacancy ratio and goal-piece geometry, and a class-conditional tie-breaking mechanism that dynamically switches between depth-priority and vertical-distance ordering to overcome f-value plateaus. Over 146 benchmark instances, CBHA* achieves a 93.4% success rate against 64% for Depth-Prioritized A*, 39% for Standard A*, and 17% for BFS, while reducing node expansions by 87.98% relative to Standard A* and sustaining an average effective branching factor of approximately 3, demonstrating that class-triggered adaptive heuristics constitute a principled mechanism for efficient spatial planning that generalizes structurally to physical constraint systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对两列Flying Block Puzzle（NP完全空间规划问题）提出CBHA*算法，通过运动学分类将状态空间划分为七个互斥类别，并为每类设计可采纳且一致的启发式函数及类条件平局打破策略。实验在146个基准实例上显著优于BFS、标准A*和深度优先A*，成功率达93.4%。
AI.motivation: 通用启发式（如基于目标占用的估计）在受限空间域中面临性能灾难性退化问题，无法利用问题的结构约束。Flying Block Puzzle作为NP完全空间规划微世界，其瓶颈几何反映了多智能体路径搜索、自动驾驶、仓储物流等领域的间隙-尺寸约束，因此需要专门设计的启发式来应对f值平台期和深度探索效率低下的问题。
AI.method: 方法核心是Class-Based Heuristic A* (CBHA*)，包含四大组件：(1) 通用移动约束定理（General Move Constraint），推导最小位移成本；(2) 基于线性对称性的运动学分类法，将状态空间按空位比k/n和目标块几何划分为七个互斥类别（A-G）；(3) 为每类设计可采纳且一致（proven）的启发式函数（如Class B的h_B = ⌈d/k⌉ + Σ⌈g_p/k⌉，Class C的h_C = 2(d_v+R+F)-M）；(4) 类条件平局打破机制（A-E用深度优先，F-G用垂直距离优先）。所有启发式均通过形式化案例分析证明一致性。
AI.result: 在146个基准实例（涵盖全部七个类别）上，CBHA*成功率达93.4%，显著优于深度优先A*的64%、标准A*的39%和BFS的17%。节点扩展数较标准A*减少87.98%，平均有效分支因子（EBF）约为3，仅为标准A*的1/7、BFS的1/26。Class G是唯一DPA*反超CBHA*的类别（小垂直距离下h_G≈0导致启发式信息量不足）。极端复杂配置（如大型障碍块需协同滑动的场景）仍超出所有算法可达范围。
AI.conclusion: CBHA*通过类触发自适应启发式和类条件平局打破，在NP完全空间规划问题上实现了原则性且高效的搜索，证明了将启发式选择与状态空间运动学结构耦合的有效性。该框架可推广至具有类似间隙-尺寸约束的物理系统（如Sokoban、窄廊道MAPF、仓储机器人），但其优势以牺牲算法通用性为代价——分类法和启发式设计需要领域专家投入，且目前仅限于两列框架，向更宽帧或不规则域扩展需重新推导分类。自动化分类推导与启发式设计（通过机器学习或元学习）是未来重要方向。

title: Benchmarking General Mobile Assistants in Challenging Real-World Scenarios
summary: Graphical user interfaces have emerged as an important environment for evaluating autonomous AI agents on multimodal interactive tasks. Existing benchmarks such as AndroidWorld and MobileWorld provide strong foundations for mobile agent evaluation, but their application coverage and task design do not yet fully capture the diversity and complexity of realistic mobile use. We present GMA, a benchmark for evaluating general mobile assistants in challenging real-world scenarios. GMA introduces seven applications based on open-source projects, spanning domains such as lifestyle sharing and travel planning, and 300 tasks across four difficulty tiers, from atomic actions to complex multi-step workflows. We evaluate eight frontier models and find that performance declines substantially as task complexity increases, with current agents remaining far from reliably handling realistic user requirements. We further conduct controlled ablation studies of agent harness choices, including context retention and explicit state tracking, under a shared environment, model setting, and task taxonomy. Results show that appropriate harness design can meaningfully improve performance, particularly on demanding workflows, while the effectiveness of specific designs can vary across foundation models. Overall, GMA complements existing benchmarks by expanding application coverage and task complexity, providing a challenging testbed for evaluating mobile agents and studying how harness design supports reliable execution in complex mobile workflows.

AI.tldr: GMA是一个面向移动助手评估的基准，包含7个自研应用和300个分四级难度的任务，评估了8个前沿模型，并通过控制变量消融实验研究了上下文保留与显式状态追踪等智能体框架设计对性能的影响，发现任务复杂度提升时性能显著下降，且框架设计对不同模型的效果存在差异。
AI.motivation: 现有移动智能体基准（如 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld）在应用覆盖广度和任务复杂度上不足以充分反映真实移动使用的多样性与复杂性，需要构建更具挑战性的测试平台来评估模型能力并研究智能体框架设计的作用。
AI.method: 基于7个开源项目自研7款Android应用（覆盖即时通讯、音乐、生活分享、本地发现、外卖、电商、旅行规划），构建300个任务分为Atomic、Compositional、Cross-Application、Realistic四级难度；采用统一资源抽象框架、可组合状态验证与确定性文本验证；评估8个前沿模型；在共享环境下对上下文保留（截图数量、思维链保留、旧截图转Caption）和显式状态追踪（Free-form vs Structured）进行控制变量消融实验。
AI.result: Qwen3.8-Max整体最优（Success 67.33%, Average 80.35），但所有模型在Realistic任务上Success率均≤20%；增加保留截图与思维链可提升性能但边际递减，旧截图转Caption在Realistic任务上提升显著（11.00→34.60）；显式状态追踪在视觉上下文有限时收益最大，且对Realistic任务始终有增益；Structured 设计对 Qwen3.7-Plus 有利，Free-form 设计则更适用于 GPT-5.6 Sol，表明框架机制不可跨模型普适迁移。
AI.conclusion: GMA通过扩展应用生态广度与任务复杂度，暴露了当前移动智能体在跨应用与现实工作流上的根本局限；研究证实性能不仅取决于基础模型，还取决于智能体框架如何管理历史上下文与执行状态，且框架设计需根据底层模型特性定制而非一刀切。

title: Effectiveness of IoT and Deep Learning for Detection and Severity Assessment of Postelectrotermes militaris in Tea Plantations
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in The Journal of Agricultural Sciences, Sri Lanka
summary: Tea plantations are vulnerable to Postelectrotermes militaris, commonly known as the Upcountry Live Wood Termite (ULWT), which can cause substantial damage when infestations remain undetected. This study proposes an IoT-enabled acoustic monitoring framework integrated with deep learning for early detection and severity assessment of ULWT infestations in tea plantations. Research Method: Audio signals were captured non-invasively from tea trunks using a high-sensitivity microphone connected to a Raspberry Pi-based IoT device, with geographic coordinates recorded for spatial tracking. After trimming, resampling, and segmentation, 2,000 ten-second samples were obtained, comprising 1,000 healthy and 1,000 infested samples, and divided into 1,600 training, 200 validation, and 200 test samples. The dataset used in this study is publicly available on Kaggle (Senevirathna et al. 2026). Fourier-derived spectrograms trained a CNN for infestation classification and probability estimation. A weighted severity model combined CNN probability, mean acoustic amplitude, and nearby infested plants within 5 m, with geospatial mapping used to visualize infestation distribution. Findings and Values: Field trials in a ULWT-affected tea plantation in Pundaluoya demonstrated feasibility under realistic environmental noise. On the held-out test set, the CNN achieved 81.5% accuracy, 80.6% precision, 83.0% recall, 81.8% F1-score, and 0.819 ROC-AUC. Beyond binary infestation detection, the framework introduced quantitative severity assessment using infestation probability, acoustic amplitude, and nearby infested plants. The resulting severity and geospatial outputs can support plantation managers in identifying high-risk areas, prioritizing field inspections, and implementing more timely and targeted control measures.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种集成物联网（IoT）与深度学习的声学监测框架，用于茶园中Upcountry Live Wood Termite (ULWT)的早期检测与危害程度评估。通过Raspberry Pi麦克风采集茶树干粗部的声学信号，利用傅里叶变换生成的频谱图训练CNN分类器，并在Pundaluoya茶园进行实地验证。CNN测试集准确率达81.5%（AUC=0.819），同时构建了结合CNN概率、声学振幅与5米范围内邻近感染植株数量的加权危害程度评分模型，并配合地理空间可视化辅助管理决策。
AI.motivation: ULWT（Postelectrotermes militaris）是斯里兰卡高地茶园的主要害虫，其在茶树内部蛀蚀心材，早期冠层无明显可见症状，导致现有依赖目视检查和管理焚烧的方法存在检测延迟、劳动密集、且无法评估空间扩散等问题。视觉检测方法因ULWT的隐蔽性而失效，而现有声学检测多限于受控环境，缺乏严重程度评估与空间映射能力。
AI.method: （1）数据采集：在Pundaluoya约3.5公顷茶园10个样地中，使用Raspberry Pi 3连接高灵敏度麦克风直接接触树干采集声学信号，对40株茶树（20健康+20感染）各采集10条50秒录音；（2）预处理：去除首尾各5秒，重采样至统一采样率，按原始录音划分数据集后在各子集内进行时间分段，得到每类800个10秒片段（训练640/验证80/测试80）；（3）分类模型：采用两层卷积CNN（32和64个3×3滤波器，ReLU激活，2×2最大池化），输入64×64×1傅里叶频谱图，Adam优化器（lr=0.001）训练50个epoch，sigmoid输出二分类概率；（4）严重程度模型：S=(0.2×A×10)+(0.3×P×100)+(0.5×N×10)，分别加权平均振幅A、CNN预测概率P和5米范围内邻近感染植株数N，并以此映射分布半径D=S×0.05（米）；（5）地理可视化：记录GPS坐标进行空间制图。
AI.result: CNN在独立测试集上达到81.5%准确率、80.6%精确率、83.0%召回率、81.8% F1分数和0.819 AUC；混淆矩阵显示83个感染样本和80个健康样本被正确分类，20个健康被误判为感染（假阳性），17个感染被误判为健康（假阴性）；训练准确率最终约95%，验证准确率稳定在约81%，存在一定过拟合；研究表明基于频谱图的CNN在田间噪声环境下具备区分ULWT感染与非感染声学信号的能力，但绝对准确率低于多数受控条件下的文献报道（94–98.91%）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在田间自然条件下基于声学信号与深度学习对ULWT隐蔽感染进行非破坏性检测的可行性，其核心贡献在于将声学采集、CNN分类、危害程度量化与地理空间可视化集成于统一的AI–IoT监测框架内，可作为茶园管理者的筛查与决策支持工具。主要局限包括独立植株与录音事件数量有限、未记录环境变量、仅采用单一数据集划分，以及严重程度权重为启发式定义且未经独立验证。未来工作需扩大数据集规模、评估其他深度学习架构并进一步验证严重程度模型。

title: Context Localization for Generalized Level-Based Evaluation in Knowledge-Based Systems
comment: Author preprint of the article published in Knowledge-Based Systems (2026)
summary: We study context localization for generalized level-based evaluation in knowledge-based systems. The framework models situations where a structured nonnegative score, defined on facts, rules, cases, criteria or evidence units, is evaluated through conditional aggregation tests on admissible knowledge contexts. The generalized level measure maximizes a monotone set function over all contexts whose aggregated support reaches a prescribed level. We characterize when filtering the score by a context $B$ is equivalent to localizing the admissible contexts by intersection with $B$. The main theorem shows that this consistency holds for all monotone set functions if and only if two structural conditions are satisfied: monotonicity with respect to contexts and a reduction property excluding positive localized support outside $B$. We analyze pointwise and block-generated mechanisms producing the reduction property, extend the result to parameterized systems, and interpret it as a stability criterion for context-dependent evidence selection, non-additive support evaluation and level-based knowledge aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究知识系统中基于广义水平测度的上下文局部化问题，刻画了"先过滤评分"与"后局部化可接受上下文"这两种操作等价的充要条件。
AI.motivation: 在知识系统中，结构化评分（事实、规则、案例等的得分）需要通过可接受知识上下文上的条件聚合算子进行评估。给定一个局部化集合 B，存在两种自然的处理方式：先对评分在 B 外置零（过滤评分），或在原始系统评估后再对可接受集合与 B 取交（局部化上下文）。对于非线性条件聚合规则，这两种方式不一定等价，需要精确刻画其等价条件。
AI.method: 引入广义水平测度 Λ(f,u) = sup{μ(E) : A(f|E)|E ∈ ℰ} 及其局部化版本 Λ(f,u;B) = sup{μ(E∩B) : A(f|E)|E ∈ ℰ}。核心证明围绕两个结构性条件：(1) 关于集合的单调性——扩大条件集合不会增大局部评估值；(2) 归约性质——掩码化后的评分在 B 外的集合上不能产生正值。通过构造专门的单调测度（如 μ_B 和 μ_C）进行反证法证明。
AI.result: 主要定理：对交集稳定的可接受集合族 ℰ 上的条件聚合算子族（FCA），局部化恒等式 Λ(f𝟙_B, u) = Λ(f,u;B) 对所有单调测度成立，当且仅当 FCA 同时满足关于集合的单调性和归约性质。分析了点式零化子、块生成结构、点分离集合族、几乎处处版本等多种产生归约性质的机制。参数化版本将参数 t 和水平 u 分离，得出二变量广义水平曲面。给出了在上下文相关知识评估、随机过程解释（本质下确界、信息原子条件均值）、Choquet–Stieltjes 型积分泛函等方面的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该定理为基于广义水平的知识评估提供了结构性稳定准则：预过滤知识库与后过滤证据上下文产生相同的评估结果，条件是同时满足关于集合的单调性和归约性质。点式零化子是归约性质的充分条件但非必要；块生成机制和点分离结构分别展示了不同的产生路径。参数化框架自然适用于上下文相关决策、随机过程的时间演化以及非可加积分泛函的一致性分析。

title: CareGraph: An Auditable Hybrid AI Framework for Evidence-Grounded Personalized Longitudinal Health Intelligence
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, Code and data: this https URL
summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming personalized healthcare, yet fragmented clinical, self reported, and wearable evidence remains difficult to interpret and trace. We present CareGraph, an auditable hybrid AI framework that converts heterogeneous records into prioritized trends, missing context indicators, bounded next steps, discussion questions, and provenance linked explanations. CareGraph organizes evidence without diagnosing, predicting outcomes, selecting treatment, or making autonomous clinical decisions. Its pipeline covers deterministic analysis, context detection, graph construction, constrained language model synthesis, evidence validation, safety controls, and release gating. Tests used synthetic cohorts of 400 patients each for development, validation, and holdout. On holdout data, a frozen ordinary least squares trend rule with a sufficiency gate achieved 0.827 accuracy, 0.837 macro F1 with a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.819 to 0.854, and 0.974 insufficient data F1. Missing context detection achieved 0.815 strict micro F1 versus 0.318 for the legacy detector. On an authored holdout benchmark, safety ruleset version 1.2 achieved 1.000 precision, 0.950 recall, and 0.974 F1. An audit requiring graph retrieval across 80 patients yielded 79 syntheses and 78 presentations without fallback; one output was blocked and one failed closed because of an invalid evidence key. Against monolithic GPT 5.6 on 56 matched patients, CareGraph was faster at 40.15 versus 49.62 seconds, shorter at 661 versus 1,163 words, and showed better exploratory lexical alignment with longitudinal targets; the baseline used fewer tokens and cited more raw evidence. Graph auditing verified provenance and deterministic retrieval; incremental graph effects on generation require paired evaluation. CareGraph offers a safety bounded foundation for intelligent personalized health systems.

AI.tldr: CareGraph是一个可审计的混合AI框架，旨在将来自EHR、实验室、可穿戴设备等多源异构纵向健康数据整合为有证据追溯的个性化健康情报。它通过确定性分析、缺失上下文检测、知识图谱构建、受约束的LLM合成、安全验证和发布门控等模块，在合成数据上验证了趋势分类、缺失上下文检测、安全规则和图谱溯源等核心组件的可行性。
AI.motivation: 纵向健康信息分散在实验室门户、EHR、用药记录、症状、生命体征、可穿戴设备等多个来源中,碎片化是核心系统问题而非数据可用性问题。现有LLM虽具备医学问答能力,但其流畅性可能掩盖无依据主张、遗漏和过度自信的建议。论文旨在构建一个系统化、可审计的架构,将证据计算、图谱溯源、受限生成与发布治理分离,以解决"黑箱式"生成式系统在个性化健康情报中的可靠性与可追溯性问题。
AI.method: CareGraph采用分层架构:(1)数据适配器将异构源标准化为统一患者状态;(2)确定性代理计算充分性门控(≥3测量、≥365天跨度等)、OLS趋势分类和缺失上下文检测;(3)构建患者范围的类型化知识图谱,保留源行溯源;(4)授权证据注册表Kp约束LLM生成;(5)安全规则集v1.2检测显式/隐式诊断、用药调整等违规;(6)发布门控(模式有效、患者匹配、键有效、证据完整、安全可呈现、产物完整)执行"故障关闭"。评估使用独立种子的合成队列(各400患者)、作者编写的安全基准(39例)、400患者图谱审计、80患者操作审计和56患者与单体GPT-5.6的配对比较。
AI.result: 在独立保留测试集(1700标签)上,冻结的OLS趋势规则实现准确率0.827、宏F1 0.837(95% CI 0.819–0.854)、数据不足F1 0.974;缺失上下文检测严格微F1从遗留检测器的0.318提升至0.815(配对差0.452,p=5.89×10⁻�¹);安全规则v1.2在39例保留基准上达到精确率1.000、召回率0.950、F1 0.974;400患者图谱审计验证源行可恢复性1.000、孤立边率0.000、溯源完整率0.979;80患者批处理中79例完成合成、78例完成呈现(无回退)、1例被阻止、1例因无效证据键故障关闭;56例配对比较中CareGraph生成更快(40.15 vs 49.62秒)、更短(661 vs 1163词),但在纵向目标词汇对齐上更优(趋势提及率93.9% vs 53.7%),而单体基线使用更少总token且引用更多原始证据。
AI.conclusion: CareGraph建立了面向个性化健康情报系统的可扩展混合AI骨干架构。合成评估表明,确定性证据计算加证据键控生成加故障关闭发布治理的模块化设计,在受控环境中能产出比单体LLM更聚焦、更可追溯的纵向健康情报。其核心优势在于纪律性分解:患者特异性证据先于语言生成、每个发现/行动必须引用授权键、无效或不可呈现输出故障关闭。论文明确指出这并非诊断、预后、治疗推荐或自主临床决策系统,而是健康信息组织和医患讨论准备的工程框架。当前局限性包括合成数据耦合、安全基准规模小(仅88例无独立专家标注)、图谱增量贡献尚未通过配对评估证实、临床相关性需独立医师评审。

title: Thinking Costs Tokens: When More Structure is Worth the Price
summary: Adding inference structure to a language model lets it search, verify, and revise, but these actions consume the very budget they are supposed to use well. In this paper, we investigate whether there exists a token-budget threshold, below which the overhead of planning and verification hurts performance and above which it helps. We evaluate two systems on FinQA and TAT-QA financial reasoning tasks, using GPT-5.4 mini across 14 budget tiers ranging from 250 to 42,000 output-equivalent tokens. The first system is a monolith, which is a single LLM call. The second is a verified search architecture that adds planning, label-blind checking, and repair capabilities. We run 1,000 cases for a total of 28,000 completed cells. Both systems score 0% at the two lowest tiers, where neither can fit a complete prompt. At 1,000 tokens, the monolith reaches 18% accuracy while verified search scores near 0%, since the planning overhead leaves no room for an answer. From 1,500 tokens onward, verified search surpasses the monolith and maintains a consistent advantage, reaching approximately 44% at the highest tiers while the monolith reaches approximately 40%. The crossover occurs between 1,000 and 1,500 output-equivalent tokens, confirmed by a strict intersection-union test ($p \le 0.001$ at both endpoints).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型推理结构（规划、验证、修复）的额外开销何时能被更高的准确性所抵消。通过在 FinQA 和 TAT-QA 两个金融推理任务上，使用 GPT-5.4 mini 在 14 个预算层级（250 到 42,000 输出等价 tokens）下对比单次调用（monolith）和带验证的搜索架构（verified search），发现存在一个明确的交叉阈值：约 1,000–1,500 输出等价 tokens 之间。低于此阈值，单次调用更优；高于此阈值，verified search 持续领先。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型系统越来越多地采用测试时机制（规划、检索、验证、修复），这些机制虽然可能提升回答质量，但同时消耗 tokens。先前工作表明额外推理结构并非普遍有益，而是条件性有益。本文旨在回答：额外的推理结构是否只在超过某个 token 预算阈值时才值得付出其开销？这一预算阈值是否存在？
AI.method: 设计受控实验，包含两个自变量：推理架构（monolith vs. verified search）和 token 预算层级（14 档，从 250 到 42,000 输出等价 tokens）。因变量为回答正确率。使用 GPT-5.4 mini，在 FinQA 和 TAT-QA 上选取 1,000 个平衡样本（各 500），每个样本在两个系统的 14 个预算下运行，共 28,000 个实验单元。Monolith 仅做单次检索和单次回答调用；verified search 增加强制规划器、标签盲检查器和修复机制。采用"输出等价 tokens"作为预算单位以反映真实成本。使用交叉-并集检验（intersection-union test）确认交叉点。
AI.result: 在最低两档（t250, t500）两个系统均得 0%，因提示词都无法完整容纳。在 t1000，monolith 达到 18% 而 verified search 仅约 0.1%，因其预算被强制规划调用耗尽。在 t1500，verified search 首次反超 monolith（24% vs. 20.6%）。从 t1500 起 verified search 在每一档都保持优势，最终在 t42000 分别达到约 44% 和 40%。交叉点位于 1,000–1,500 输出等价 tokens 之间，由严格的交叉-并集检验确认（两端 p ≤ 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 额外的推理结构是条件性有益的：只有在 token 预算足以容纳其完整机制时（约 1,500 输出等价 tokens 以上），verified search 的规划、检索和验证机制才能发挥效用；低于此阈值则不应使用。架构选择应根据可用 token 预算进行条件性选择——在 1,500 tokens 时有用的系统在 1,000 tokens 时可能完全失效。验证搜索的优势不是一次性收益，而是随可用预算持续累积。

title: WM-R1: Training GUI Agents to Reason and leverage World Models with Reinforcement Learning
summary: GUI agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) have showcased strong environment learning capabilities on mobile platforms. However, RL typically demands extensive real-environment interactions, leading to high resource costs and instability, especially in GUI scenarios. To address these, we propose WM-R1, the first reinforcement learning framework that trains mobile GUI agents with world models instead of real environments. Specifically, world models serve as the source of state transitions during all rollouts, replacing the real Android environment within the training loop. WM-R1 also embeds world models directly into the thinking process, enabling agents to reason about the consequences of candidate actions before committing to the final action. Crucially, WM-R1 eliminates the need for real-environment interaction, supports massively parallelized and step-level granularized trajectory generation grounded in world models, and introduces a multi-dimensional rule-based reward that jointly optimizes task success, trajectory efficiency, and world model utilization. For efficient training, we curate a high-quality dataset of 2000 challenging tasks. Experiments on Android mobile benchmarks demonstrate that WM-R1-trained agents significantly outperform GRPO-only baselines and inference-time simulation methods. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: WM-R1是首个完全在基于世界模型模拟环境中训练移动端GUI智能体的强化学习框架。它使用Code2World-8B作为冻结的世界模型替代真实Android环境进行状态转移，通过GRPO算法进行训练，并将`<call_wm>`机制嵌入智能体的思维链中使其能推理候选动作的后果。实验在AndroidWorld、GUI-Odyssey、ScreenSpot-Pro/V2和AndroidControl等基准上均显著优于GRPO基线和推理时增强方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的GUI智能体强化学习方法都需要大量真实环境交互，带来三大瓶颈：(1)计算成本高昂（环境交互比模型推理慢几个数量级）；(2)不可逆性（单个错误动作可使长程轨迹偏离）；(3)环境噪声（不确定性转移会污染奖励信号）。同时，现有的世界模型方法仅在推理时使用，不改变RL训练循环。该工作旨在首次将世界模型作为训练环境本身。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1)以Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B为策略模型，Code2World-8B为冻结世界模型，生成可渲染HTML并通过无头浏览器渲染为1080×2400截图；(2)在思维链中嵌入`<call_wm>`机制，允许智能体在推理流内部调用世界模型预览候选动作后果，实现"先思后行"的自校正循环；(3)设计多维复合奖励：成功奖励R_success（LLM评判，权重α=1.0）+长度奖励R_L（DAST式预算惩罚，权重β=0.5）+世界模型调用奖励R_WM（调控调用频度，权重γ=0.1）。训练数据从AndroidCode、GUI-Odyssey、GUI-R1中筛选2000个中等难度任务，使用Ray分布式调度、FSDP训练、vLLM推理。
AI.result: WM-R1-7B在AndroidWorld达到39.8%成功率，比UI-R1-7B(30.8%)高+9.0分，比UI-TARS 1.5-7B(34.2%)高+5.6分；在GUI-Odyssey达31.6%，超UI-R1-7B(21.5%)+10.1分。OOD平均提升+16.0分，是UI-R1(+8.7)的1.84倍。3B规模同样全面领先。消融实验显示思维链贡献最大（-5.2分），R_L贡献+3.3分，R_WM贡献+2.6分。训练动态显示WM调用从~4.2次降至~1.8次/轨迹，呈现探索-校准-选择性利用三阶段。参数敏感性分析证实默认配置稳健。Qwen3-VL系列上的额外实验验证了架构无关性（WM-R1-8B达44.5/35.8）。计算成本：单卡H200上训练11.2小时，无需真实环境。
AI.conclusion: WM-R1证明了世界模型模拟环境作为训练环境本身的可行性和有效性，实现了大规模并行、零真实环境交互的GUI智能体训练。其关键贡献在于将世界模型嵌入到思维链推理流中而非仅作为推理时辅助，使智能体学会的是"如何与世界模型协作推理"的通用策略而非记忆特定UI模式的动作映射，这带来了更强的分布外泛化能力。该范式降低了训练成本和能耗，具有推动可访问性自动化和工作流自动化的应用潜力，同时增强了智能体决策的可解释性和可复现性。

title: SETU: An Agentic Ecosystem for Multilingual, Persona-Aware Communication Coaching
summary: Corporate training teams need scalable and explainable tools to improve workforce communication in multilingual settings. Existing systems often score text, audio, or video in isolation, or produce black-box outputs that are difficult to audit for coaching use. This paper presents SETU, an agentic ecosystem for corporate communication coaching aimed at recruiters, frontline sales professionals and training units who prepare for audience specific conversations. SETU is designed for two scoped scenarios: (i) recruiter-candidate eligibility-and-interest calls with persona context and (ii) sales pitches with target-audience adaptation; owing to limited evaluation resources, this paper reports results on scenario (ii) only. The ecosystem decomposes analysis into specialized video, audio-speech, text-relevance, scoring, notification and reporting agents coordinated through trust-aware orchestration. It generates modality-attributed coaching reports for formative training, with human reviewers retaining final judgment. The name SETU (bridge in several Indic languages) reflects the goal of bridging communication gaps across regional languages and audience expectations.

AI.tldr: SETU是一个面向企业沟通培训的智能体生态系统，专为多语言、角色感知场景设计。它将分析任务拆解为视频、音频、文本相关性、评分、通知和报告等专门化智能体，通过信任加权编排协同工作，生成可归因于各模态的指导报告。论文仅在销售 pitch 场景上进行了18个样本的试点评估，相比单模态基线在评分一致性和教练效率上有所提升。
AI.motivation: 现有沟通指导系统往往只对文本、音频或视频单一模态评分，或输出难以审计的黑箱结果，在多语言企业培训场景中缺乏可解释性、可调试性和公平性治理。论文旨在通过模块化的智能体架构解决这些问题。
AI.method: SETU采用双流智能体管道：(1) 同步音视频流由视频智能体(MediaPipe Holistic提取姿态/表情/头部运动)、音频智能体(Sarvam STT做多语言与代码混合转写，Librosa提取声学特征)、文本智能体(LLM按评分标准打分)处理；(2) 相关性智能体结合买家角色与任务提示判断内容匹配度。编排器(LangGraph)基于信任度(Acc+Cons+R加权)对各模态证据进行路由和加权融合，最终输出结构化指导报告，由人类教练最终审核。系统形式化为七元组 M=(A,T,S,E,O,C,Mem)，并给出信任计算公式和编排优化准则。
AI.result: 在18个销售 pitch 视频的试点评估中(英语、印地语、泰卢固语及其代码混合)，SETU与教练评分的Spearman ρ=0.78，可解释性评分4.3/5，语言宏F1=0.86，平均批处理延迟38.6秒/片段。相比文本基线(ρ=0.61)和非智能体多模态基线(ρ=0.69)均更优；教练审阅时间从22分钟降至13分钟(减少40.9%)，达到Fair/Good所需的练习轮次从4.1降至2.6。
AI.conclusion: 多模态智能体分解结合信任加权编排和人类监督，能够为多语言销售 pitch 提供可解释、角色相关的指导；该框架在评分一致性和教练工作量方面优于单模态和非智能体基线。但当前试点规模小(18个样本)、范围限于销售场景，且需在更大规模、专家标注数据集上验证，并开展跨性别、口音、肤色、残疾和地区语言的公平性审计。

title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator: A Compact Multimodal, Multilingual, and Reasoning Enabled Content Safety Moderator
summary: Safety moderation for deployed AI applications is moving beyond text-only prompts: systems increasingly need to judge images, documents, screenshots, and generated responses under policies that vary across domains. Existing guardrails usually cover only part of this setting, making it difficult to combine broad coverage, custom policy control, and low compute cost. We present Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator, also referred to as Nemotron 3.5 CS in this paper for brevity, a compact 4B vision-language safety moderator that jointly classifies user prompts, images, and assistant responses across 12 languages. Nemotron 3.5 CS returns safety labels for latency-sensitive moderation and can additionally produce concise reasoning traces that apply supplied custom policies and identify violated categories when reasoning is requested. We also release a multimodal and multilingual safety dataset for guard training, spanning human-labeled real-image moderation, benign vision-language and document tasks, synthetic rare-risk and jailbreak cases, and custom-policy examples. Across evaluations spanning multimodal safety, text moderation, multilingual robustness, custom-policy following, benign false positives, and latency, Nemotron 3.5 CS demonstrates a practical coverage tradeoff: it adds image-conditioned and policy-conditioned moderation while remaining broadly competitive with specialized guard models. These results suggest that compact vision-language moderators can serve as deployable front-line safety components, with reasoning used selectively for audit and policy review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator (CS)，一个紧凑型 4B 视觉语言安全审核模型，可在 12 种语言下联合分类用户提示、图像和助手响应，支持自定义策略与可选推理模式，用于多模态、多语言、低延迟的部署级内容安全审核。
AI.motivation: 现有安全审核系统存在三个不足：仅覆盖文本输入（无法处理图像与视觉上下文）、以英语为中心（在多语言部署中存在显著缺口）、依赖固定分类法（难以适应应用域自定义策略）。同时，图像条件攻击和过度拒绝问题表明，需要一个支持多模态、多语言、策略条件判定且低延迟的统一审核器。
AI.method: 基于 Gemma 3-4B 基模型，通过 LoRA (rank=8, alpha=32) 在 H100 GPU 上进行监督微调 (5 个 epoch, lr=1e-4, bfloat16)。输入接口支持三部分：用户输入 (文本+可选图像)、助手响应、自定义策略。安全分类法基于 AEGIS 2.0，新增"经济伤害"细类。推理支持两种模式：直接分类模式 (输出 safe/unsafe 标签+违反类别) 与推理模式 (输出思维链+违规类别)，通过 /think、/no_think、/categories、/no_categories 四个 token 切换。训练数据混合六类来源：人工标注多模态数据、Nemotron Safety Guard Dataset v3、Nemotron VLM Dataset v2、CantTalkAboutThis 主题跟随数据、合成数据生成 (SDG)，并采用八阶段 SDG 流程 (种子收集→合成生成→调整→多样化→过滤→图像生成→响应生成→三 VLM 陪审团+人工审核标注)。
AI.result: 在六维能力评估中：(1) 多模态安全：VLGuard 与 MM-SafetyBench 提示侧平均 unsafe-F1 为 0.81，较 Gemma 3-4B 基线 (0.68) 提升 +0.13，显著优于 LG4、LG3-V、Omni；(2) 文本安全：在 Aegis 2.0、XSTest、WildGuard 上略低于 Qwen3Guard (F1 差 -0.03 至 -0.04)；(3) 多语言安全：12 种训练语言内表现稳定，对越南语和俄语 (训练集外) 也保持鲁棒，PolyGuard/Aegis Adapted 响应侧 F1 为 0.847，高于 Qwen3Guard (0.817)；(4) 自定义策略：DynaGuardrail 与 CoSA 上 F1 为 0.85，与最佳基线持平或略优；(5) 良性多模态误报：MMMU/AI2D 上 FPR 仅 0.030/0.001，DocVQA 略高 (0.060)；(6) 延迟：RTVLM 图文输入下 TTFT/E2E 为 60/76 ms，优于 LG4 的 99/118 ms。总体展示了"覆盖广度优于单一维度深度"的实用权衡。
AI.conclusion: Nemotron 3.5 CS 表明，紧凑型 (4B) 视觉语言模型可在单一模型中联合支持图像条件、策略条件、12 种语言的内容审核，同时在专业文本审核上保持竞争力；推理模式应选择性用于审计而非默认高吞吐路径。模型权重、训练数据与 SDG 流水线将开源发布以推动多模态安全审核研究。

title: LongGuard: Mechanistic Analysis and Training-Free Mitigation of Long-Context Failure in Safety Guardrails
summary: Safety guardrails serve as the last line of defense against harmful inputs and outputs of large language models (LLMs), yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on short text. We present LongGuard, a framework that evaluates, mechanistically analyzes, and mitigates long-context guardrail failure. We formulate the task as Safety Needle-in-a-Haystack (SafetyNIAH) over a 0.25k-32k length grid; across 15 mainstream guardrails, unsafe recall drops monotonically by more than 50% on average, and a paired Benign-Fill vs. Needle-Repeat design attributes the failure to proportional dilution of the unsafe needle rather than to absolute length. A three-layer attention-logit-behavior analysis on six guardrails locates the mechanism: attention mass on the unsafe needle is diluted, the unsafe-over-safe logit margin is compressed in lockstep, and the detection decision collapses accordingly, with this attention->logit->behavior chain remaining consistent after partialling out length. We further isolate a sparse set of guard-specialized retrieval heads that exhibit partial specificity relative to their base models. Building on the analysis, we propose two training-free mitigations - Chunked Detection (CD) and Attention-Head Sharpening (AHS) - and a deployment protocol, Context-Aware Hyperparameter Routing (CAHR), that selects configurations by context length and audit side. Across five benchmarks spanning synthetic data, long-context attacks, and reasoning-model outputs, CAHR-CD and CAHR-AHS improve the six-guardrail average by 22% and 13%, respectively. Code and data are available online.

AI.tldr: LongGuard 系统性地研究并缓解了安全护栏（safety guardrails）在长上下文场景下的失效问题。研究构建了 SafetyNIAH 评测基准（覆盖 0.25k–32k 长度），发现 15 个主流护栏的 unsafe recall 平均下降超 50%，根因是"针-海比例稀释"而非绝对长度；通过注意力-Logit-行为三层机制分析定位到稀疏的 guard-specialized retrieval heads；并提出 Chunked Detection (CD)、Attention-Head Sharpening (AHS) 两种免训练缓解方法，配合 Context-Aware Hyperparameter Routing (CAHR) 部署协议，在五个长上下文基准上平均提升 22% 和 13%。
AI.motivation: 当前安全护栏几乎只在短文本上训练和评估，但实际部署场景中（如 Many-shot Jailbreaking、NINJA Attack、长推理模型输出）需要处理越来越长的输入/输出序列。护栏能否在长上下文下继续充当 LLM 安全最后防线尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1) 提出 SafetyNIAH 任务与基准，将短标注样本（needle）嵌入中性长上下文（haystack），通过 Benign-Fill/Needle-Repeat 配对设计分离比例稀释与绝对长度效应；2) 在 15 个护栏上评估，在 6 个全注意力护栏上做 attention-logit-behavior 三层机制分析，定位 guard-specialized retrieval heads；3) 基于分析提出训练免费的 CD（分块检测，提升局部 needle 占比）和 AHS（在检索头上做 softmax 温度锐化），并设计按上下文长度与审计侧动态选择超参的 CAHR 路由协议。
AI.result: 在 SafetyNIAH 上，15 个护栏 unsafe recall 平均下降 50.12%，safe recall 仅下降 1.30%（非对称退化）；Benign-Fill vs Needle-Repeat 表明稀释是主导因素。机制分析显示 needle 注意力下降 3.0–5.1×、unsafe-over-safe logit margin 被压缩，三层偏相关 +0.56 至 +0.83（p<10⁻⁴）。Base-guard 控制实验显示检索头具有"部分特异性"（ρ≥0.74，guard top-5% 占比高出 base 7.9–19.9%）。在 5 个基准上，CAHR-CD 和 CAHR-AHS 六护栏平均提升 +21.79% 和 +12.56%；对话、代码、中文填充域上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文护栏失效的根本机制是"比例稀释"——不安全证据在长上下文中被稀释，而非绝对长度所致。Guard fine-tuning 不创造新检索路径，而是放大了已有 retrieval heads 的强度。免训练方法 CD（高收益高代价）和 AHS（低代价低收益）通过 CAHR 路由协议可在不同部署预算下稳定恢复长上下文检测能力，呼吁将上下文长度作为护栏训练与评估的第一类轴。

title: Generative AI Expands the Intellectual Reach of Course Based Undergraduate Research Experiences (CUREs)
summary: Course-based undergraduate research experiences (CUREs) broaden access to authentic scientific inquiry through responsive instructor support as research problems become increasingly complex. Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) may extend this support by providing individualized assistance that can adapt as student needs change. However, how embedding GenAI within a CURE to provide support across the research process impacts student inquiry, collaboration, and scientific reasoning remains unresolved. Here we use longitudinal qualitative data collected across three semesters of a bioinformatics and genomics CURE to show that GenAI expanded the intellectual reach of the research experience in three distinct ways. First, personalized, on-demand scaffolding allowed students to move beyond the boundaries of instructor expertise and transform their own interests into researchable inquiry, with all teams developing distinct self-directed projects rather than selecting instructor-provided topics. Second, GenAI became part of the distributed cognitive system of research teams, helping novice researchers communicate and coordinate across differentiated expertise without eliminating specialization. Third, expanded capability did not replace the need for disciplinary judgment. Students increasingly validated, revised, or rejected AI-generated contributions, such that research independence emerged through retained intellectual responsibility. Together, these findings suggest that GenAI can extend the reach of CUREs by expanding what novice researchers can investigate, how they can collaborate, and the level of responsibility they can assume while preserving human judgment central to authentic scientific inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在课程性本科生科研经历（CURE）中嵌入生成式人工智能（GenAI）对学生探究、协作和科学推理的影响。通过三个学期生物信息学与基因组学CURE的纵向质性数据，发现GenAI通过三种方式拓展了科研体验的智识边界：（1）个性化按需支架帮助学生将兴趣转化为可研究的课题；（2）GenAI成为研究团队的分布式认知系统组成部分；（3）学生需要对AI生成内容进行验证、修正或拒斥，研究独立性源于保留的智识责任。
AI.motivation: 课程性本科生科研经历（CUREs）通过指导教师的支持扩展了本科生接触真实科学探究的机会，但随着研究问题日益复杂，教师支持面临瓶颈。生成式人工智能（GenAI）有望通过提供可适应学生需求的个性化辅助来延伸这一支持，但其在CURE中嵌入后对学生探究、协作与科学推理的具体影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用纵向质性研究方法，在三个学期的生物信息学与基因组学CURE课程中收集数据，分析GenAI作为嵌入式支持工具对学生研究过程的影响。研究聚焦于GenAI如何在研究全过程中提供支持，并考察学生探究、团队协作与科学推理方面的变化。
AI.result: 研究发现GenAI从三个维度拓展了CURE的智识边界：（1）个性化、按需的支架式支持使学生能够突破教师专业知识的局限，将自身兴趣转化为可研究的课题，所有学生团队均自主开发了独特的研究项目，而非选择教师预设的课题；（2）GenAI成为研究团队分布式认知系统的有机组成部分，帮助新手研究者在不消除专业分工的前提下进行跨专长沟通与协作；（3）能力的扩展并未取代对学科判断力的需求——学生越来越多地对AI生成的内容进行验证、修正或拒斥，由此通过保留智识责任实现了研究独立性的发展。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明GenAI能够拓展CURE的边界，扩展新手研究者能够探究的内容、协作的方式以及能够承担的责任层级，同时保留了作为真实科学探究核心的人类判断力。这为在本科教育中整合GenAI以扩展科研机会提供了重要启示，强调了人机协作中保留智识责任的重要性。

title: If Agents Were Angels, No Governance Would Be Necessary: Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement at a Trusted Tool Boundary
summary: Give an agent a human's credential and it inherits the person's reach without the judgment that limits its use. It can sweep every reachable record into model context, where hidden instructions steer its next call, and every request stays credential-valid while the agent exceeds its job or absorbs a secret. Prompts are a brittle guardrail: one fallible reasoner interprets the task and enforces its limits. We present Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement (OBPE), a trusted boundary outside agent reasoning. It authorizes the typed operation and resource, narrows the query before the backend call, then filters records and fields or masks values in the response. Semantic gating can deny or hold an authorized call on argument values or external state. A data policy owner sets the maximum grant; agent policy can only narrow it. We prove, under stated conditions, that the policy plan is order-independent and agent policy cannot widen the ceiling. Field removal covers one execution; masking and history rules claim less. We release an HTTP proxy prototype simplified from our production system, with conformance tests tying its typed Cedar policy core to the model. Against Jira and ServiceNow mocks, our benchmark compares prompted agents with and without OBPE on four models, including 20 adaptive red-team tasks. A trace failure means protected data entered agent context, an exact value appeared in the answer, or a forbidden effect completed. In 3,621 trials it fell from 57.6% to 0.2%, a cluster-weighted reduction of 41.2 points [95% CI: 27.7, 54.9]; fulfillment fell from 79.1% to 60.9%, while paired safe-useful completion rose 21.8 points [9.5, 35.2]. Some answers reconstructed a value that never entered context or used filtered row counts as an oracle: shaping one execution is not noninterference. Write controls, durable approval, and temporal and aggregate policies lie outside this evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了一种名为"带外策略执行"（OBPE）的系统，旨在解决基于LLM的工具调用智能体因继承人类凭据而产生的权限过度问题。OBPE在智能体推理路径之外的受信工具边界上，对工具调用执行授权、请求塑形（窄化查询/参数）和响应塑形（过滤记录/字段、遮蔽值）。该系统采用双层策略架构（数据所有者策略设定上限，智能体策略只能进一步收紧），并通过Cedar策略语言实现。论文证明了在特定条件下策略方案具有顺序无关性和单调性。同时发布了基于生产的HTTP代理原型，并在3,621次试验中针对Jira/ServiceNow模拟器对四种模型进行了评估：启用OBPE后，确定性跟踪失败率从57.6%降至0.2%，而安全有效完成率提升了21.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体被赋予人类凭据以执行任务，它们继承了凭据的访问范围，却缺乏人类使用时所需的判断力。这导致：1）凭据覆盖范围远超任务实际所需；2）返回的数据被注入到模型上下文中，可能包含间接提示注入；3）需要根据参数值或外部状态进行语义门控的调用无法得到处理。模型自身的提示作为防护手段不可靠——同一个不完美的推理器既解读任务又执行限制。需要在工具交换的受信边界进行策略执行，而非依赖模型推理。
AI.method: OBPE在智能体工具客户端与后端之间建立受信网关，执行三阶段处理：1）门控（Gating）：基于类型化的主体、操作、资源进行授权决策，结果可为允许、拒绝或延迟；2）请求塑形（Request Shaping）：在分派前窄化查询、上限记录数、修改类型化写入参数；3）响应塑形（Response Shaping）：在数据进入模型上下文前过滤记录/字段、完全编辑或遮蔽值。策略采用双层模型：数据所有者策略设定最大授权，智能体策略只能收紧不能放宽。使用Cedar作为类型化授权核心，OBPE注解选择塑形操作符。论文形式化证明了策略方案具有排列不变性（顺序无关）和单调性（智能体策略不能扩大所有者上限）。释放了简化的HTTP代理原型，包含一致性测试套件。
AI.result: 在3,621次试验中（涉及四种模型：Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5、GPT-5 mini），针对Jira和ServiceNow模拟器及20个自适应红队任务：1）主要安全指标——确定性跟踪失败率从57.6%（仅提示）降至0.2%（提示+全量OBPE），集群加权减少41.2个百分点[95% CI: 27.7, 54.9]；2）安全有效完成率提升21.8个百分点[9.5, 35.2]（Judge A）和19.1个百分点[6.9, 32.2]（Judge B）；3）独立任务完成率从79.1%降至60.9%（因OBPE阻止了部分不安全请求）；4）红队对抗中，提示组173/231次跟踪失败（74.9%），OBPE组仅2/227次（0.9%）；5）累积操作符消融显示各层防护逐步贡献：记录控制+字段剥离+遮蔽/写入保护+模式遮蔽分别带来渐进改善。失败案例包括：4次从可见信息重建被保护值（虽值未进入上下文），以及1次利用过滤后行数作为预言机的侧信道攻击。
AI.conclusion: OBPE通过在受信工具边界执行策略，成功将LLM智能体的权限风险从"事后补救"转为"事前阻断"，在保持实用性的同时大幅降低数据泄露和未授权操作。然而，论文明确划定了能力边界：OBPE提供的是结构性的单次执行保障（字段移除/完全编辑），而非信息流非干扰性。重建攻击和行数预言机揭示了"塑形一次执行"与"证明无干扰"之间的鸿沟。生产级写入控制、持久化人工审批、时序和聚合策略仍在本评估范围之外。OBPE不能替代正确的所有者上限设计——静态检查能找到错误的规则，但无法判断组织意图的正确性。

title: A Framework for Object-Centric Predictive Monitoring of Collaborative Processes
comment: Submitted to Information Systems, under review
summary: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) of collaborative, inter-organizational processes requires reasoning over multiple interdependent entities, including participants, messages, local executions, and the global collaboration case. Existing approaches extend traditional event logs with collaboration attributes but retain a single-case perspective, leaving much of this structure implicit. Object-centric process mining (OCPM) provides an alternative by representing these entities as first-class objects with explicit relations and multiple notions of case. This study connects collaborative PPM and OCPM through three contributions: (i) a formal semantic mapping from extended collaborative event logs to an OCED-conformant object-centric representation, serialized in OCEL 2.0; (ii) a reformulation of collaborative prediction tasks as object-centric prediction tasks; and (iii) a reproducible converter and prediction pipeline implementing the proposed mapping. We evaluate the framework on four public collaborative event logs and a fifth derived from the BPI Challenge 2013 incident-management log by executing the fourteen reformulated tasks using five predictive strategies across tabular, sequential, and graph-native encodings. We further discuss the benefits, limitations, and threats to the approach's validity. The representation makes collaboration structure explicit and makes it natural to state prediction targets based on object relations that fall outside the case-centric taxonomy, at the cost of increased relational complexity and dependence on object-centric tooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个框架，将协作式业务流程的预测性过程监控（PPM）与以对象为中心的流程挖掘（OCPM）相结合。具体贡献包括：(i) 从扩展协作式事件日志到符合OCED的对象中心表示的形式映射（以OCEL 2.0序列化）；(ii) 将协作预测任务重构为对象中心预测任务；(iii) 可复现的转换器与预测流水线。在五个事件日志上使用五种预测策略进行评估，表明映射和重构在所有日志上都成立。
AI.motivation: 传统的预测性过程监控（PPM）假设单一案例视角，不适合跨组织的协作流程。现有协作式PPM方法通过事件属性扩展日志，但协作结构仍是隐式的。以对象为中心的流程挖掘（OCPM）通过将实体表示为具有显式关系的一类对象来解决此问题。然而，协作式PPM和对象中心PPM之间的关系尚未深入研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，连接这两种范式。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心部分：（1）从扩展协作式事件日志到符合OCED核心模型的对象中心表示的形式映射（规则M1-M8），并以OCEL 2.0序列化，包含六个一致性准则（P1.1-P1.6）；（2）将Predict-Collab引入的14个协作预测任务重构为对象中心预测任务，以CollaborationCase为统一的范围视角，引入"目标锚点"概念区分范围对象类型与标签所指对象类型；（3）基于ocpa库实现的可复现转换器和预测流水线，支持表格、序列和图形三种编码方式，使用Random Forest、XGBoost、Transformer、LSTM和GNN五种预测模型。
AI.result: 在五个事件日志（四个公开协作日志和一个从BPI Challenge 2013衍生的第五个日志）上的评估表明：（1）转换器生成的OCEL 2.0日志满足所有一致性准则并通过模式验证（RQ1）；（2）重构任务的标签在每个评估前缀上都与源级标签完全匹配，共172个任务-日志-参数组合（约279,400个标签）和115个参数组合（约713,345个标签）均零不匹配（RQ2）；（3）所有350个任务-日志-预测器组合均端到端成功执行（RQ3）。在四个基准日志上，分类和结构目标的预测器超过其简单基线；但在真实生活日志上，数值目标未能可靠地超过基线。GNN是唯一成本随前缀数量稳定可预测的编码方式。对象中心表示使协作结构明确化，支持视角灵活性，并使超出案例中心分类法的预测目标自然产生，代价是更高的关系复杂性和对对象中心工具的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了协作式PPM和对象中心PPM之间的概念桥梁，定义了一个形式映射、任务重构和可复现工具链。对象中心表示使协作结构成为一等公民，支持更灵活的预测目标表达。主要局限包括未建模消息发送-接收对应关系、未将个体执行者提升为对象、OrchestrationCase无法区分同一参与者的多次局部执行。未来的工作包括丰富消息相关性、执行者身份和局部执行身份的关系建模，以及在更多真实生活协作日志上验证该框架。

title: Agents for Everyone: A Workshop Framework for Building Agentic AI Capabilities in a Distributed Curation Community
summary: Agentic AI has the potential to accelerate curation of biological databases and knowledge bases. However, uptake has been hindered by a number of challenges and obstacles, including access to agents and appropriate training. Here we describe how we have attempted to address and mitigate these challenges and obstacles through the deployment of a cloud-based agentic environment, and the development of an interactive training workshop for the Gene Ontology Consortium. Our cloud environment for agentic-assisted curation was based on the JupyterHub platform, and utilized Claude Code as a universal harness. This allows curators to interact with an agent session through a terminal running in the browser, and has additional benefits such as centralization of access through a single API gateway, removing the need for participants to manage subscriptions or install software locally. We created four training modules, walking participants through basic agentic tool use first and then working up to agentic biological pathway curation using the existing GO-CAM (GO Causal Activity Model) curation tool. Thirty-seven participants took part in the four-hour workshop. Our key takeaway from this workshop is that building community capability with agentic AI is primarily a problem of access, workflow design, and training. Removing technical barriers, introducing capabilities gradually, grounding exercises in familiar curation tasks, and giving curators direct experience evaluating agent output can provide a practical route toward building shared agentic AI capability in distributed scientific communities.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Gene Ontology Consortium（GO Consortium）如何通过部署基于云的智能体（agentic AI）环境和开展交互式培训研讨会，来应对生物数据库与知识库策划（curation）中应用AI智能体的访问与培训挑战。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI在加速生物数据库和知识库策划方面潜力巨大，但其实施面临访问门槛高、缺乏适当培训等障碍，阻碍了其推广应用。本研究旨在通过云端部署和结构化培训，弥合这些差距。
AI.method: 构建基于JupyterHub的云端智能体环境，以Claude Code作为通用接口，通过浏览器终端进行交互，并通过单一API网关集中管理访问，消除订阅管理和本地安装的复杂性。开发四个培训模块，从基础智能体工具使用逐步过渡到使用GO-CAM（GO因果活动模型）进行生物通路策划的实践应用。举办了为期四小时的研讨会。
AI.result: 共有37名参与者参加了此次四小时研讨会。报告的关键经验包括：社区智能体AI能力建设主要涉及访问、工作流设计和培训三个核心问题；移除技术障碍、循序渐进地引入功能、将练习锚定于熟悉的策划任务，以及让策划者直接评估智能体输出，是构建分布式科学社区共享智能体AI能力的可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 通过降低技术门槛、逐步培养能力、依托熟悉的策划任务进行实践训练，并让策划者直接体验评估智能体输出，可以在分布式科学社区中切实建立共享的智能体AI能力，从而加速生物数据库的策划工作。

title: PCFBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Product Carbon Footprint Estimation
summary: AI systems are being deployed on high-stakes, domain-specific workflows that demand correctness not just in the final output, but at every intermediate step. One such workflow is estimating a product carbon footprint (PCF), the greenhouse-gas emissions attributable to a physical product. AI agents are increasingly being used to generate PCFs, but existing evaluations score either total emissions (hiding error sources and cancelling mistakes) or sub-tasks in isolation (missing compositional interactions). We introduce PCFBench, the first benchmark to carve PCF modeling into independently-evaluable tasks that require decomposition, retrieval, ontology matching, and numerical extraction. It comprises 614 expert-labelled items across six tasks. Together they probe reasoning under under-specification, conflicting context, and numerical constraints.
