AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base上，基于DAPO-Math-17K训练，在AIME24/25/26、AMC、Minerva、Olympiad、MATH共7个基准上，DA3PO在avg@k上平均比DAPO提升5.08%和5.40%，比GSPO提升5.02%和4.95%；pass@k也均显著优于基线；消融实验显示λ=2最优且对λ取值鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: DA3PO通过简单直接地放大困难提示上正确响应的优势，有效补偿了动态采样的非对称放大效应，在保持训练稳定性的同时提升了训练效率，是一种轻量、即插即用且兼容GRPO及其各种变体的改进方法。

title: When Evidence Shapes Collaboration: Knowledge-Conditioned Topology Generation for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have recently moved from static workflows toward dynamically generated collaboration topologies. However, existing topology generation methods rely primarily on the parametric knowledge of large language models, with external search or retrieval used only as a reactive tool rather than an explicit determinant of collaboration structure. This leads to structure-knowledge misalignment, where systems exhibit redundant interactions or insufficient verification in knowledge-intensive tasks. We propose K-GAT (Knowledge-Guided Agent Topology Generator), a neuro-symbolic framework that formulates collaboration topology design as a knowledge-conditioned structure learning problem, integrating external evidence directly into autoregressive graph generation. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate K-GAT's efficiency and effectiveness: notably on the expert-level GPQA dataset, K-GAT outperforms the LLM-Debate baseline by a substantial margin of +15.7% in accuracy, while consuming less than half the computational tokens.

AI.tldr: K-GAT提出了一种"证据优先"的神经符号框架，将多智能体系统的协作拓扑生成建模为以检索证据为条件的自回归图生成问题，通过课程学习从执行反馈中挖掘最优拓扑结构，解决了现有方法中"结构-知识失配"的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有动态多智能体系统遵循"先规划后检索"的范式，协作拓扑仅依据查询语义生成，而忽略了实际检索证据的需求，导致两种结构失配：(1)过度规划——对证据充分且一致的查询生成不必要的复杂工作流；(2)规划不足——对证据稀疏或冲突的查询分配过于简单的顺序结构，缺乏足够的验证与协作。
AI.method: K-GAT包含三个核心组件：(1)证据驱动拓扑生成——首先从外部知识图谱检索top-K证据单元及其溯源信息，将其线性化编码为证据条件表示𝐜_𝒦，然后自回归地逐节点预测智能体角色、逐边预测通信路由，生成DAG协作拓扑；(2)课程学习框架——从模板、随机DAG和当前策略中采样候选拓扑，通过实际执行评估经验成功率，结合结构成本计算得分，并通过剪枝获得最小充分结构，最终用分布匹配目标训练生成器；(3)知识基础验证器(KG-Verifier)——在执行过程中检查中间智能体响应与溯源证据的一致性，修正或终止不可靠的推理路径。
AI.result: 在七个推理基准上的实验表明：基于Qwen-3-8B骨干，K-GAT平均准确率达78.68%，优于所有8B基线并与32B/70B模型相当；在专家级GPQA数据集上比LLM-Debate基线提升+15.7%准确率，同时token消耗减少50%以上；在MMLU-Pro和GPQA上融入外部知识后的增益（+15.35%、+10.56%）显著优于单智能体和查询条件化基线；拓扑大小敏感度分析显示平均生成拓扑仅约2.34个节点；不同证据条件下生成的拓扑会动态适应（高质量证据→2.02节点，冲突/低相关证据→2.66节点）；在更强骨干Qwen3-235B-A22B上仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: K-GAT验证了"证据优先"协作范式的有效性：通过将协作拓扑生成直接条件化于检索证据及其溯源信息，能够根据证据质量动态调整协作复杂度和验证强度，在提升推理准确性的同时显著降低计算开销，证实了增益来源于证据与协作结构的更优对齐而非单纯弥补骨干模型能力不足。

title: GOD: Govern, Observe, and Direct - A Real-Time Control Room for Agent Societies
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations Track
summary: Generative-agent systems are easier to start than to inspect. A run can contain many agents, locations, messages, commands, and model calls, yet the operator often gets either a finished replay or raw logs. That makes it hard to ask why an agent moved, test a small intervention, or package a run for another researcher. GOD is a local-first control room for agent societies. From the same browser workflow, an operator can issue targeted questions or interventions and inspect the resulting replay state. The system combines a setup wizard, Agent Studio, Map Studio, a spatial replay interface, Ask and Intervene commands, and portable experiment, map, and agent packs. Its technical contribution is the command and artifact loop: live controls and replay evidence share the same operator command model, while package contracts separate scenario, map, and profile data from local runtime state. The public release includes hosted Smallville-style and PKU replays, the open-source repository, and downloadable packs. We evaluate this path on 15 completed run slots. Across the 14 intervention runs, 78 of 84 target-agent checks recorded the commanded destination, and 169 of 182 state answers matched a saved location or action string.

AI.tldr: GOD 是一个面向生成式智能体社会的本地优先（local-first）控制室系统，通过统一的浏览器工作流将操作员命令与空间重放状态绑定，并提供可移植的实验/地图/智能体包，使生成式智能体模拟的运行可被检视、干预和复现。
AI.motivation: 生成式智能体系统虽然容易启动，但运行过程难以检视：操作员通常只能看到完整的重放或原始日志，难以解释"为什么某个智能体移动了"，也难以执行小规模干预或将一次运行打包共享。已有系统（Generative Agents、AgentSociety、AutoGen Studio、AgentScope 等）各自提供部分能力，但缺乏统一的命令-重放-制品工作流。
AI.method: 系统整合了 React/Vite 前端、FastAPI 后端、AgentSociety 模拟器和 JiuwenClaw 智能体运行时（v0.1.11）。核心方法是"命令与制品循环"（command and artifact loop）：（1）统一的操作员命令模型，使 Ask（只读问询）和 Intervene（下一步干预）命令在实时控制和重放视图中共享同一 schema，并附带于对应的模拟步骤；（2）分离的包契约（package contract）将场景、地图、档案数据与本地运行时状态（API 密钥、日志、SQLite 重放库等）分开；（3）提供设置向导、Agent Studio、Map Studio、空间重放界面以及 Ask/Intervene 命令。研究者在 PKU 地图（22 个智能体）上用 Qwen-Plus 模型运行了 15 个完成槽位（1 个无事件基线 + 14 个干预运行）。
AI.result: 在 14 个干预运行中：84 次目标智能体检查中有 78 次记录了命令目的地；182 次状态答案中有 169 次与已保存的位置或动作字符串匹配；182 次事件边界答案中有 144 次通过术语规则；事件特定 trace@2 为 212/308；零次事件前术语泄漏；零次不支持的位置提及；四对重复场景的最终位置分布平均 JSD 为 0.011。82 项后端测试全部通过；公共数据/配置文件中未发现隐私状态泄漏。
AI.conclusion: GOD 通过集成现有模拟器与智能体运行时，提供了一种以操作员和制品工作流为核心的方案，而非提出新的小镇模拟或智能体策略。其命令-制品路径在一次模型配置和四对重复场景下是可重现的；但智能体目标仅检查单步后的记录状态而非完整轨迹，字符串检查衡量的是命令与重放的一致性而非语义基础或操作员可用性，结果可能因模型、场景和用户而异。

title: Should I Use This Synthetic Dataset for Training? How to Test with Minimal Real Data
summary: Digital twins (DTs) and learned world models are increasingly used to generate synthetic data that augment the scarce real datasets available for training artificial intelligence (AI) models in engineering systems. Owing to the inevitable simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) gap, however, augmentation may fail to improve the performance of the trained model on the real data distribution. This paper addresses the resulting decision problem: Given a real dataset, a candidate synthetic dataset, and a fixed learning algorithm, decide whether training on the augmented dataset improves the true, population-level performance, while consuming as few real test data points as possible. Two formulations are considered: a direct test on the mean loss difference between the two trained models, and a symmetry-based test on the paired loss difference, which trades a stronger null assumption for faster evidence accumulation. For the latter, we introduce the {adaptive e-process sign-flip test} (aeSFT), a doubly adaptive procedure that adapts both the number of Monte Carlo sign-flip rounds, and hence the computational cost, and the amount of real test data consumed. aeSFT yields anytime-valid Type-I error control, with no need to pre-specify the test-set size. Experiments on a synthetic-data classification task, a DT-aided wireless packet-scheduling task, and a radio-map prediction task show that aeSFT identifies useful synthetic data using substantially fewer real test samples than mean-based sequential testing, matches the power of fixed-sample sign-flip testing and the paired $t$-test, while keeping the false-positive rate below the target level.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工程系统中数字孪生(DT)和世界模型生成的合成数据是否真正有用的问题，提出了一种新的假设检验方法——自适应e过程符号翻转检验(aeSFT)，用于在消耗尽可能少的真实测试数据的前提下，判定将真实训练集与合成数据集联合训练是否能提升模型在真实数据分布上的泛化性能。该方法通过批内与批间两层自适应e过程，在符号对称零假设下实现任意时刻有效的I类错误控制，无需预设测试集大小或损失上界。
AI.motivation: 在工程系统中(如无线网络、机器人、自动驾驶等),针对特定部署场景采集真实数据成本高昂且耗时,数字孪生和世界模型虽可生成大量合成数据,但由于仿真-现实(sim-to-real)差距,合成数据增强未必能提升模型在真实分布上的性能。因此亟需一种统计严谨、样本高效的方法来判断给定合成数据集是否真正有助于训练。
AI.method: 1. **问题形式化**:将合成数据有用性判定建模为序贯二元假设检验问题,提出两种零假设——直接零假设(基于损失差的均值)和基于对称性的零假设(配对损失差分布关于零对称)。2. **aeSFT算法**:引入双层自适应e过程——批内(intra-batch)e过程使用aGRAPA下注策略自适应确定符号翻转轮数;批间(inter-batch)e过程以乘积形式跨独立批次累积财富。3. **批内停止规则**:采用基于变化量的拒绝准则与基于阈值ω的早停准则;批大小按增长率β自适应扩展。4. **理论保证**:利用Ville不等式和可选停定理,证明批间财富过程在对称零假设下为非负测试鞅,从而保证任意时刻有效的I类错误控制。5. **实验验证**:在二分类、DT辅助的无线分组调度、无线电地图预测三个任务上与aMT、eSFT、配对t检验等方法进行TPR/FPR对比。
AI.result: 1. **二分类任务**:aeSFT在约680个测试样本后即拒绝零假设,而aMT需要约1410个样本;平均停止时间为1024个样本;TPR显著高于aMT,尤其在样本量较小时。2. **无线分组调度任务**:aeSFT在仅16个真实测试回合后TPR即达0.657,而aMT接近零;平均停止时间为88.0回合,远少于aMT的143.6回合。3. **无线电地图预测任务**:aeSFT在50张高保真地图后TPR达0.463,而aMT始终为零;自适应延续后TPR升至0.512,经验FPR控制在0.096以下,均低于目标水平α=0.1。4. **整体表现**:aeSFT在所有任务上均保持经验FPR低于α,固定样本的eSFT和配对t检验在预设样本量下达到相近功效,但无法在同一检验中继续追加数据。
AI.conclusion: aeSFT通过双层自适应机制(批内符号翻转轮数与批间真实测试数据量)解决了既有方法在样本效率和计算效率上的瓶颈,为合成数据增强的统计验证提供了实用工具。其任意时刻有效的错误控制保证使其特别适用于真实评估代价高昂的工程场景,可推广至无线信道状态验证、LLM合成指令/偏好数据集评估、机器人世界模型验证等多种应用。

title: Automated Analysis Framework for Multilingual Climate-Health Literature Based on Multi-Agent Large Language Model
summary: The rapid proliferation of interdisciplinary and multilingual scientific literature has left traditional manual analysis and single-algorithm methods plagued by low efficiency, poor scalability, and insufficient domain adaptability. Targeting the literature analysis needs of the typical interdisciplinary climate-health field, this study proposes a multi-agent large language model automated analysis framework for multilingual scientific literature, which realizes full-process automation covering literature screening, structured information extraction, and standardized integration. With a central coordination module as the core, the framework deploys three dedicated agents for document evaluation, information extraction, and analytical review to mimic the literature analysis thinking of domain experts, and adopts a four-layer hallucination control strategy together with a manual verification procedure to ensure the accuracy and reliability of analytical outcomes. Validated on a bilingual Chinese-English corpus of 32,642 climate-health papers covering China from 1993 to 2023, the framework achieves an F1 score of 0.92 in core information extraction, and completes the extraction and standardization of 2,012 city-literature association pairs, offering effective technical support for large-scale evidence mining in the climate-health research domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向多语言跨学科科学文献的多智能体大模型自动分析框架，并以中-英双语气候健康文献为应用场景进行验证。框架采用中心调度模块统一管理文献筛选、结构化信息提取与质量审查三个专职智能体，结合四层幻觉控制策略，在32,642篇覆盖中国1993–2023年的气候健康论文上实现核心信息提取F1值0.92，并提取标准化了2,012个城市-文献关联对。
AI.motivation: 随着跨学科多语言科学文献数量激增，传统人工阅读与单一算法方法在效率、可扩展性和领域适应性方面存在明显不足。气候健康作为环境科学、公共卫生与流行病学交叉的前沿领域，文献体量大、双语发布、学科跨度广，亟需可扩展、可靠、可解释的自动化文献分析方案。此外，大语言模型（LLM）在专业文献任务中存在任务过载、幻觉输出、缺乏领域本体以及跨语言术语漂移等问题，制约了其直接应用于科学文献挖掘。
AI.method: 框架采用"中心化集中调度+多智能体协作"架构：（1）文档评估智能体（Document Appraiser Agent）基于标题、摘要和关键词进行二分类相关性筛选，仅依据显式信息判断；（2）信息提取智能体（Information Extractor Agent）执行严格的抽取式任务，提取研究城市、气候暴露因子、健康结局、脆弱人群、社会经济因素等结构化字段，并附带1–5级模型自评估置信度，约束多值字段原子化，禁止跨句任意配对；（3）高级分析智能体（Senior Analyst Agent）通过完整性检查、领域本体映射、常识逻辑一致性验证、置信度过滤与异常检测进行质量控制，并自动生成分析报告。中心协调模块基于Prefect实现任务调度与数据流管理。框架集成WMO气象要素库、中国城市地名库与WHO-ICD疾病库三个外部知识资源作为工具调用实现术语标准化；通过提示约束、跨智能体逻辑校验、模型置信度评分与外部知识库过滤构成四层幻觉控制策略，配合专家双盲校验。
AI.result: 在800篇专家标注语料（IAA=0.87）上，框架核心信息提取整体Precision=0.93、Recall=0.92、F1=0.92；其中地理信息提取F1=0.94最高，气候暴露因子F1=0.91，健康结局F1=0.92。在32,642篇完整语料上，有效提取率达98%，数据标准化率99%，成功输出2,012个城市-文献关联对。基线对比显示框架优于单LLM（F1≈0.82）、领域BERT-NER（0.84）、AutoGen多智能体（0.87）以及LiRA、Paper Circle等已有文献分析系统（0.88–0.90）。消融实验验证三智能体分解优于单体与两体方案；移除跨智能体验证、外部知识库过滤或置信度过滤均导致精度明显降低；高置信度样本F1=0.94，低置信度样本仅0.66，验证了置信度筛选有效性。跨语言表现均衡（英文F1=0.93、中文F1=0.91）。基于输出识别出中国气候健康研究的空间不均衡（东部沿海集中，基尼系数0.761）和主题缺口（脆弱人群与社会经济因素研究不足）。
AI.conclusion: 该多智能体LLM框架证明了通过任务分解与多层幻觉抑制可以显著提升科学文献结构化信息提取的准确性与稳定性，为气候健康领域提供了可复用的证据综合工具，并为更广泛的跨学科文献数据挖掘提供了通用范式。局限在于当前仅基于标题/摘要/关键词进行浅层分析、依赖外部LLM API存在调用速率限制、少量非标准表达文献仍需人工抽检。未来工作将拓展至全文PDF解析与表格理解、动态知识更新、跨领域泛化以及知识图谱与交互式可视化证据地图构建。

title: PhenoIntel: A Lifecycle-Aligned Multi-Agent Web Application for Verified, Accessible Plant Phenotype Analysis
comment: 32 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (Elsevier)
summary: Existing conversational plant-phenotyping platforms are difficult for plant scientists to use and lack the reliability scientific research demands: failed analyses are reported as valid measurements rather than flagged as missing, statistical tests run without checking assumptions, predictions carry no uncertainty estimate, and specialised hardware limits accessibility. We present PhenoIntel, a lifecycle-aligned multi-agent web platform that turns the full machine-learning workflow into a reliable, user-friendly phenotyping system. Nine specialised agents divide the analysis into stages, from image collection through model selection, inference, and reporting, rather than handing the whole task to one AI manager. Independent checks separate these stages, and every agent reads from and writes to one shared, fixed-structure record, so an inconsistent output from one stage is caught before it reaches the next. Uncertainty is matched to each model family, conformal prediction, detection-confidence spread, or Monte Carlo Dropout, rather than applied uniformly, and quality thresholds adapt to crop and task instead of one global cutoff. When no suitable model exists, PhenoIntel can propose, validate, and integrate a new one on its own. The model repository spans ten trained models across five crops and four imaging modalities. Classification models reach Macro F1 of 0.78-0.996; object-detection models reach 0.96 mAP@50 with a 54% reduction in counting error over an unoptimised baseline; and a temporal model reaches held-out Macro F1 of 0.7050. PhenoIntel runs in a browser on standard hardware, requiring no GPU, and a 1,200-test automated suite confirms complete pipeline execution. Every result carries calibrated uncertainty, validated statistics, and FAIR-compliant provenance, a combination existing conversational phenotyping tools do not offer.

AI.tldr: PhenoIntel 是一个面向植物表型分析的全生命周期多智能体 Web 平台,通过九个专门的智能体和八个验证检查点(V0–V7),将传统单体 AI 编排器(plant phenotyping)中的失败传播、零值误报、统计假设未校验、无不确定性量化等问题以架构层面系统解决;在浏览器中无需 GPU 即可运行,并为每次会话生成符合 FAIR 原则的 12 文件可追溯包,经 1200 测试自动化套件全数通过。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式植物表型平台存在四大类可靠性缺陷:失败检测被记录为 0 而非缺失、统计检验未检查假设、预测无不确定性、依赖专业硬件。作者通过对 Xu 等 (2024) 的单体编排器进行源代码审计,诊断出这些问题的共同根源——规划、推理、统计、解释被压缩在单一提示链中,阶段间无形式化边界,故障无法在传播前被拦截。
AI.method: 1) 九智能体生命周期分解:Planning(0)、Data Collection(1)、Preprocessing(2)、Feature Engineering(3)、Dataset Partitioning(4,仅 Build)、Model Selection(5)、Inference(6)、Evaluation(7)、Reporting(8);唯一 LLM 接口在 Planning 阶段。2) 单一强类型共享状态 AgroPhenoState 作为唯一通信通道,所有读写作经此进行。3) V0–V7 八个自动、非 AI 验证检查点,每阶段边界强制拦截。4) 按模型族分发不确定性量化:分类用 RAPS 共形预测,检测用检测置信度分布,时序用 MC Dropout (N=30) + 分位数回归。5) 自扩展层:任务本体、Pipeline Adaptation Agent (LLM 生成架构后由独立 LLM 评分,最多 4 次尝试)、五源骨干(timm、HuggingFace、torchvision、内置 zoo、自定义)。7) 沙箱统计执行:只读文件系统、无网络、内存/超时限制、固定导入白名单,自动 Shapiro-Wilk + Kruskal-Wallis 回退 + APA 输出。8) 12 文件 FAIR 溯源包,checksum 索引。
AI.result: 10 个模型 zoo 检查点(5 分类+2 检测+3 时序)+ 6 个跨领域案例(CS1–CS6)。完成率 100%(16 个会话零崩溃零超时零零值失败);分类 Macro F1 0.78(咖啡,N=90)–0.9963(玉米);GWHD 小麦穗检测 mAP50 = 0.9605;水稻穗计数 MAE 从 7.66 降至 3.54(54% 误差削减);时序作物类型 Macro F1 0.7050;熵回退路径 ECE 均值 0.068、覆盖率 93.6%、平均预测集大小 1.14;MC Dropout P10–P90 覆盖率 86%/83% (80% 目标);冷启动 <1 分钟,无需 GPU,3 步上手;12/12 FAIR 文件,1200/1200 测试通过。CS5 首次实战触发 Pipeline Adaptation Agent 生成新架构并通过验证;CS6 显示 Build 工作流可正确路由至时序骨干。
AI.conclusion: PhenoIntel 证明将生命周期分阶段、阶段间强制检查的纪律从训练流水线(MLflow/Kubeflow)迁移到推理时智能体编排是可行的;每个架构响应均针对一个具体智能体失败模式并以独立指标验证,而非单一聚合得分。该模式(共享类型化记录、阶段间验证、不确定性方法与模型匹配、新能力 propose-check-verify-promote 流程)可推广至其他科学 AI 流水线。局限性:无精细化分割检查点(零样本路径最弱,CS2 MAE=3)、RAPS 共形覆盖率未独立基准测试、作物类型头 0.7050 无法独立复现(全池重新评估降至 0.2649,部分差异源于报告的逐类校准/阈值步骤未被复现)、CS6 自报告 0.973 vs 全池重现 0.3728(独立的不一致)、硬件限制(CPU only,未资助)限制了数据集规模和评估深度,部分案例研究为单次运行无 bootstrap 置信区间。未来工作:精细分割检查点、GPU 基础设施、共形化分位数回归、主动学习路由、联邦学习、多季节验证。

title: Coverage, Not Credit: Failure-Credit Routing of Zeroth-Order Perturbation Budgets Does Not Improve On-Pool Sample Efficiency for LLM Agents
summary: Trajectory-level credit assignment can localize which module of a tool-using LLM agent causes failures using only verifiable signals. We ask whether such failure credit should route a fixed zeroth-order/evolution-strategies (ZO/ES) perturbation budget. Across a synthetic environment and frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B and SmolLM2-1.7B agents, three task families, six allocation schemes, a credit-noise sweep, paired seeds, and exact sign-flip tests, we find no statistically detectable improvement over uniform allocation in any on-pool comparison (no gain of at least 2 percentage points). The joint soft-plus-sigma scheme is equivalent to uniform within a +/- 0.02 AUC margin on 1.5B and 3B; concentrating the full budget on the credit argmax is marginally equivalent on 1.5B, where that module is the verified bottleneck, and significantly worse on 3B. Inverse-propensity debiasing does not rescue routing, and misrouting costs up to -0.074 AUC in-house and -0.118 end-to-end on the BFCL-derived family. Across six fixed-step schedules, loss is linear in bottleneck starvation rate (R^2 = 0.94, descriptive), and a preregistered credit-free coverage floor removes detected harm. Matched-budget burst and step-compensating catch-up schedules are consistent with harm arising from insufficient cumulative parameter movement rather than update frequency. Our primary estimand is optimization efficiency on a fixed task pool. On unseen BFCL functions, the study's one exception is that soft routing exceeds uniform on held-out endpoints (+0.047, p = 0.031, n = 6). A plausible but untested reading is that routing-favored caller improvements transfer while uniform's on-pool gains reflect a synthesizer behavior specific to our harness. We report this exception explicitly and document three failure modes that can silently invalidate ZO/ES experiments on frozen LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过大量受控实验证明：在冻结LLM智能体上，将零阶/进化策略（ZO/ES）的扰动预算按轨迹级失败归因（failure credit）进行路由分配，在任务池上的优化效率并不优于均匀分配。其核心结论是"覆盖率（coverage），而非信用（credit）"才是关键——保持每个模块每代至少一对扰动即可消除错误路由造成的损害。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型LLM智能体可通过轨迹级信用分配定位失败模块（选择器/调用者/合成器等），一个自然的假设是：应将ZO/ES的扰动预算集中投放到失败归因指向的模块上。然而这一组合策略从未被严格验证。本文旨在控制性检验"信用→ZO/ES扰动预算路由"这一组合是否真正提升样本效率。
AI.method: 方法学核心：模块化低维子空间参数化——将每个模块绑定32维系数向量，注入到所有目标投影层（Q/V/O）的SVD奇异方向上；采用对偶镜像零阶优化（antithetic mirrored ES）；基于可验证信号（工具错误选择、调用失败、最终答案不匹配）的规则化信用分配器；六种分配方案（uniform/soft/hard/random/sparse/hard~q）；预注册的配对种子设计与精确符号翻转置换检验；TOST等价性检验（±0.02 AUC边界）；覆盖下限（每模块每代≥1对）；实验平台：Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B与SmolLM2-1.7B冻结智能体，合成+自建工具调用+BFCL派生三类任务族。
AI.result: 主要结果：1）在任何"在池"（on-pool）比较中均未检测到路由优于均匀分配（无一例获得≥2pp增益）；2）错误路由带来真实代价（最高−0.118 AUC端到端）；3）六方案损失与瓶颈模块"饥饿率"呈线性关系（R²=0.94，斜率−0.087）；4）预注册的覆盖下限消除了检测到的损害（单瓶颈与多模块两种headroom下均成立）；5）突发（burst）与追赶（catch-up）调度实验表明损害源于瓶颈模块累积参数移动不足，而非更新频率；6）唯一的例外是在BFCL未见函数上，soft路由优于均匀（+0.047，p=0.031，n=6），但该差异由调用者精度而非合成器中继驱动。
AI.conclusion: 结论：失败信用路由（加权或逆倾向加权去偏）用于ZO/ES扰动预算分配，在固定任务池的优化效率上不优于均匀分配，且存在可量化的下行风险；统一覆盖（或带每模块下限的任何方案）才是鲁棒默认设置。机制证据指向：模块的累积参数位移是约束资源，信用错误路由会通过饥饿瓶颈模块而损害该资源。实践建议：因系统原因选择子集是可以的，但在预算允许时应保持覆盖保证；不应期望信用信号带来收敛速度提升。留待检验的是：信用路由是否在泛化层面有用（即把训练预算投向"其增益可迁移"的模块）。

title: String: An Agentic OS Where Every App Is a Markdown File
summary: LLM agents have become a new class of software user, but every surface they work through was designed for someone else. Pages are built for human eyes, which can skim and ignore; tool schemas for programs, which pay nothing to carry definitions they never call. An agent has neither luxury: it re-reads, and pays again for, everything it is shown on every turn. We present String, an open-source runtime that gives this user an interface of its own and treats the job as an operating-systems problem. Tool knowledge moves out of the agent's context and into a common layer that renders it back one view at a time as Markdown. A single SFMD (String-Flavored Markdown) document declares an application's views, typed actions, navigation, and credentials, and the runtime handles discovery, validation, execution, state, and secrets behind two core verbs: /open to see and /act to do. Web and app turn out to be two renderings of one architecture: an SFMD site serves styled HTML to browsers and the raw document to agents, so one grammar reaches apps, files, shells, and the web, even legacy HTML, with no per-site integration. Views stay partial by design, and the staging is causal: disclosing one tier of detail a single turn too early costs up to 23 accuracy points, while proper staging drops wrong-action selection from 28% to 2%. Privilege follows provenance: a remote page may call HTTP but never the shell, and caller-supplied text never expands a stored secret. On an 87-task benchmark that pairs each task with curated skills, operationalizing those procedures as on-demand String apps yields comparable aggregate success across six models from frontier to small (+1.3pp) while using 33.5% fewer tokens among completed episodes, and the resident interface stays a constant 53 tokens at any catalog size. We report the design, the evaluation, and what three months of production use taught us.

AI.tldr: String 是一个为 LLM 智能体设计的开源"操作系统"运行时，将所有应用抽象为 Markdown 文件（SFMD 格式）。它通过将工具描述移出智能体上下文、按需渲染部分视图、统一 Web/应用/文件/Shell 界面，显著降低 Token 消耗并保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体作为新型软件使用者，面临严重"认知负载"问题：所有工具 Schema、API 描述都常驻上下文，每次轮转都需重新读取，造成 Token 浪费和决策干扰（小模型尤甚）。现有方案（Function Calling、MCP、技能库）只解决了"连接"问题，未解决"上下文占用"问题。
AI.method: 核心创新是 SFMD（String-Flavored Markdown）格式与配套运行时：1) P1 部分暴露——视图故意只渲染当前决策所需，其余通过地址寻址；2) P2 位置透明——Web/应用/文件/Shell 用同一语法（/open、/act）；3) P3 文档即程序——Markdown 文件即应用，安装即复制；4) P4 递归渲染——动作输出再渲染为 SFMD。运行时提供 OS 级服务：Topic、原子包管理、来源溯源的权限模型、隔离的凭据存储、Webhook 收件箱。
AI.result: 在 87 任务 SkillsBench 上，6 个模型（从 GPT-5.5 到 Haiku 4.5）平均成功率 51.8%（vs 技能基线 50.5%，+1.3pp），已完成回合 Token 减少 33.5%。常驻接口仅 53 Token，与工具数量无关（对比全 Schema 103,518 Token）。100 个 OpenAPI 应用测试中，Token 下降 91.8–93.5%。层级披露时机关键：提前一层披露降低 23.3 准确率，正确分阶段使错误动作选择从 28% 降至 2%。对 4 个开源模型在生产轨迹上微调后，Token 再降 51.9–78.9%。
AI.conclusion: String 证明智能体 OS 层面是一个"渲染纪律"问题，而非新协议：通过将过程知识操作化置于部分、统一接口之后，可匹配精选技能的效果同时减少 1/3 的 Token，并将常驻接口上下文从 10 万级 Token 压缩到 53 Token。小模型微调证明该稳定接口可作为可学习训练目标。局限：当前为单用户、仅回环、无认证，签名/能力/审计仍在路线图上。

title: WeAgent-MMSearch: Native Text-Vision Interaction for Multimodal Search Agents
summary: Multimodal search agents extend parametric knowledge with newly emerging and long-tail evidence from the open web. Yet many existing agentic search environments often expose retrieved evidence only as text and omit tool-returned images from subsequent context, reducing visually grounded trajectories to text-only reasoning. Long-horizon interaction also compounds tool-call, response-length, timeout, and budget failures, which can discard salvageable trajectories, waste rollout computation, and disturb policy updates. To address these issues, we introduce WeAgent-Harness, a multimodal agentic harness that supports native text-vision interaction and runtime recovery. Retrieved images receive persistent disk references, allowing the model to inspect, process, and cite them throughout the trajectory. Based on this harness, we develop WeAgent-MMSearch, an integrated system spanning data construction, agentic post-training, and multimodal rollout. For data construction, a strong MLLM uses WeAgent-Harness to discover, synthesize, and verify MMSearch-style tasks and collect expert trajectories. During post-training, our Failure-Aware GSPO (FA-GSPO) recovers salvageable abnormal rollouts and filters invalid ones to improve bounded multimodal planning and this http URL also introduce VisTarget-Bench, a 150-task human-verified benchmark that pairs each question with a held-out target image, distinguishing image-retrieval failures from visual-perception failures. Evaluation on VisTarget-Bench and seven public benchmarks shows that agentic post-training improves the average score by 19.22 points, enabling our model to outperform similarly sized open-source models and rival models with roughly ten times its parameter count.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WeAgent-MMSearch 多模态搜索智能体系统,通过支持原生文本-视觉交互的 WeAgent-Harness 框架,结合 Fault-Aware GSPO 强化学习算法,在多个基准测试上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体搜索环境存在两个主要缺陷:(1)工具返回的图像在后续上下文中被丢弃,导致视觉依赖的任务退化为纯文本推理;(2)长程交互中累积的工具调用错误、超时、预算超限等异常会浪费计算资源并扰乱策略更新。此外,多模态搜索 (MMSearch) 任务的高质量监督数据十分稀缺。
AI.method: 1) 设计 WeAgent-Harness:通过持久化磁盘引用管理检索图像,使其在整条轨迹中可被检查、处理和引用;结合缓存搜索、明确的错误恢复和预算控制提供运行时恢复能力。2) 四阶段 Harness-Native 数据流水线:种子生成→多跳反向扩展→任务验证→轨迹采样,构建 3.3K SFT + 4.9K RL 提示,加上开源数据共计 59.5K SFT 和 13.3K RL。3) Failure-Aware GSPO 强化学习:扩展 GSPO,在恢复后过滤无效样本,仅对"eligible"轨迹进行组级归一化,保留可挽救的异常轨迹。4) VisTarget-Bench:150 道人审任务,每题配有一个 held-out 目标图像,可区分图像检索失败与视觉感知失败。
AI.result: 在 VisTarget-Bench 与七个公开基准上,后训练将平均得分提升 19.22 分。WeAgent-MMSearch-RL 在 8 个基准上平均达 55.97%,优于同体量开源模型并可媲美约 10 倍参数量的模型。具体:MMBrowseComp 28.13%,MMSearch 77.78%,MMSearch-Plus 37.82%,VisTarget-Bench 30.22%。Kimi K2.6 使用 WeAgent-Harness 后平均从 21.92% 跃升至 58.42%。在 VisTarget-Bench 上,最终模型在图像引用 20.67%、目标匹配 87.10%、匹配后准确 77.78% 上表现优异。消融实验显示图像再喂入机制带来巨大增益(46.89%→55.97%),且 FA-GSPO 优于 Vanilla GSPO(51.10%→55.97%)。
AI.conclusion: WeAgent-MMSearch 是一个围绕 WeAgent-Harness 构建的端到端多模态搜索系统,通过将工具检索图像作为可寻址的策略状态并在多轮中持续喂入视觉观测,结合运行时恢复和环境对齐的学习,显著提升了多模态搜索性能。该系统在高难度视觉推理任务(如图中颜色识别、奖杯查询)上展示了多轮视觉证据整合的关键作用。

title: Learning to Allocate Incentives for Incentivized Advertising via Offline Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Complete your ad view and grab a 5-cent bonus! In incentivized advertising, a platform promises users a bonus before observing downstream ad revenue, encouraging them to click and complete ads. It must balance the incentive promised in advance against the revenue realized afterward: insufficient incentives forfeit monetization opportunities, whereas excessive incentives reduce net profit. Because current incentives may also shape user expectations and future engagement, incentive allocation is a sequential decision problem with delayed revenue, cost sensitivity, and carryover effects. Existing work has not studied decision-making algorithms for this setting. Auto-bidding assumes available ad opportunities, while targeted promotion optimizes incentives outside the ad monetization pipeline. We formulate the problem as an MDP and develop an offline model-based RL framework for cost-controllable sequential incentive allocation. It learns a world model of user feedback and ad revenue, then performs conservative policy optimization. An independent counterfactual scorer evaluates each learned policy on held-out logs, enabling pre-launch selection without costly online exposure. Experiments on large-scale industrial data and online A/B tests show that the scorer provides a stable offline signal. The deployment path from causal inference to offline RL and then Offline-MBRL further validates the framework: MB-IQL improves per-user net profit by 7.96\% over TD3+BC, whereas reverting to plain IQL reduces it by 6.56\% (both \(p<0.0001\)).

AI.tldr: 本文针对激励视频广告中的激励金额分配问题，提出了一种基于离线模型强化学习（Offline-MBRL）的成本可控序列决策框架。该框架通过学习用户反馈与广告收入的业务结构化世界模型，结合保守策略优化，并利用独立的反事实评估打分器（CES）在上线前筛选策略。工业级数据和在线A/B测试验证了MB-IQL相对TD3+BC可提升人均净利润7.96%，且CES排序与线上部署证据一致。
AI.motivation: 激励视频广告中，平台需在预先向用户承诺激励金额与延迟观察下游广告收入之间取得平衡。激励过低会失去变现机会，过高则侵蚀净利润，同时当前激励还会通过用户预期影响后续互动。现有自动出价（auto-bidding）假设曝光机会已存在，定向促销（targeted promotion）则将激励置于广告变现管道之外，均未覆盖"用激励创造曝光并考虑短期用户行为连续性"这一联合问题。需要一种无需高风险在线RL探索的、成本可控的序列决策方法。
AI.method: 1. 将连续激励交互建模为MDP：状态包含实时与离线特征，动作是激励金额；奖励r_t^λ = I_t − λ·y_t·a_t，引入成本系数λ控制成本敏感度；时间衰减采用半衰期折扣。2. 设计业务结构化世界模型（WM），具有三个请求级预测头（曝光概率p̂_z、完成概率p̂_y|z、条件广告收入m̂_I）以及动力学预测可变实时特征子集；WM采用MMoE架构。3. 在真实-虚拟混合数据d_f = f·d_off + (1−f)·d_wm上训练批评家，对WM诱导候选动作施加保守Q正则化（采用LME-T形式的CQL风格惩罚），形成MB-TD3+BC、MB-IQL、MB-CQL三种骨干扩展。4. 独立训练反事实评估打分器（CES），按请求级预测-用户级聚合方式产出人均收入、成本、净利润，支持支持集感知的上线前策略排序。
AI.result: 在DY-1（~200M）、DY-2（~400M）、DH（~50M）三个工业日志环境中，CES显示所有WM扩展均稳定优于对应的模型自由基线：MB-TD3+BC平均相对增益+46.8%，MB-IQL+35.5%，MB-CQL+29.8%。在线A/B测试在≥10M累计DID和10%峰值流量下确认部署排序DESCN < TD3+BC ≈ IQL < MB-IQL：MB-IQL相对TD3+BC人均净利润+7.96%（p<0.0001），去掉WM回到plain IQL则下降6.56%（p<0.0001）；长期LT与LTV未出现显著恶化。CES支持集诊断显示，当策略动作超出±20%内支持区间时估计偏差增大，需通过λ等超参控制策略外推。固定8×32GB GPU预算下，CES每检查点评估开销仅5%，远低于FQE的50%。D4RL HalfCheetah公开基准上，MB-IQL、MB-TD3+BC在Medium/Medium-Replay四项配对中三项优于对应基线。
AI.conclusion: 激励视频广告中的激励金额分配应被视为成本敏感、延迟收入、短期用户行为连续性耦合的序列决策问题。基于业务结构化WM与保守策略优化的离线模型强化学习框架可显著提升人均净利润，独立的CES提供与线上部署证据一致的离线排序信号，可在不承担在线探索风险的前提下支持上线前策略筛选。该工作的局限在于聚焦短窗口净利润优化、未建模长期用户指标；CES是基于请求级预测的支持集感知排序工具而非全长期反事实价值估计；WM与CES存在输入和目标重叠，错误可能相关，存在高估策略价值的风险。

title: SEPO: Evidence-Grounded Prompt Optimization via Structural Editing
summary: Existing API-only prompt optimisers are often described as interpretable, but in practice, this usually means only post-hoc inspectability: each iteration still rewrites the prompt as one opaque string, leaving a trace of full-prompt diffs rather than localisable, machine-readable edits. This paper introduces SEPO (Structural, Evidence-grounded Prompt Optimization), a multi-trajectory prompt optimiser centred on edit-effect lineage feedback. Rather than treating each iteration as an isolated whole-prompt rewrite, SEPO locally edits stable, typed units in a two-layer prompt schema, links the target and realised structural operations of each edit to the examples it newly fixes or breaks, and carries this edit-effect record forward to guide later architect calls on the same search branch. This makes prompt optimisation addressable, attributable, and actionable. Across a 14-task held-out suite, SEPO improves over the strongest baseline, GEPA, by 3.1 pp on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and 2.2 pp on Qwen3-8B, reaching 61.9% and 73.3% macro accuracy. SEPO also lies on both the optimisation-time and test-time Pareto frontiers, spending 2.9M optimisation tokens versus 4.1M for GEPA and producing prompts over 5x shorter.

AI.tldr: SEPO（Structural, Evidence-grounded Prompt Optimization）是一种基于结构化编辑和编辑效果谱系反馈的多轨迹提示优化方法，通过定位可寻址的编辑单元、记录每次编辑的归因目标与实现操作、并将其与新修复/破坏的样本关联传递给后续架构师调用，从而在14任务测试套件上以更低的优化和部署成本超越GEPA等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有仅API的提示优化器虽然常被称为"可解释"，但实际上每次迭代都将提示作为不透明字符串整体重写，留下的是完整提示差异序列，无法定位编辑发生在哪里、为何进行、影响了哪些样本。这导致提示膨胀和持续规则堆积，难以保留有效改进。
AI.method: SEPO采用两层提示模式（顶层大纲+步骤级规则），每次迭代进行局部结构化编辑。两个架构师调用（归因架构师+补丁架构师）共享证据包，包含父级上次编辑的breadcrumb、新修复/新破坏的样本以及训练探针。通过Lexicase选择和示例级准入（含唯一覆盖规则）维持轨迹多样性。每步编辑记录类型化元组(τ, ℓ, o(c), effect)作为谱系状态传递给后续迭代。
AI.result: 在14任务测试套件上，SEPO在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上达到61.9%宏准确率（+3.1pp于GEPA），在Qwen3-8B上达到73.3%（+2.2pp）。SEPO仅用2.9M优化token（vs GEPA的4.1M），部署token减半，提示长度缩短5倍以上，胜出于优化时间和测试时间Pareto前沿。消融实验证实局部归因、谱系反馈、多轨迹多样性三大原则均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: SEPO通过将提示优化转化为可寻址、可归因、可操作的编辑过程，证明了结构化、谱系感知的编辑优于整体重写或纯标量奖励驱动的优化。其在程序性、多步骤任务（词排序、代码生成）上收益最显著，但对长输入的算法性失败模式仍受限于纯指令性修复的边界。

title: Speculative Probing: LLM Monitoring at Speculative-Decoding Cost
summary: Real-time classification during language model inference is valuable for safety filtering, behavioral analysis, and model monitoring, but current approaches force a trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Hidden-state probes are fast but limited: they are either not context-aware: operating on a single vector and cannot model interactions across positions; or they are very costly: having dedicated classifier models (Llama Guard, Qwen Guard, LLM-as-judge) or performing computation on hidden states for all tokens and then pooling the results (MultiMax). This shows an intrinsic trade-off between efficiency and accuracy. However, we find that the speculative-decoding module in recent LLMs can be repurposed for efficient high-quality classification. By appending a trained soft prompt at the end of the target sequence, we can repurpose the speculative-decoding module into a sequence classifier. At inference time in a speculative-decoding pipeline, the KV cache is already in GPU memory, so classification adds negligible overhead. We evaluate on four classification tasks across four models (Qwen3.5-4B, 9B, 27B, MiniCPM4.1-8B). Our small probes consistently outperform zero-shot GPT-5.4-mini and, on multilingual prompt safety, match or beat specialized 8B safety classifiers (Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B, Llama-Guard-3-8B) without running a full LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"投机式探针"(Speculative Probing)，将LLM自带的投机解码头(预训练MTP或蒸馏Eagle3)重新用作序列分类器，通过附加少量可学习soft prompt，仅训练约16K-20K参数即可实现高效的序列级监控分类，且在投机解码流水线下KV cache已驻留显存，分类几乎不增加额外开销。
AI.motivation: LLM部署中需要实时分类(安全过滤、行为监控、CoT分析等)，现有方法存在效率-精度权衡：隐藏状态探针快但仅看最后token缺乏上下文感知，专用分类器(Llama Guard等)精度高但推理成本大。需要一种既高效又能建模跨位置交互的方法。
AI.method: 1) 冻结基础模型与投机解码头(MPT/Eagle3)；2) 在目标序列末尾附加k个可学习的soft prompt向量；3) 递归运行投机解码层k次，每次将前一步输出与新soft prompt拼接；4) 仅训练soft prompt和一个线性sigmoid分类头(约16K-20K参数)；5) 复用投机解码已计算的KV cache，附加注意力成本为O(kn·d_h)，几乎可忽略；6) 不干扰解码路径，可多任务共享MTP缓存。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B/9B/27B(MTP)和MiniCPM4.1-8B(Eagle3)四个模型、四个二元分类任务(指令层级合规、CoT重复检测、CoT分支推理、多语言安全)上的评估显示：SP一致优于零样本GPT-5.4-mini；在多语言安全任务上匹敌或超越专用8B安全分类器(Qwen3Guard、Llama-Guard-3)；在效率-精度Pareto前沿上占优，可训练参数比MultiMax少50倍但精度相当；PII检测示例中以8.2K参数达到MultiMax(412K参数)同样的100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 现代LLM随附的投机解码头(MTP/Eagle3)可被有效复用为零边际成本的高质量序列分类器；联合预训练的MTP头效果优于后蒸馏的Eagle3头(差4-12pp)，提示投机解码质量与分类特征质量相关；该方法依赖目标模型已配备高质量投机解码头，并需每任务数千样本监督训练。

title: The Shape of Power: A Multilingual Framework for Social Power Reasoning in Dialogues
summary: Social power plays a fundamental role in shaping human interaction, yet computational studies of power remain limited to narrow linguistic and cultural settings. Existing datasets further lack the demographic and relational depth needed for robust cross-cultural analysis. To address this gap, we introduce a theoretically grounded framework for studying social power in naturalistic multilingual dialogue through movie screenplays. The framework integrates a schema informed by social science theory, a native speaker annotation pipeline refined through pilot studies, and a custom interface for scalable cross-lingual analysis. Using this framework, we constructed an initial corpus containing 15,836 annotated instances from 100 scenes in French and Egyptian Arabic movies. Our analysis reveals strong agreement on observable demographic and contextual attributes, while socially interpretive aspects, such as power asymmetry and intention alignment, remain more contested, highlighting the complexity of social power across cultures. We evaluated 6 Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs on cross-cultural social power reasoning, finding persistent gaps between human and model agreement in relational and theory-of-mind reasoning. Our work introduces the first extensible multilingual framework for studying social power in dialogues and provides an initial evaluation setting for studying cross-cultural social reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向对话中社会权力推理的多语言可扩展框架 SocLens,基于电影剧本构建法语和埃及阿拉伯语双语语料库,并对 6 个 LLM/MLLM 进行跨文化社会权力推理基准测试,发现模型在需要关系推理和心智理论的维度上与人类一致性存在持续差距。
AI.motivation: 社会权力是塑造人际互动的核心概念,但现有计算语言学研究主要局限于单一语言(尤其是英语)和西方文化背景,缺乏具有足够人口统计学和关系深度的数据集以支持跨文化分析。本文旨在填补这一空白,回答权力如何在不同文化中通过人口统计和交互特征显现、LLM 能否可靠识别自然对话中的权力动态、LLM 行为如何跨语言文化变化三个核心问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件:(1) 基于社会科学理论(扩展的 French 和 Raven 权力类型理论,涵盖强制、奖励、合 法、专家、参照/魅力、信息和意识形态权力)的标注 schema,包括人口统计特征、情感状态、权力类型、说话者动态(双向有向关系)和对话语境五类特征;(2) 由母语者执行、通过两轮试点研究完善的标注流水线(经过 7 个月迭代);(3) 基于 HCI 原则设计的自定义跨语言标注界面。数据源选取反映日常社会互动的法语和埃及阿拉伯语电影剧本,经场景分段后由母语者独立标注,并使用 Gemini-2.5-Pro 处理剧本结构化。评估采用 Gwet 的 AC2 统计量衡量标注一致性,并对 Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.1、Gemma-3-27B、Qwen-2.5-14B 及多模态版本进行基准测试。
AI.result: 构建了包含 100 个场景、15,836 条标注实例的 SocLens 数据集(法语 38 个场景 7998 项,阿拉伯语 62 个场景 7838 项)。人类标注员在人口统计和语境属性上一致性较高(如性别接近 1.00,关系类别 0.85-0.97),但在权力差异、社会地位差异和意图对齐等需关系推理和心智理论的维度上一致性较低(法语仅 0.57)。LLM 在显性属性上表现良好,能接近人类水平(如性别、关系类别),但在权力差异、意图对齐和情感等社会解释性维度上持续落后于人类,最大差距出现在涉及隐含权力结构、视角采择和文化基础的社会推理上。多模态模型因安全拒绝和输出失败,有效覆盖率仅 55.7%,未能证明多模态输入的普遍优势。参照/魅力型权力是最具争议的权力类型(23% 的分歧),模型倾向于将强制和奖励型权力归入合法/制度化权威。
AI.conclusion: 本文是首个针对对话中社会权力的可扩展多语言框架,为跨文化社会推理提供了初始评估基准。结论表明当前 LLM/MLLM 能复制部分表层社会推理模式,但在捕捉细致且文化嵌入的权力动态方面仍然有限,这表明社会权力可作为评估 AI 系统跨文化社会推理能力的有价值诊断工具。该框架具有跨语言可扩展性,但仍受限于语言数量(仅两种)、标注者数量(每场景仅 2 人)和基准模型的快速迭代,作者计划未来扩展更多语言和文化。

title: Under-Mattress Temporal Sensing for Next-Day Agitation Risk Scoring in Dementia Wards
summary: Agitation fluctuates over short time horizons in people living with dementia, yet continuous physiological information for anticipating next-day risk is limited. We assessed whether contactless under-mattress signals from the preceding night inform next-day agitation risk and whether preserving minute-level temporal structure improves performance over conventional nightly summaries. We analyzed 423 patient-nights from 65 subjects in a specialized hospital dementia unit using two under-mattress sensing systems. A unified four-paradigm benchmark compared nightly handcrafted summaries, three-period handcrafted features, full-night sequence modeling, and sliding-window multiple-instance learning. Source-specific preprocessing and five-fold patient-grouped cross-validation were used, with performance estimated from pooled out-of-fold predictions. Evaluation included discrimination, calibration, fixed-threshold metrics, and a comparison of period-signal attribution patterns across two temporal models. Full-night sequence modeling achieved the highest discrimination (AUROC, 0.692; AUPRC, 0.849) and balanced accuracy (0.658). Both minute-level pipelines had higher AUROC than nightly summaries, but differences from three-period handcrafted features were uncertain. Cross-model attribution prioritized activity, heart rate, and respiratory rate during the core overnight period. Calibration remained limited. The preceding night's signals supported modest next-day risk discrimination, with minute-level temporal modeling outperforming nightly summaries. Prospective calibration and external validation are needed before use in individual care decisions. This patient-grouped benchmark identifies contactless overnight sensing as a promising biomedical engineering direction for agitation-risk research in hospitalized dementia cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本文基于65名住院痴呆患者共423个患者-夜的接触式床垫下传感器数据（EMFIT与WSA），对比四种时间表征范式（夜间手工特征汇总B0、三时段手工特征B1、全夜分钟级序列建模D0、滑窗多示例学习M0）预测次日激越风险。D0（InceptionTime）取得最佳AUROC 0.692和平衡准确率0.658，分钟级表征优于夜间汇总，但校准仍有限。
AI.motivation: 痴呆患者激越行为具有短时波动特性，现有研究多依赖多日汇总或居家监测，缺乏针对住院专业病房、前一夜生理信号预测次日激越风险的细粒度时序建模方法，且未明确保留分钟级时间结构是否带来增益。
AI.method: 采用统一四范式基准（B0夜间手工汇总、B1三时段手工特征、D0全夜InceptionTime序列建模、M0 Transformer窗口+门控注意力MIL池化），配以源感知预处理、五折患者分组交叉验证与1000次患者级bootstrap，配对DeLong检验比较AUROC差异；并对B1与M0的15个时段-信号组合进行跨模型归因秩比较。
AI.result: D0-InceptionTime获最高AUROC 0.692（95%CI 0.622-0.759）、AUPRC 0.849、平衡准确率0.658；D0与M0相对B0的AUROC增益（+0.127、+0.114）bootstrap区间排除零；D0与M0之间、D0与B1之间差异不确定；两模型均优先关注核心夜间时段的活动、心率和呼吸率；高负担终点（PAS总分>4，患病率17.3%）下D0仍领先；校准有限。
AI.conclusion: 前一晚床垫下信号对住院痴呆患者次日激越风险提供中等程度的判别信息；保留分钟级时间结构的全序列与滑窗建模优于常规夜间汇总，但优势相对时段特征B1尚不确定；活动与心肺信号在核心夜间时段被两模型一致优先关注；临床应用前需前瞻性校准与外部验证。

title: CrabOS: An Operating System for Human-AI Co-inhabitation
summary: AI agents are evolving into long-running computational entities that can invoke tools, maintain memory, and complete complex tasks across applications. In real-world settings, completing a task often requires humans and AI to take turns leading its execution. Such alternation depends on the seamless handoff of the work state of the task between humans and AI. Existing agent systems, however, provide humans and AI with separate work environments. AI agents must therefore rely on additional bridges to continue work: either developers build task-specific interfaces to access the work state, or users manually transfer relevant parts of it through screenshots or textual descriptions. Both approaches make handoffs costly and scale poorly. We propose Human-AI Co-inhabitation, a type of work environment that enables humans and AI to seamlessly take turns continuing work on the same task, and design and implement CrabOS to realize this concept. CrabOS represents the work state as natural-language-readable text objects shared by humans and AI, allowing both to access and manipulate it directly through the same auditable interface without bridges. Case studies show that CrabOS elevates support for complex tasks with alternating human and AI leadership from bridge-dependent application-level solutions to native operating-system capabilities, which provide a new foundation for developing and running AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Human-AI Co-inhabitation（人机共栖）这一新型工作环境概念，并设计实现了操作系统CrabOS，通过将工作状态表示为自然语言可读的文本对象、共享可引用的工作对象以及统一的系统能力调用入口，实现人与AI在同一任务上的交替协作而无需桥接。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体系统为人与AI提供独立的工作环境，二者的工作状态分离，导致任务交接时需额外构建专用接口或手动迁移上下文（截图、文本描述），随着任务阶段增多，桥接成本急剧上升，难以扩展。
AI.method: CrabOS采用四层架构：L0对象层（将所有状态物化为文件系统中的结构化文本对象，含File/Handbook/Chat/Task/Memory/App/Config/System八类）、L1系统服务层（含Kernel Interface五阶段管道：主体绑定、契约解析、策略执行、授权门、能力调度，以及Agent Runtime、App Runtime、Index Service、Network Service）、L2 Shell层（GUI Shell与Text Shell，管理窗口状态以使AI能感知人类工作状态）、L3 App层（通过iframe运行的app，与AI agent共享系统API调用能力）。遵循三项设计原则：文本化工作数据、共享工作对象、统一能力入口。
AI.result: 案例研究显示，CrabOS能在操作系统层面原生支持记忆管理（任何记忆策略可作为L3 app独立实现并替换）、Vibe Anything（任意场景的上下文延续）、多智能体任务编排（从Task文本对象和WaitPathChange原语组合得出）以及操作轨迹记录（Kernel Interface天然产生语义级操作轨迹），无需应用层桥接机制。
AI.conclusion: Human-AI Co-inhabitation将人与AI的协作从应用级桥接方案提升为操作系统级原生能力，CrabOS验证了通过共享工作状态和统一调用入口可以同时降低开发者、用户与AI三方的协作成本，为未来智能体系统的基础设施提供了新范式。

title: Expert Knowledge & Machine Understanding: Bridging Reactome's Ontology with LLM Semantic Embeddings
comment: Accepted at the CIBB 2026 conference ( this https URL )
summary: Biological knowledgebases like Reactome provide high-quality pathways that include biological elements' relationships and textual descriptions (metadata). The quality of such pathways is granted by manual curation, that presents, however, significant scalability challenges. Lately, numerous NLP tools have been proposed to cope with this issue, leveraging textual information to automatically expand biological knowledgebases. However, little exploration has been done so far to assess whether relationships among textual descriptions mirror higher order biological relationships. This study explores whether human-written descriptions in Reactome can be used to infer the experts' defined global hierarchical structure. To test this, we extracted from Reactome the Homo Sapiens hierarchy of pathways and their reactions (Reactome Hierarchy), and used textual metadata to reconstruct a Semantic Hierarchy, combining a sentence transformer model (SPECTER2) with a modified agglomerative nesting algorithm and a graph reconstruction algorithm. Quantitative (Laplacian Spectral Distance and Bootstrapping) and qualitative (global topological metrics) analyses confirm our hypothesis and indicate that the global hierarchical structure of pathways can be inferred by experts textual metadata.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种工作流程，利用SPECTER2句子嵌入模型对Reactome知识库中Homo sapiens的通路（Pathway）和反应（Reaction）的文本元数据进行编码，然后通过改进的AGNES层次聚类算法和图重建算法构建一个"语义层次结构"（Semantic Hierarchy, SH），并使用基于拉普拉斯谱距离（LSD）和自举法的图论度量方法评估其能否重建专家策展的Reactome层次结构（Reactome Hierarchy, RH）。结果在18,732个节点的图上获得LSD=0.085（归一化上界约为0.693）、p<0.005，表明仅从文本元数据就能以统计显著的方式恢复生物通路全局层次结构。
AI.motivation: Reactome等生物知识库依赖人工策展保证高质量，但扩展性受限；已有NLP工作多关注对话接口、文献摄入或动力学建模，对"文本描述之间的语义关系能否反映更高阶生物关系"这一问题关注有限。论文旨在验证：仅利用Reactome中已有的、由专家撰写的标题和描述，能否重建出其全局层次结构，从而为自动化知识库扩展提供可扩展的初步路径。
AI.method: 1) 从Neo4j Reactome Graph Database（V95，2025年12月版）过滤Homo sapiens，提取所有Pathway与ReactionLikeEvent节点及其层级关系与文本描述，构建Reactome Hierarchy（RH）；2) 将Name与Description用[SEP]拼接，并对超长文本用SaT (sat-12l-sm) 分句+10%重叠；用SPECTER2生成规模为18,732×768的句子嵌入；3) 扩展AGNES聚类算法为多路（multiway）层次聚类：当一个节点被合并的高度差小于数据驱动阈值ε时直接吸收其子节点，并以Lance-Williams公式迭代更新距离矩阵；4) 通过后序DFS遍历把数学聚类节点映射为Pathway节点，依据"仅Reaction / 至多一个Pathway / 多个Pathway三种场景，用Reactome祖先-后代映射绑定最近祖先"；5) 对比用Frobenius边距、Laplacian Spectral Distance（LSD）、密度、平均度，并以保留度分布的全局重连生成500个零模型做自举检验。
AI.result: RH含18,732节点（2,848 Pathway + 15,884 Reaction）和19,613条边；SH保持同样节点数（18,732）但边数18,703。Frobenius距离216.88，仅为该阶图理论最大距离18,731.5的约1.16%；密度0.00011、平均度2.00（RH分别为0.00011和2.09）。LSD=0.085（归一化上界ln(2)≈0.693），谱密度分布几乎与RH重合，保留λ=1处的生物网络特征峰。完整重连SH的LSD上升至0.224，自举p<0.005，说明拓扑相似并非随机。计算耗时：嵌入~2分钟、聚类~46秒、图重建~6秒。
AI.conclusion: 结论是，仅依靠Reactome中已有的、由专家撰写的文本元数据，就可借助SPECTER2嵌入+改进AGNES聚类+图重建，统计显著地重建其全局生物层次结构，为以文本驱动的自动化策展/通路重建提供了可行且可扩展的初步证据。局限性：仅限Homo sapiens、单一知识库、评估主要为拓扑层面、缺少生物学家领域评估；同时给出了未来方向：引入节点相似度与图对齐技术、其他物种与数据库验证、识别低策展区域并反馈给策展专家。

title: Generative AI Alignment with Hinduism's Theological Plurality and Sacred Representation
summary: Generative AI systems are increasingly used to answer personal questions and mediate everyday practices, including religion. However, existing discussions around AI alignment and ethics have largely centered secular, Western, and Abrahamic assumptions about religion, offering limited attention to other faith-based traditions. In this paper, we examine how Hindu users engage with generative AI systems in relation to their religious knowledge, belief, and practice. Drawing on 15 semi-structured interviews with Bangladeshi Hindu participants, we analyze how users interpret AI-generated religious representations, scriptural explanations, devotional interactions, and synthetic religious media. We found that AI can be both accessible and ethically troubling. While AI supported scriptural inquiry, devotional visualization, and religious storytelling, our study also identified concerns about theological flattening, cultural misrepresentation, devotional manipulation, and the simulation of sacred presence and authority. We conclude by arguing that religious alignment in generative AI requires interpretive alignment: systems that disclose their limits, preserve plurality, and avoid simulating sacred authority and sycophantic personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过15位孟加拉国印度教参与者的半结构化访谈，探讨生成式AI系统如何与印度教的宗教知识、信仰和实践互动。研究发现AI在支持经典查询、虔信可视化和宗教叙事方面具有价值，但也引发神学扁平化、文化误识、虔信操纵和模拟神圣权威等伦理问题，并提出"解释性对齐"的概念。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI对齐与伦理讨论主要围绕世俗化、西方和亚伯拉罕宗教的假设展开，对其他信仰传统关注有限。印度教作为世界第三大宗教及最大的非亚伯拉罕宗教传统，其内部具有多元的诠释传统、区域实践和情境化的权威形式，但GenAI系统可能会在看似中立的输出中隐含神学和文化选择，造成宗教多元性的扁平化。该研究特别聚焦孟加拉国印度教徒，弥补以印度为中心的代表性模板的不足。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，于2024年6月至2026年4月间通过便利、目的性和滚雪球抽样招募15名孟加拉国印度教参与者（10男5女，年龄25-63岁，涵盖不同种姓、教育程度和城乡背景），进行半结构化访谈（平均40分钟，使用Zoom以孟加拉语或英语进行），采用归纳主题分析法分析数据，考察参与者如何理解和评估GenAI在宗教表征、权威性、真实性、种姓、区域特殊性和虔信实践方面的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现三大主题：(1) GenAI与印度教实践的表观契合及其表征扭曲问题——AI虽支持经典接触、虔信可视化和宗教叙事，但也通过肤色美化、性别化、奇异化等产生美学扭曲；(2) AI系统模拟神圣在场、精神指引和虔信操纵的问题——当AI使神祇看起来在说话、回应或引导用户时，跨越了表征与在场之间的伦理边界，构成亵渎性的神圣模仿；(3) AI系统扁平化印度教多元性、模糊性和区域特殊性的批判——AI倾向于将某些诠释传统（如Puranic叙事）作为"印度教本身"，净化种姓解释，忽视区域圣人（如Ramthakur被误识为Rama），并通过西方或印度中心化模板强化殖民和东方主义表征逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 宗教对齐应被理解为解释性问题而非群体身份对齐问题，即"解释性对齐"：系统应承认其局限性、保留多元性、避免模拟神圣权威和阿谀式个性化。建议AI系统应：明确标示其诠释立场；区分经典段落、注释、大众虔信信仰和当代社会实践；揭示争议性问题的多元解读；避免神祇的第一人称言语或神圣在场的模拟；在涉及压迫性实践时承认活生生的社会现实；在适当时候指引用户咨询有知识的实践者、长老或学者。研究呼吁平台治理将合成宗教操纵视为独立关切。

title: Stay Within Your Bounds: Distance-Guided Decoding for Guaranteed Context-Free Grammar Compliance
summary: Grammar-constrained decoding helps large language models produce syntactically valid structured outputs, such as code, JSON, and SQL. For context-free grammars, many practical decoders enforce local prefix feasibility: each token must keep the current prefix extendable to some valid completion. Yet, under tokenizer-grammar mismatch and finite token budgets, feasible prefixes may still fail to reach acceptance. We propose a lookahead-guided decoding framework for context-free grammars based on pushdown automata. Offline, we compute bounded pushdown summaries with reachability labels and upper-bound distances to acceptance. Online, these estimates guide horizon-aware pruning and beam search. The resulting decoder is syntactically sound: every output is accepted by the target grammar. Experiments on JSON, SQL, and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) show both consistent syntactic validity and improved completion quality over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SWYB解码框架，基于下推自动机的有界可达性和接受距离估计，实现有预算感知的CFG约束解码，保证语法正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有CFG约束解码仅依赖局部前缀可行性，但在分词器-语法不匹配和有限token预算下，前缀可行未必能到达接受状态；缺乏对到达接受配置的全局前瞻指导。
AI.method: 离线阶段：构造CFG对应的PDA有界栈摘要，计算可达性标签和到接受状态的token级上界距离d_H。在线阶段：波束搜索结合模型top-k与自动机提议token，通过距离估计进行预算感知剪枝和距离引导的重排序。
AI.result: 在JSON、SQL和LTL三个任务上，使用Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B和Qwen2.5-7B三种模型，SWYB在所有设置下均达到100%语法正确性，同时在执行准确性和任务准确率上优于Guidance、Outlines、XGrammar、SynCode、GenLM等基线。
AI.conclusion: SWYB通过将来自形式化方法的下推可达性技术应用于LLM解码，提供了既有语法正确性保证又有任务质量提升的CFG约束解码方案，填补了通用CFG上预算感知前瞻解码的空白。

title: REINS: Refusal-Enhanced Inhibitory Steering with Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Steering with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offers a lightweight inference-time path for adapting the behavior of large language models without retraining. By exposing sparse and interpretable features, SAE steering provides a promising interface for safety control that guides harmful continuations toward refusal. However, we observe that complex wrappers can still undermine existing SAE steering methods on harmful prompts. To evaluate this failure mode systematically, we construct Generalized Undercover Instruction Safety Evaluation (GUISE), a dataset of harmful prompts with complex wrappers. Existing single direction SAE steering methods do not reliably produce refusals on harmful prompts, suggesting that refusal enhancement alone can be too weak when the harmful continuation path remains active. This motivates us to propose Refusal-Enhanced INhibitory Steering (REINS), which suppresses harmful continuation features and enhances safe refusal features in the same SAE feature space. Experiments on GUISE and other datasets show that prior methods either intervene too weakly or achieve only apparent safety through collapse, while REINS substantially reduces harmful responses, markedly improves safe refusals and largely preserves general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REINS（Refusal-Enhanced Inhibitory Steering）方法，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在推理时增强大语言模型对带有复杂包装的有害提示的安全拒绝能力，并通过构建GUISE基准数据集系统评估该方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的安全导向方法在面对带有复杂包装（角色扮演、领域借口、格式约束等）的有害提示时表现脆弱，单纯增强拒绝特征无法有效抑制有害续写路径，导致模型仍会产生有害输出或仅通过输出崩溃实现表面安全。
AI.method: 提出REINS方法，在同一SAE特征空间中联合执行两个互补操作：1）Harm-Inhibit（每提示独立）通过梯度×激活归因抑制支持当前有害续写的特征；2）Refusal-Enhance（固定校准）增强校准得到的拒绝特征，仅在生成初始几个token时介入。此外提出REINS-Gate作为提示侧门控，仅在高风险提示上激活REINS。构建GUISE数据集，采用三级分类法（5大类、15子类、45场景）通过多智能体流水线生成900个带复杂包装的有害提示及其匹配的安全提示。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B-Base和Qwen3.5-2B-Base上的实验表明：REINS将GUISE有害响应率从90.3%降至26.3%，安全拒绝率从3.7%提升至63.7%，崩溃率仅2.7%，显著优于Refusal-SAE、SAE-SSV*和CorrSteer-A等基线；在AdvBench、JailbreakBench和HarmBench上也表现稳定；REINS-Gate将通用能力（MMLU-Pro、GPQA）恢复到接近原始水平并将附带效应从26.4%降至0.1%；消融实验证明Harm-Inhibit与Refusal-Enhance承担不同角色，二者缺一不可；特征审计显示99%以上的Harm-Inhibit选择落在中后层且语义指向有害支持。
AI.conclusion: SAE安全导向应在同一特征空间中协调有害续写抑制与显式拒绝增强两个角色，二者承担不同的失败模式应对功能；门控机制可有效减少对无害提示的不必要干预，平衡安全性与通用能力保持。

title: Beyond Task-Only Matching: Personalized Skill Routing with Counterfactual Evaluation
summary: The rapid expansion of reusable skill repositories makes skill routing a critical capability for large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods treat routing as task-only semantic matching. However, when users with incompatible constraints issue an identical request, this assumption conflates task relevance with skill suitability: a task-only router can select a semantically plausible skill that is unsuitable for the requesting user. To expose this failure mode, we formulate \textit{personalized skill routing} as profile-conditioned retrieval, in which relevance depends jointly on the task and the user profile. We first introduce a profile-counterfactual benchmark, in which the task is held fixed while changes in the user profile induce changes in the reference skill. We further construct paired counterfactual supervision and propose SkillFeed, a progressive retrieve-and-rerank framework that first establishes task--skill alignment and then learns profile-conditioned discrimination. By retrieving body-level evidence and reranking semantically similar but profile-conflicting candidates, SkillFeed identifies skills that satisfy both task requirements and user constraints. On SkillFeed-Bench, SkillFeed attains 75.1\% top-1 retrieval accuracy, a 23.1-point improvement over the corresponding pretrained routing baseline. Adding profile conditioning yields a 35.1-point gain on queries where user profile changes the reference skill. This contrast shows that user profiles are most consequential precisely when they change skill suitability. Our website is publicly available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化技能路由任务，将传统基于任务语义匹配的技能路由重新定义为任务与用户画像联合条件下的检索问题。针对该问题，作者构建了包含228K候选技能的SkillFeed-Bench基准（含329个标注查询，其中包含77个反事实画像切换样本），并提出两阶段框架SkillFeed，结合多源召回（BM25+任务稠密+画像分块稠密）与画像感知的重排序。在基准上取得75.1% Hit@1，较预训练基线提升23.1个百分点；在画像反事实子集上提升35.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有技能路由方法将路由视为纯任务语义匹配，忽略了用户画像约束对技能选择的影响。当不同用户发出相同请求但具备互斥的约束（如预算、平台、语言等）时，任务级路由器可能选择语义相关但不适用的技能，导致用户级失败。传统基准也无法区分系统是否真正利用画像信息，因为其查询中任务固定，画像变化不应影响参考答案的设定未被测试。
AI.method: 1) 构建SkillFeed-Bench：从GitHub、SkillNet、SkillSMP聚合228,432个技能（每个含名称、描述、SKILL.md程序体），由LLM代理交互收集272个任务，搭配结构化用户画像，采用两阶段标注（嵌入检索+LLM评估+人工审核），并通过画像反事实增强构建77个任务固定但参考答案随画像切换的样本。2) 构建训练监督：2,712个任务中心实例和7,459个画像条件实例，含配对反事实正例和画像冲突的困难负例。3) SkillFeed两阶段框架：a) 两阶段检索器训练（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B），Phase 1仅用任务学习任务-技能对齐，Phase 2加入画像和反事实对学习画像判别，使用InfoNCE损失；b) 画像感知技能主体检索，将SKILL.md按Markdown分块编码，使用加权聚合（最大+TopM均值+对数计数）将块级证据融合为技能级信号；c) 多路召回通过加权倒数秩融合（任务稠密0.4+画像分块稠密0.4+BM25 0.2）；d) 画像感知重排序器（Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B），用列表式交叉熵在候选组上训练。
AI.result: 在SkillFeed-Bench上：完整管线Hit@1达75.1%（95% CI [0.706,0.794]），MRR@20达0.803；较预训练Qwen3基线提升23.1个百分点（p<0.0001）。在画像反事实子集上，加入画像条件带来35.1点增益（0.026→0.377），在画像敏感查询上带来18.6点增益。消融研究表明：去除BM25降至72.3%，去除画像稠密降至72.6%，仅Phase1检索器仅48.3%。与8B规模的Qwen3-Embedding和SkillRouter相比，0.6B参数量的SkillFeed反超，体现领域专用监督对模型规模的补偿作用。统计显著性检验（bootstrap和置换检验）均确认主要差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 论文将LLM代理的技能路由重新定义为画像条件相关性问题，证明仅依赖任务语义无法在用户约束改变适用技能时正确路由。SkillFeed-Bench通过固定任务变化画像的反事实设计，揭示了任务级评估无法暴露的失败模式。SkillFeed通过多源候选召回与画像条件重排序的两阶段设计，将画像信号从被动特征转化为主动判别依据，在画像敏感场景获得最大增益。局限在于科学/技术类细分领域性能较低（Hit@1约45-61%），未来工作将探索从多轮对话中动态提取和更新用户约束。

title: Regime-Aware Portfolio Management via Retrieval-Augmented LLM-Guided Expert Switching
summary: Financial markets are inherently non-stationary, making the effectiveness of individual portfolio-management strategies highly dependent on changing market conditions. This work proposes a retrieval-augmented expert-switching framework that dynamically selects portfolio management experts based on their historical performance under similar market situations. A dual-stream variational autoencoder represents asset-level and market-wide information, while a retrieval-based knowledge base stores historical situations and expert performance. During inference, an instruction-tuned LLM reasons over the retrieved evidence to identify the most appropriate expert rather than directly generating portfolio actions. We further establish a monotonicity property showing that adding a locally superior expert cannot degrade the switching mechanism's performance. Experiments across cryptocurrency, stock, and foreign-exchange markets show that the proposed selector achieves the highest cumulative return and Sharpe ratio among the evaluated selection strategies in all three markets. In the stock market, for example, cumulative return increases from 26% for the best fixed expert to 34%, while the Sharpe ratio improves from 0.74 to 0.96. Ablation results confirm the importance of both retrieval and LLM reasoning, while experiments with different expert-pool sizes demonstrate the value of complementary expertise. Overall, the findings support retrieval-grounded expert switching as an effective approach to adaptive portfolio management in non-stationary financial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成(RAG)与LLM推理的专家动态切换框架,用于非平稳金融市场中的自适应投资组合管理。通过双流变分自编码器编码市场状态,利用检索到的历史相似情境中各专家的表现,并结合指令调优LLM的推理能力来选择最合适的专家,而非直接生成投资组合动作。理论证明了单调性性质,并在加密货币、股票和外汇三个市场验证了优越性。
AI.motivation: 金融市场具有非平稳特性,单一投资组合管理策略在不同市场环境下表现差异显著。传统的均值-方差优化、深度强化学习、混合专家(MoE)等方法存在以下局限:(1)端到端深度学习系统易过拟合训练数据中的市场规律;(2)MoE的门控机制在训练集未覆盖的新市场制度下可靠性下降;(3)LLM直接作为交易代理时表现不稳定。核心动机是将专家选择视为"历史匹配问题"——在当前市场状态下,寻找历史上表现相似的情境下表现最佳的专家。
AI.method:
框架包含离线和在线两部分:
1. **离线索引**:使用双流Transformer-VAE分别编码资产级技术指标(log收益、RSI、MACD、ATR、波动率、成交量等)和市场级宏观特征(趋势、波动率制度、流动性),拼接为统一嵌入h_t。在历史时间窗口中评估所有专家(A2C、DDPG、PPO、TQC、CrossQ)在固定前向持有期(H=5天)的表现,生成包含累积收益、Sharpe比率、最大回撤的Statement of Performance (SoP),存入向量数据库。
2. **在线推理**:编码当前市场状态为h_t,通过KNN检索(K=3,余弦相似度,d=64)最相似的K个历史情境,计算相似度加权性能估计。检索到的SoPs与当前市场描述一起输入指令调优LLM,由LLM进行上下文风险/回报评估和不确定性校准,输出结构化JSON格式的评估结果(包括calculated_rho、confidence_bound_epsilon、regime_separation_margin_tau、tail_optimal_flag)。LLM仅负责选择专家,不直接生成组合权重。
3. **理论框架**:提出三个公理——有界估计误差(ρ_i(s)与真实效用U_i(s)之差≤ε)、保守切换逻辑(τ≥2ε)、专家主导与尾部保护(δ>τ+2ε),证明了"单调性定理":在满足这些条件下,向专家池添加局部优越的新专家不会降低切换机制的性能。
AI.result:
在加密货币(30个币种)、股票(30只美股)、外汇(30个货币对)三个市场进行实验:
1. **选择策略对比**:所提RAG在三个市场均取得最高累积收益和Sharpe比率。股票市场:累积收益从最佳固定专家的26%提升至34%,Sharpe从0.74提升至0.96;加密货币:累积收益从68%提升至71%,Sharpe从1.64提升至1.73;外汇:累积收益从3.2%提升至4.3%,Sharpe从0.71提升至0.88,且显著优于近期收益门控策略(后者在外汇市场为负收益)。
2. **专家池规模消融**:1→4个专家时,Sharpe提升幅度逐渐增大——加密货币0%→19.8%,股票0%→22.0%,外汇0%→27.5%,表明互补专家多样性的重要性。
3. **组件消融**:检索和LLM推理均有贡献。股票市场移除LLM导致累积收益从34%降至25.5%,Sharpe从0.96降至0.735;外汇市场移除LLM导致负收益(-0.2%)和负Sharpe。
4. **LLM敏感性**:索引阶段Qwen3.6-27B-it 100%成功,Gemma4-31B-it 96%,Gemma4-E4B仅28%。推理阶段Qwen3.6-27B-it在三个市场均最优,Gemma4-E4B最弱(外汇Sharpe为-1.07)。
5. **SOTA对比**:所提方法在三个市场均优于AlphaMixRL、TAC、LLM-MAS、Multi-LLM Black-Litterman、Fine-tuned LLaMA等基线,在累积收益、波动率、Sharpe比率和MDD方面均取得最优或接近最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了基于检索增强的专家切换作为非平稳金融环境中自适应投资组合管理有效方法的可行性。核心发现:(1)不同市场没有单一始终占优的专家,需要自适应选择;(2)互补专家多样性是性能提升的关键;(3)检索与LLM推理均对最终性能有实质贡献;(4)LLM作为选择协调器而非直接交易代理的角色定位更为有效;(5)所提框架在加密货币、股票、外汇三类市场均优于现有SOTA方法,具备跨市场泛化能力。局限:每个市场仅单次实验运行(非多种子平均),未独立分离不确定性决策的贡献,未来需在多随机种子、不同时期、交易成本场景下进一步验证。

title: Physics-Guided Flow Matching for CT Image Reconstruction
summary: Deep generative models have recently emerged as powerful priors for solving ill-posed inverse problems in CT, with diffusion-based approaches achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction performance. However, diffusion models typically rely on stochastic sampling procedures, long inference trajectories, and carefully tuned noise schedules, which can limit computational efficiency and numerical stability, especially at high spatial resolutions. In this work, we investigate Flow Matching as an alternative generative prior for CT reconstruction. We train a high-resolution Rectified Flow Matching model on 256x256 chest images from the Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT dataset. To mitigate overfitting and limited anatomical variability, we employ a two-stage training strategy consisting of an initial phase with strong, anatomically informed data augmentation, followed by a fine-tuning phase with reduced or no augmentation to refine structural fidelity. The resulting model is capable of generating high-quality and anatomically coherent CT-like images, serving as a strong learned prior. We then evaluate multiple reconstruction methods specifically designed for Flow Matching models, including Plug-and-Play Flow, FlowDPS, Flower, and Flow-Priors (ICTM), and compare them against state-of-the-art diffusion-based reconstruction algorithms such as DDRM, DPS, and DiffPIR. Experimental results across several CT inverse problem settings show that Flow Matching-based approaches consistently outperform diffusion-based methods in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and perceptual quality, while requiring fewer sampling steps. Finally, we publicly release the trained Flow Matching model and accompanying code to facilitate reproducibility and future research. Overall, this work demonstrates that Flow Matching provides a stable, efficient, and effective alternative to diffusion models for high-resolution CT image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Flow Matching（FM）作为扩散模型的替代先验用于256×256稀疏视图CT重建。作者在Mayo Clinic低剂量CT数据集上训练了首个公开的高分辨率Rectified Flow Matching模型，并采用"强增强+微调"的两阶段训练策略缓解过拟合。系统比较了四种FM重建方法（FlowDPS、PnP-Flow、FLOWER、ICTM）与两种扩散基线（DPS、DDRM），在60/90/120个投影角度下进行评估，FlowDPS在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS上均达到最优性能，且所需采样步数更少。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽在CT逆问题中取得SOTA，但存在随机采样、推理轨迹长、噪声调度敏感等局限，在高分辨率医学影像中尤为突出。本文旨在探索Flow Matching这一基于确定性ODE的生成先验，验证其在CT重建中的稳定性、效率和重建质量优势。
AI.method: 1）在Mayo Clinic低剂量CT数据集（3306张256×256胸部切片，来自10名患者）上训练Rectified Flow Matching模型，采用ResidualAttentionUNet骨干（4层、64/128/256/256通道，最深两层带自注意力）；2）两阶段训练：第一阶段使用旋转、翻转、弹性形变（α=120, σ=6）等强增强训练500个epoch（学习率1e-4），第二阶段降低增强（α=15, σ=4）微调100个epoch（学习率5e-5）以恢复结构保真度；3）评估四种FM重建方法（FlowDPS、PnP-Flow、FLOWER、ICTM）与扩散基线（DPS、DDRM）；4）关键技术处理：图像域[-1,1]与物理域[0,1]映射、梯度归一化因子γ=1/(H√N_α)、基于CGLS的校正以处理ASTRA反投影非严格伴随问题；5）评估指标：KID（无条件生成）、PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS（重建质量）。
AI.result: 1）无条件生成：FM在所有步数下KID均低于扩散基线，低步数时优势尤其显著；两阶段训练使KID再降10-20%；2）重建（60/90/120角度）：FlowDPS达到最优PSNR（36.19/36.56/36.64 dB）、SSIM（0.9162/0.9230/0.9260）和LPIPS（0.1759/0.1653/0.1576），全面优于DDRM（PSNR 35.30/35.89/36.21）和DPS（28.51/30.75/32.76 dB）；3）LPIPS差距尤为显著（如60角度下DDRM 0.2768 vs FlowDPS 0.1759）；4）定性上FM方法保留更清晰的解剖细节，抑制条纹伪影，尤其在60角度极端稀疏条件下优势明显；5）PnP-Flow和ICTM能恢复底部细小对称骨结构，而FlowDPS、DPS、DDRM在该区域存在失败。
AI.conclusion: Flow Matching是扩散模型的稳定、高效、有效替代方案，特别适合高分辨率稀疏视图CT重建。其确定性ODE特性、更少的采样步数、更低的数值敏感性以及更高的感知质量，构成了优于扩散先验的实际优势。开源的预训练模型和代码将促进后续研究。未来方向包括高阶ODE求解器、与物理约束的更紧密耦合以及向三维/动态CT重建的扩展。

title: Finding Where the Buck Stops: An Automated Failure Attribution-Based Reflection Framework for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown promise for complex tasks but suffer from high failure rates. Current self-reflection methods for MAS require all agents to reflect upon failure, overlooking a critical reality: failures typically stem from a specific agent leading the task astray, namely the decisive error agent, while others merely fulfill their regular duties. Forcing regular-behaving agents to reflect contaminates their memory with wrong insights. Hence, we propose DoCtOR (Diagnose-then-Correct PPO-enhanced Reflection), a novel reflection framework that enhances multi-agent collaboration. DoCtOR first identifies the decisive error step and decisive error agent through automated failure attribution, then employs counterfactual reasoning to generate a corrected decisive error step, and finally engages only the decisive error agent to produce targeted reflections. Experimental results show DoCtOR achieves 22%, 26%, and 27% improvements over initial success rates on HotPotQA, ChartQAPro, and Mind2Web datasets, outperforming Reflexion, Retroformer, and COPPER. We further establish the generalizability of our diagnose-then-correct paradigm and demonstrate that in low-resource settings, focusing reflection on reasoning steps after the decisive error step achieves comparable quality to reflecting on the complete failure trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoCtOR框架，通过自动失败归因识别"决定性错误智能体"并进行针对性反思，解决了多智能体系统中强制全员反思导致正常行为智能体记忆污染的问题，显著提升了多智能体协作的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）失败率高达60%-86.7%，现有自反思方法（如COPPER）要求所有智能体对失败进行反思，但忽视了失败通常由特定"决定性错误智能体"导致这一关键事实，强制正常行为智能体反思会产生错误洞察，污染其记忆并引入新错误。
AI.method: DoCtOR框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 诊断子模块（ProFA）—— 基于过程奖励模型为每个推理步骤分配正确性分数，将首个错误步骤识别为决定性错误步骤，定位决定性错误智能体；(2) 修正子模块—— 利用反事实推理生成修正后的决定性错误步骤，并通过ProFA验证其正确性；(3) 反思器模型—— 仅由决定性错误智能体基于失败轨迹生成针对性反思，采用三阶段RLHF流程（SFT→奖励建模→PPO）进行微调。
AI.result: 在HotPotQA、ChartQAPro和Mind2Web三个数据集上，DoCtOR分别比初始成功率提升22%、26%和27%，优于Reflexion、Retroformer和COPPER基线；ProFA在智能体级准确率上提升4%-35%，步骤级准确率上提升9%-28%；诊断-修正范式具有可推广性，在低资源设置下，仅对决定性错误步骤之后的推理步骤进行反思即可达到与完整轨迹反思相当的质量。
AI.conclusion: DoCtOR通过"诊断-修正"范式有效解决了多智能体系统反思中的记忆污染问题，显著提升了协作性能。该框架具有通用性，可推广至其他提示型反思方法，且在计算资源受限场景下具有实用价值。

title: RECAST: Recent & Context-Aware Sampling for Test-Time Adaptation in Streaming Biosignals
summary: Streaming biosignals vary across subjects and drift over time, so population-trained models lose accuracy during long-term monitoring. Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables online personalization by updating the model on incoming samples. But in a stream, a basic question is left open: \emph{which samples should drive each update?} Using all buffered samples blurs the update with irrelevant segments. Using only the latest segment makes the update noisy and unstable. The most useful samples are recent, aligned with the current physiological state, and reliable enough to learn from. We propose \textbf{RECAST} (REcent \& Context-Aware Sampling for TTA), a lightweight sampling module for buffered TTA frameworks. RECAST builds each adaptation batch from three signals: temporal recency, contextual similarity, and predictive reliability. It changes only which samples are used, leaving the model and the training objective unchanged. On two blood-pressure datasets, RECAST improves estimation accuracy and trend tracking over baselines and ablations. The per-patient gains are statistically significant on both datasets, with broad improvement on the regular benchmark and gains concentrated on the hardest patients in the emergency-department setting. RECAST stays practical, adding only sub-second latency per segment on a single GPU and CPU core.

AI.tldr: RECAST 是一个面向流式生理信号测试时自适应（TTA）的轻量级样本选择插件，融合时间近因、上下文相似性和预测可靠性三重准则，在两个血压估计数据集上显著优于现有基线，且仅引入亚秒级延迟。
AI.motivation: 流式生理信号存在两个时序特性：(1) 非平稳性（渐进式分布漂移）使旧样本不再代表当前状态；(2) 突发转变（活动或临床事件引起的快速状态切换）使仅依赖最近样本的更新变得不稳定。现有 TTA 框架在缓冲样本使用上仅采取"全部使用"或"仅用最新"两种极端策略，前者引入无关片段，后者更新高方差且易过拟合，因此需要一种更智能的样本选择机制。
AI.method: RECAST 作为可插入的采样模块，集成于 Test-Time Calibration (TTC) 框架内部，包含三个互补准则：(1) 时间近因——通过指数衰减函数降低旧样本权重，对抗漂移；(2) 上下文相似性——在编码器潜在空间中计算余弦相似度，应对突发转变；(3) 预测可靠性——通过 MC Dropout（S=20 次）估计认知不确定性，作为安全过滤。前两者融合为单一联合评分 s̃ = Sim(z_t, z_i) · exp(-λ_t · a_i)，后者作为附加筛选 (m_i = (s̃_i ≥ τ_sim) ∧ (ũ_i ≤ τ_unc))。每个适应批次保持 25% 标签比例，仅编码器更新，预测头冻结。
AI.result: 在 PulseDB（279 个测试会话）和 MC-MED（2,244 名患者）两个血压估计基准上，RECAST 在所有三个目标（Total/SBP/DBP）上均取得最低 MAE 和 RMSE 及最高相关性：PulseDB Total MAE 为 9.51（相对 TTC 降低 5.4%，相对 No TTA 降低 61%）；MC-MED Total MAE 为 19.44（相对 TTC 降低 3.0%，相对 No TTA 降低 34%）。配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验在两个数据集上均显示统计学显著改进（p ≈ 1.3×10⁻¹⁶ 和 1.4×10⁻⁹）。PulseDB 上 74.6% 会话获得改善，MC-MED 上 55.0% 患者获得改善。消融实验表明三个准则互补：移除相似性或不确定性均会退化，仅用最近样本性能最差。计算开销方面，RECAST 每段延迟约为 429 ms（PulseDB）和 436 ms（MC-MED），仅占数据采集窗口的约 4% 和 0.7%。
AI.conclusion: 样本选择是缓冲式流式 TTA 中一个关键但未充分指定的旋钮。RECAST 通过显式建模时间近因、上下文相似性和预测可靠性，无需改动模型架构或训练目标即可在统计学显著地提升个性化血压估计的准确性与趋势跟踪能力。其增益依赖于患者内变异性：对几乎平稳的患者收益有限，但对存在漂移与突变的患者改善最大。该方法为流式 TTA 提供了一个通用、即插即用的采样增强方案。

title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
summary: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whether success or failure reflects the loop's guidance or the coding agent's ability to carry out the task. We introduce LoopArena, a benchmark for evaluating how well one model can guide a separate coding agent through a long-running task. The model under evaluation is the \textbf{Controller}: after each coding round, it receives a structured summary of the run and instructs a separate, fixed coding agent, the \textbf{Worker}, on what to do or verify next, or decides whether to stop. LoopArena evaluates this ability in three complementary settings that differ in execution scope and cost. Type I scores next-step Loop Contract selection through execution-validated questions without running the Worker at evaluation time. Type II executes repeated control over a selected slice of a full task, while Type III evaluates the paired full task from its original state. On full tasks, the best observed Strict Success Rate is \textbf{24.69\%}, leaving substantial room for improvement in long-horizon loop control. Across Controllers, the paired reduction in estimated inference cost averages \textbf{64.4\%}, and Type II produces a similar ordering under the main Core criterion (Spearman's \(\rho=\textbf{0.9747}\)). We release the benchmark data and evaluation code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LoopArena 是一个评估模型作为运行时控制器（Controller）来引导外部编码智能体（Worker）完成长时程代码任务能力的基准，包含 Type I（决策层，无 Worker 执行）、Type II（任务片段执行层）和 Type III（完整任务执行层）三种互补设置。
AI.motivation: 随着 Loop Engineering 的兴起，开发者通过循环来管理编码智能体，但端到端的最终结果无法区分成功或失败究竟来自循环的引导还是编码智能体本身的能力。需要一种方法独立衡量模型对编码智能体的运行时循环控制能力。
AI.method: 采用 Controller-Worker 双智能体架构：被评估的模型作为 Controller，在每轮编码后基于 Reporter 生成的结构化 Evidence Packet 发出 Loop Contract（advance/verify/stop）指令；Worker（固定 Qwen3.7-Plus）执行具体编码。设置三种评估粒度：Type I（不执行 Worker，仅四选一）、Type II（从中间状态评估任务片段）、Type III（从原始状态评估完整任务）。Type I 的正确选项通过双独立回放调度确定。
AI.result: 在完整任务（Type III）上，最佳严格成功率仅 24.69%（GPT-5.5），各 Controller 范围 16.05%–24.69%；Type II 与 Type III 在主要 Core 标准下排序高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.9747），且推理成本平均降低 64.4%；Type I 契约准确率范围 72.22%–87.78%。固定目标重述基线在 Type III 上不优于无控制。
AI.conclusion: LoopArena 首次将长时程编码循环的运行时控制能力作为直接评估对象，证实当前模型在该能力上仍有大幅提升空间，且有效循环控制必须基于执行证据自适应，而非仅持续重述目标。Type II 作为低成本评估设置可较好替代 Type III。

title: Memristive-Friendly Hadamard Reservoir Computing: Structured, Multiplier-Free Recurrences at Scale
summary: Reservoir Computing (RC) designs Recurrent Neural Networks around a fixed, i.e., untrained, recurrent layer, and is a natural candidate for neuromorphic hardware. Memristive-friendly reservoirs derive the neuron dynamics from memristive-device kinetics, but still rely on dense recurrent matrices, which are expensive to realize physically. In this paper, we replace the dense matrix with a structured orthogonal operator, built from sign diagonals, a permutation, and a fast Walsh-Hadamard transform. The operator is multiplier-free, requires $O(N)$ parameters and $O(N\log N)$ operations per step, and is never materialized as a matrix. We instantiate it in a standard and in a memristive-friendly Echo State Network, with one binary input connection per unit. Our mathematical analysis shows that exact orthogonality yields an echo state condition that is tight in the recurrent scaling, and a noise response that is predictable at design time. Moreover, the operator mixes the whole state in a single application. Experiments on twenty classification and seven regression benchmarks, at reservoir sizes up to $N = 8192$, show that the structured models match dense orthogonal reservoirs, and achieve better mean performance than the cycle reservoir by a margin that widens with size. Furthermore, we time the recurrent step on three hardware platforms, where it is up to $50\times$ faster than a dense product and $10^4\times$ smaller in memory. Finally, we ablate the operator and measure the response to noise, quantization, device mismatch and discrete faults.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于储层计算（Reservoir Computing）的结构化正交循环算子M = D₂ Ĥ_N Π D₁，由符号对角矩阵、置换矩阵和归一化Walsh-Hadamard变换构成，可作为密集循环矩阵的替代品。该算子无需乘法运算，每步仅需O(N log N)次加法/减法和O(N)个参数。将其应用于标准回声状态网络（H-ESN）和忆阻友好型网络（MF-H-ESN），在20个分类和7个回归基准测试中（最大N=8192）验证了其性能与密集正交储层相当，且优于循环储层（SCR）。算子的精确正交性使回声状态条件紧致、噪声响应可在设计时预测。在CPU和GPU上比密集矩阵乘法快达50倍，内存占用减少10⁴倍。
AI.motivation: 储层计算（RC）是神经形态硬件的自然候选，但其循环耦合通常依赖密集随机矩阵，导致O(N²)的存储和计算开销，这在物理实现中代价高昂。现有的硬件友好替代方案（极简循环拓扑SCR或密集正交矩阵）各有权衡：SCR信息传播慢，密集正交矩阵存储和计算成本仍为O(N²)。因此需要一个兼具正交性、全局混合性以及乘数无关（multiplier-free）特性的结构化算子来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 1) 提出结构化正交算子M = D₂ Ĥ_N Π D₁，由两个±1符号对角矩阵D₁、D₂、随机置换矩阵Π和归一化Walsh-Hadamard变换Ĥ_N组成，通过FWHT以O(N log N)次加法/减法实现，参数仅O(N)。2) 将其嵌入标准leaky ESN得到H-ESN，嵌入忆阻友好型ESN得到MF-H-ESN，并通过二值化输入路径（每单元一个二进制输入连接）构建简化输入变体（_si）。3) 理论分析证明精确正交性使ESP条件紧致于ρ_M，噪声增益在设计时即可确定。4) 消融研究确认三个组件各司其职：Hadamard变换提供单步全局混合，置换保护边缘稳定性附近的记忆，符号对角矩阵在退化输入下保持非线性状态的多样性。5) 在三个硬件平台（Apple M3 Pro CPU、NVIDIA T4 GPU、A100 GPU）上进行时间基准测试，评估对噪声、量化、器件失配和离散故障的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1) 性能方面：H-ESN在N=256时20个分类任务上平均准确率达0.823（最佳），在N=8192时仍保持最佳排名（3.4）；MF-H-ESN_si在所有规模下均为分类任务的最佳排名模型。2) 效率方面：在CPU和T4 GPU上N≈1024时超过密集矩阵乘法，N=32768时快约50倍；A100上交叉点移至N≈8192。3) 内存：N=8192时算子仅需15.4 kB（vs 密集的268 MB），减少约1.7×10⁴倍；简化输入变体整个储层仅17.4 kB，仅含3个模拟值。4) 鲁棒性：8位量化几乎无损失（≤4.4点）；20%器件失配最多损失2.3点；5%符号翻转或路由故障损失<1点。5) 统计显著性：Friedman-Nemenyi检验将GRU与最佳储层分开，8个储层模型间无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Hadamard储层计算以结构化正交算子替代密集循环矩阵，实现了O(N log N)计算和O(N)参数的无乘法实现，且不牺牲精度。在27个基准测试上与密集正交储层性能相当，显著优于循环储层（SCR），且全球混合性使优势随规模扩大而增大。精确正交性消除了密集随机储层中基于范数的稳定性条件中的松弛，使ESP条件紧致于调节标量。储层描述几乎完全离散化（符号+路由索引+单一增益），赋予模型对器件失配、符号翻转和路由故障的强大内在鲁棒性。该方法弥合了极简循环拓扑和密集正交矩阵之间的鸿沟，是迈向忆阻物理实现的有力候选。

title: MAIL: Memory-driven, Adaptive, Incremental, and Literature-grounded Framework for Hypothesis Generation in Chemistry
summary: The ever-expanding volume of the chemical literature offers unprecedented opportunities to generate novel and impactful hypotheses. However, the bottleneck lies in efficiently navigating this vast knowledge base to formulate high-quality, experimentally meaningful insights. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for this task, existing methods often rely on static inspiration corpora, predefined heuristics, or laborious human-in-the-loop pipelines and decision-support frameworks that limit scalability and novelty. In this work, we propose an automated approach, a Memory-augmented, Adaptive, Incremental, and Literature-grounded (MAIL) framework for hypothesis generation in chemistry. Our MAIL method formulates hypothesis generation as a temporally grounded, memory-driven reasoning process, where hypotheses emerge from an evolving conceptual path that continuously accumulates and reinterprets prior knowledge. We evaluated the MAIL framework on a public TOMATO-Chem dataset and a newly curated and disseminated high-novelty nature/science challenge (HN-NS) dataset. Across both datasets, MAIL generates structurally coherent and mechanistically plausible hypotheses, achieves the highest MIOS and MPOS by more effectively recovering the central ideas and methodological elements of the historical target hypotheses, and obtains the highest overall expert-evaluation scores for scientific quality. These results demonstrate the potential of LLMs to autonomously explore chemical domains and generate hypotheses that are both innovative and chemically plausible.

AI.tldr: MAIL是一个用于化学假设生成的自动化框架，通过动态文献检索、多轮迭代精炼和自适应提示，将假设生成建模为基于时间的记忆驱动推理过程。在TOMATO-Chem和新构建的HN-NS数据集上均取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 化学文献的爆炸式增长为科学发现提供了前所未有的机会，但如何高效地从海量知识中提炼出高质量、可实验验证的假设仍是瓶颈。现有基于LLM的方法依赖静态灵感语料库、预定义启发式或人工干预，限制了其可扩展性和新颖性。本文旨在构建一个全自动、无需人工干预的化学假设生成框架。
AI.method: MAIL框架将假设生成建模为时序的、记忆驱动的推理过程，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于LLM引导的文献检索模块——利用关键词提取和布尔查询构建，从PubMed、CrossRef和Semantic Scholar按时间分区（如pre-2015、2015–2020、2021–2023）动态检索文献；(2) 增量精炼与自我评估机制——每轮基于前一假设和反馈进行假设更新，包含有效性、新颖性、意义和潜力四个维度的结构化自评；(3) 提示自适应与假设选择——采用压缩上下文记忆（类似MCV）维护概念一致性，并通过多轮候选精炼和最终选择生成最优假设。整个流程无需人工干预，经过3轮精炼，每轮生成8-10个候选假设。
AI.result: 在TOMATO-Chem数据集上，MAIL达到Top MIOS 4.27、Avg MIOS 3.69、Top MPOS 3.91、Avg MPOS 2.38，均优于MOOSE-Chem等6个基线方法；在新构建的高难度HN-NS数据集（50篇Nature/Science论文）上，同样取得最佳性能（Avg MIOS 2.61，Avg MPOS 2.09）。专家盲评中MAIL总分10.80 vs MOOSE-Chem 10.32（TOMATO-Chem）和8.63 vs 8.33（HN-NS）。消融实验验证了迭代精炼、上下文感知检索、反馈推理和提示优化的必要性。跨模型实验（Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1系列）表明MAIL的改进具有模型无关性。
AI.conclusion: MAIL证明了LLM在无需人工干预和预定义语料库的情况下，能够自主探索化学领域并生成创新且化学上合理的假设，为AI辅助化学发现提供了稳健基础。迭代、文献驱动的推理是有效利用LLM推动科学研究前沿的关键。局限包括尚未进行湿实验验证、计算成本较高、当前评估侧重于有机和材料化学，以及需关注双重用途风险。

title: Real-Valued Hyperdimensional Sequence Representations with Hadamard Product Binding and Shift Equivariance
summary: Encoding temporal order is a fundamental requirement for sequence representations in Hyperdimensional Computing. Fractional Power Encoding provides similarity-preserving position vectors whose inner products approximate shift-invariant kernels, and it supports shift-equivariant transformations of encoded sequence representations. However, standard formulations of Fractional Power Encoding are primarily designed for binding operations such as circular convolution or complex-valued multiplication, which limits their compatibility with Hadamard product binding of real-valued vectors. This paper develops real-valued position encodings motivated by Random Fourier Features, aiming to retain the desirable properties of Fractional Power Encoding while supporting Hadamard-based operations. We propose three real-valued position-encoding variants: a real-valued baseline based on the inverse Fourier transform, and Sinusoid and Cosine-only representations derived from Random Fourier Features. Among them, the Sinusoid variant provides an explicit algebraic shift operator, allowing temporal shifts to be applied directly to the vector-encoded sequence representation without re-encoding the shifted sequence. Experiments on time-series classification datasets show that the proposed real-valued representations achieve performance comparable to standard Fractional Power Encoding while enabling computationally efficient Hadamard product binding. The Sinusoid variant offers the most favorable trade-off, combining efficient real-valued implementation with exact shift-equivariant transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种实数值位置编码变体（基于随机傅里叶特征），使超维计算中基于Hadamard积绑定的序列表示能够保持类FPE的相似性结构和移位等变性，其中Sinusoid变体支持显式的代数移位算子。
AI.motivation: 标准分数幂编码（FPE）依赖循环卷积或复数域乘法作为绑定操作，无法直接兼容Multiply-Add-Permute（MAP）等高效实数值HDC/VSA模型所使用的Hadamard积绑定，这限制了FPE在实数值序列编码中的应用。
AI.method: 本文提出三种位置编码变体：（A）通过逆傅里叶变换将复数FPE映射到实数空间作为基线；（B）基于随机傅里叶特征的Sinusoid表示，由正弦和余弦分量构成，支持通过三角恒等式实现显式的代数移位算子⋄；（C）仅含余弦的简化表示。设计依据五项要求：Hadamard兼容性（R1）、相似性保持（R2）、范数稳定（R3）、移位等变性（R4）和计算效率（R5）。
AI.result: 在时间序列分类任务中，三种变体在HDC-MiniROCKET和HDC-MultiROCKET-HYDRA框架上达到与标准FPE相当的准确率（平均相对准确率提升约1.1%–1.4%）。Sinusoid变体在D=1000时实现约5倍的移位操作加速，并在正确移位处相似度达到1.0，验证了精确移位等变性。Cosine变体计算更简单但缺乏等变算子。
AI.conclusion: Sinusoid变体在保持相似性核的同时支持实数值显式移位算子，将计算复杂度从O(D log D)降至O(D)，是兼容Hadamard积绑定的实数值序列表示中最具优势的方案。Cosine变体适用于对计算简洁性优先的场景。该工作表明相似性保持的位置编码可以与HDC/VSA中的Hadamard积绑定有效集成。

title: AGENT-O: A Semantic Agent Card Framework for Interoperable and Governed Healthcare AI Agents
summary: AGENT-O is a modular ontology framework that defines a semantic Agent Card for representing health-oriented AI agent systems and supports assessment of reporting completeness in scientific publications. AGENT-O was developed as an OWL 2/RDF ontology covering runtime, models, workflow, tools, clinical use, evaluation, provenance, governance, and reporting assessment. Evaluation included ontology inventory, OWL-RL reasoning, three SHACL suites, 12 SPARQL competency queries, three cases, and model-assisted reporting-completeness assessment of 279 papers across five dimensions. The ontology contained 1,962 RDF triples and 1,922 Protege axioms, with 252 active classes, 198 active object properties, and 51 datatype properties. All SHACL suites conformed on example graphs, all competency queries returned prespecified evidence, and all 279 papers were scored. Incomplete reporting was highest for runtime/architecture (84.6%), governance/safety (82.8%), and provenance/reproducibility (78.1%), compared with evaluation (25.8%) and benchmark-process alignment (29.8%). AGENT-O supported semantic Agent Card representation and reporting assessment while revealing an evaluation-specification gap: evaluation and benchmark procedures were reported more consistently than runtime architecture, governance, and reproducibility. AGENT-O provides a reusable ontology, semantic Agent Card profile, and reporting-completeness workflow for structured reporting and gap identification, but does not assess agent quality or deployment readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGENT-O模块化本体，以语义Agent Card表征医疗AI Agent系统，并对科学论文报告完整性进行评估。覆盖本体设计、多维验证（SHACL/SPARQL/案例）及279篇论文打分，发现评估规范缺口：运行架构、治理与可复现性报告严重不足（78%~84.6%）。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI Agent相关论文的报告完整性差异大、缺乏统一语义框架，难以系统化揭示研究规范缺口。
AI.method: 基于OWL 2/RDF构建模块化本体（覆盖runtime/models/workflow/tools/clinical use/evaluation/provenance/governance），定义语义Agent Card；通过本体清单、OWL-RL推理、3套SHACL约束、12个SPARQL能力问题、3个案例及对279篇论文的5维度报告完整性评估进行验证。
AI.result: 本体含1,962个RDF三元组、1,922个Protégé公理（252个活跃类、198个对象属性、51个数据类型属性）；所有SHACL通过、SPARQL查询返回预期证据、279篇论文全部完成评分。报告不完整率最高：运行架构84.6%、治理/安全82.8%、可复现性78.1%；评估25.8%、基准流程对齐29.8%。
AI.conclusion: AGENT-O提供可复用的本体与语义Agent Card配置文件及报告完整性工作流，能识别报告规范缺口，但不评估Agent质量或部署就绪度；凸显"评估-规范差距"（评估与基准流程较规范，运行架构、治理与可复现性显著欠缺）。

title: Propagating construction-time knowledge quality into medical question answering: A framework grounded in clinical guidelines
summary: Large language models have facilitated knowledge graph (KG) construction from clinical guidelines, but extracted triples vary in structural validity and evidential support. Meanwhile, graph-augmented question answering (QA) systems typically optimize query relevance during retrieval, with limited reuse of quality information produced during KG construction. This creates a disconnect between construction-time quality control and inference-time evidence use. We investigate whether construction-time triple quality can serve as a persistent signal for downstream evidence selection and presentation. We propose a quality-aware framework that models structural conformance (SchemaConf) and evidential support (EvidScore) as complementary dimensions and fuses them into a per-triple quality signal, Q(t). Rather than using quality solely for filtering, the framework retains Q(t) and derived quality tiers as graph attributes and propagates them into quality-weighted subgraph retrieval and tier-conditioned evidence prompting, while preserving passage-level provenance. Experiments on Chinese diabetes clinical guidelines show that the utility of the quality signal is distribution dependent. Under cross-version and cross-model shift, the fused Q(t) provides stronger triple-quality discrimination than either component alone (AUC 0.748 vs. 0.703 for EvidScore and 0.645 for SchemaConf).
