Although AlphaGeometry achieves near-IMO gold-medalist performance, manually converting natural-language problems into its formal syntax remains a significant usability bottleneck. To address this challenge, we introduce the Natural Language to AlphaGeometry Benchmark (NL2AGBench), which evaluates LLMs in translating English geometry problems into AlphaGeometry-compatible formal representations. NL2AGBench uses execution-based verification within AlphaGeometry to assess translation quality rather than relying solely on textual similarity. We evaluate ten state-of-the-art open- and closed-source LLMs across multiple parameter scales and analyze executable translation accuracy, syntactic correctness, and error characteristics. Our experiments reveal a substantial performance gap between closed- and open-source models: leading closed-source models achieve executable translation rates above 80%, while even the largest open-source models struggle to consistently preserve geometric constraints and produce valid formalizations. We introduce an error taxonomy distinguishing syntax and logic errors and investigate mitigation strategies, including few-shot prompting, fine-tuning, and human-guided hinting, which yield measurable improvements across multiple model families.

AI.tldr: NL2AGBench 是一个针对 AlphaGeometry 系统的大语言模型自动形式化基准测试,用于评估 LLM 将英语几何问题翻译为 AlphaGeometry 专用领域语言(DSL)的能力。该基准采用基于执行的验证方法(在 AlphaGeometry 中实际运行生成的 DSL),而非简单的文本相似度。作者评估了 10 个开源/闭源模型,发现闭源前沿模型可执行翻译率超过 80%,而最大开源模型即使在优化提示下也不到 46%。论文还提出了一个区分语法错误和逻辑错误的错误分类法,并探究了少样本提示、微调和人工引导提示等改进策略。
AI.motivation: AlphaGeometry 在 IMO 几何问题上达到了接近金牌选手的水平,但需要问题以专用 DSL 形式输入。将自然语言几何问题手动形式化是该系统可用性的主要瓶颈。现有基准主要评估证明生成或一般数学推理,缺乏专门评估自然语言到 AlphaGeometry DSL 翻译能力的工作。
AI.method: 从 JGEX 仓库中选取 231 个 AlphaGeometry 形式化问题,筛选 48 个代表性题目构建 NL2AGBench,涵盖多种几何概念(圆、垂心、外心、中点等)。评估框架基于 AlphaGeometry 的实际执行:翻译结果分为成功翻译、语法错误、逻辑错误三类。语法错误细分为 AssertionError(参数数量错误)、KeyError(子句/分隔符误用)、ValueError(几何对象定义不一致);逻辑错误指句法有效但语义错误。提示框架包括官方语法说明、手写规则和目标问题。改进策略包括少样本提示(54 个示例)、两阶段人工引导(基于图示的几何提示 + 针对错误的提示)、以及基于 HAGeo-409 的监督微调。
AI.result: 零样本评估显示明显性能差距:闭源 GPT-5.4 达 75%,Gemini 3.1 达 62.5%,Grok-3 达 52.08%;而开源模型中 Qwen3:235B 仅 12.5%,Llama3.1:70B、Llama3.2:3B、Mistral:7B、Nemotron-3-nano:4B 全部为 0%。少样本提示带来最大增益(开源 Qwen3:235B 提升 33.3 个百分点至 45.8%,Llama3.1:70B 从 0% 升至 23%);人工引导提示在可恢复错误上进一步改进 GPT-5.4(14.29%)、Grok-3(32.14%)等;微调虽改善语法遵循但对可执行翻译准确率提升有限,模型往往学会表面模式而无法捕捉几何语义。
AI.conclusion: NL2AGBench 揭示了几何自动形式化的核心挑战:成功形式化不仅需要目标语言的句法掌握,还需要准确的几何解释和约束保持。闭源与开源模型之间的显著差距表明数学形式化需要语言理解、几何推理与符号验证的更紧密集成。少样本提示是最具扩展性的策略,而人工引导纠正确认部分翻译失败源于局部歧义而非完全缺乏几何推理能力。论文提出的错误分类法为未来自动形式化系统的诊断和改进提供了实用框架。

title: How Proper Scoring Rules Shape LLM Forecasting
summary: This paper evaluates how reward function choice shapes the performance and behavior of LLM forecasters. We compare five proper scoring rules as training objectives for binary forecasts of resolved real-world events. Although the rules share the same theoretical incentive for truthful probability reporting, the resulting models differ in calibration, probability use, and estimated profiles of bias, information, and noise, with smaller differences in aggregate accuracy and discrimination. The Brier-trained model has the lowest observed Brier score and highest AUC-ROC, while the log-trained model has the highest observed log score and lowest calibration error. Models with similar aggregate performance also reach that performance through different combinations of bias, information, and noise. Proper scoring rules therefore need not behave interchangeably as training objectives. Reward choice may shape not only how well an LLM forecasts, but how its forecasting errors are structured. Each condition uses a single seed, so some differences may reflect training stochasticity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了五种严格恰当评分规则（对数、Brier、球形、Beta(2,8)、Beta(8,8)）作为LLM预测任务的GRPO强化学习终局奖励时，对模型行为的影响差异。尽管这些规则在理论上都激励真实概率报告，但在有限训练设置下，它们导致了不同的校准、概率使用和偏差-信息-噪声分解剖面。Brier训练模型在Brier分数和AUC-ROC上最优，对数训练模型在对数分数和ECE上最优。
AI.motivation: 恰当评分规则在理论上对真实概率报告具有相同的最优激励，但它们在曲率、有界性、尾部行为和强调的概率区域上有所不同。在GRPO这类基于分组相对优势的有限策略优化下，这些几何差异可能产生不同的学习信号，导致学习到的预测器具有不同的行为特征。研究激励在于探讨理论上等价的评分规则在实践训练中是否真正可互换。
AI.method: 使用Dr. GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization变体）对GPT-OSS-120B模型进行LoRA微调（rank=32），数据集为8,041个二元预测问题（7,076训练/965评估），涵盖政治、地缘政治、经济等领域的已解决新闻事件，预测期限7-90天。仅改变奖励函数（5种恰当评分规则），保持模型、数据、优化器、训练步数、rollout预算和超参数固定。每种条件使用单一随机种子。主要评估采用5次采样的合并评估。分析方法包括聚合分数、ECE、AUC-ROC，以及Satopää等人(2021)的偏差-信息-噪声(BIN)分解。
AI.result: 所有奖励训练变体均优于未训练基线模型。Brier训练模型实现最佳Brier分数(0.1648)和AUC-ROC(0.7511)；对数训练模型实现最佳对数分数(-0.5132)和最低ECE(0.0434)。BIN分解显示不同奖励产生不同的误差剖面：Beta(2,8)有最大偏差贡献，Brier有最大信息贡献，对数有较大正向噪声贡献，而球形和Beta(8,8)有负向噪声贡献抵消了部分增益。统计显著性方面，对数、Brier、球形、Beta(2,8)在Brier分数上相对基线在1%水平显著，Beta(8,8)在5%水平显著。奖励条件在训练中生成的token数差异显著（约7倍），导致实际token级计算量不同。
AI.conclusion: 理论上等价的恰当评分规则在有限训练的LLM预测中并非可互换。奖励选择不仅影响预测准确性，还影响预测误差的结构组织方式。这提示奖励选择可作为调控偏差-信息-噪声权衡的杠杆，不同奖励训练的模型可能为预测集成提供互补的错误剖面。局限性包括：单一基础模型、单一数据集、单一训练种子、固定超参数、未针对每种奖励单独调优、token级计算量不均等。

title: On the Maintenance and Co-evolution of Agent Plugins: An Empirical Study of Claude Code Plugin Marketplaces
summary: AI coding agents, software tools that automate development tasks through reasoning and tool use, are increasingly extended through plugin marketplaces, yet the structure, maintenance, and co-evolution dynamics of these emerging repositories remain empirically unexplored. Unlike traditional software packages that deliver functionality through source code, agent plugins deliver functionality through a combination of natural-language instruction files, scripts, and configuration files, raising the question of whether these plugins are maintained artifacts that co-evolve across components, or one-off artifacts that developers write once and do not need to revisit. To study the maintenance and co-evolution of agent plugins, we conduct an empirical study of 1,926 repositories hosting Claude Code plugin marketplaces, analyzing 8,351 plugins and 77,773 commits across 2,018 marketplaces. We find that the marketplace is expanding rapidly, plugin-touching commit activity growing 8.8x over six months after the October 2025 launch, and plugins targeting Software Engineering tasks accounting for 61.3% of all plugins. Plugin development is predominantly feature-driven, with feature commits occurring at more than twice the rate of conventional open-source software (OSS) (39.6% vs. 17.2%). Claude co-authors 34.9% of all commits, and four commit types (docs, perf, style, and refactor) carry substantially different meanings in plugin repositories than in traditional software. Most component types evolve independently, but within skills directories, natural-language instruction files and implementation scripts co-evolve at above-chance rates, with 78% of co-changes being functionally coupled, representing a new class of maintenance dependency not observed in traditional software engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Claude Code 插件市场进行了首次大规模实证研究，分析了 1,926 个仓库中的 8,351 个插件和 77,773 次提交，发现 AI 原生插件仓库是一类全新的软件制品，其自然语言指令文件与脚本之间存在传统软件工程中未观察到的新型维护依赖。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理通过插件市场进行扩展，但与传统软件包不同，代理插件的主要交付物是自然语言指令文件而非源代码，其维护和协同演化动态尚未得到系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立 AI 原生软件制品的实证基线，并检验传统软件工程方法是否适用于这一新制品类别。
AI.method: 本文采用混合方法进行大规模实证研究：（1）通过 GitHub Code Search API 发现托管 marketplace.json 的仓库，经过 10 星阈值筛选后获得 1,926 个仓库；（2）采用两阶段管道（正则匹配 + GPT-5-mini）按 Conventional Commits Specification (CCS) 对 77,773 次提交分类；（3）对 700 次提交进行分层手动开放编码，识别 CCS 类型在插件仓库中的语义偏移；（4）对 docs/ci/style 类型进行重新分类；（5）使用关联规则挖掘（Support、Confidence、Lift、卡方检验）在组件间和组件内两个层面分析协同演化；（6）对 64 个脚本-Markdown 共变更 PR 进行手动编码，构建耦合分类法并用 LLM 扩展。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：（1）软件工程类插件占 61.3%，34.4% 的插件组合多种组件类型；（2）插件相关提交活动在 6 个月内增长 8.8 倍；（3）feat 提交占 39.6%，是传统开源软件（17.2%）的两倍多；（4）Claude 共同署了 34.9% 的提交；（5）docs、perf、style、refactor 四种 CCS 类型在插件仓库中具有与传统软件不同的含义（docs 经重新分类后从 10.3% 降至 1.7%）；（6）大多数组件独立演化，但 skills 目录内脚本与 Markdown 文件存在高于概率的协同演化（78% 功能耦合），代表了一种新的维护依赖关系；（7）agents-commands 是唯一在组件层面高于概率共变更的组件对（Lift=1.40）。
AI.conclusion: AI 原生插件仓库是一种本质上区别于传统 OSS 制品的软件类别。由于主要制品是自然语言指令文件，传统面向代码的度量、提交分类器和维护假设不再直接适用。研究人员应将 AI 面向的 Markdown 视为一等软件制品，开发专用于自然语言内容的分析方法，并建立代码-指令一致性检查技术。插件开发者修改脚本时应同步更新 SKILL.md，修改 agent 或 command 定义时应验证交叉引用的一致性。

title: An Enclosed Mode Is a Gauge Choice: Topology Relative to Reach in Certified Code World Models
comment: 33 pages, 2 figures. Paper 3 of a series (companion papers: arXiv:2607.14169 , arXiv:2608.17956 ). Code, data, and Lean formalization: this https URL
summary: A code world model accepted by a sampling gate can be exactly right on everything the gate can see and arbitrarily wrong beyond it. We characterize what a certified model can know, and what its errors can cost, when the omission is an annular freeze mode enclosing an unreachable interior. The gate quotient makes the question precise: acceptance-with-certainty determines the model exactly on the reachable query set; beyond reach is gauge. On a minimal ring instrument we prove the extreme case (a wrong-topology filled-disc artifact unfalsifiable by any sampling gate and bitwise harmless at play) and measure, with LLM synthesis across three model families, how one knob (a channel of width gamma) walks the same artifact through three regimes: unfalsifiable-and-harmless, falsifiable-and-costly, and instantly falsified. Three principles organize the empirics. First, danger is topology relative to reach: a channel the planner can use collapses the blind model's exploitation (play cost 1.09 to ~0 over a knee at gamma ~ 0.1), while a hidden channel with the same first Betti number keeps it at full strength (1.12). Second, repair is parameter-bound and sensor-bound: no family recovers the region from outside evidence; from inside, models pose the right topology but cannot pin its parameters, and the posed topology tracks the guiding persistent-homology summary's wrong beta_1 (a sensor with a measured geometric resolution limit), not the truth. Third, mitigation must match the error's dimension and direction: point fences fail against the one-dimensional boundary, a dimension-matched persisted fence collapses exploitation to a two-lesson transient (0.999 to 0.058), and the dual freedom certificate collapses the invented-mode failure symmetrically (1.769 to 0.029). In n dimensions the shell makes misidentification near-certain while the danger stays fully exploitable: the two axes are independent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代码世界模型(CWM)中采样门认证的局限性，聚焦于"封闭模式"(一个环形冻结带包围不可达内部)场景。核心结论是：采样门仅能认证模型在可达查询集上的行为，超出可达范围的错误本质上是一种"规范选择"(gauge choice)，无法被任何采样门证伪。论文通过一个最小化的环形仪器，在三种LLM家族上系统测量了一个旋角通道宽度γ如何将同一错误拓扑伪影在三种状态间切换：不可证伪且无害、可证伪且代价高昂、瞬时可证伪。三大核心发现：(1)危险是拓扑相对于可达性的，而非拓扑本身——面向规划器的通道使盲模型的利用崩溃，而同等宽度的隐藏通道(相同β₁)保持完全利用强度；(2)修复受参数和传感器分辨率双重限制——从外部证据无法恢复，从内部可建立正确拓扑但无法定位参数，且所建立的拓扑跟随的是持久同调摘要的错误报告而非真值；(3)缓解措施必须匹配错误维度和方向——点围栏(零维覆盖)对一维边界失效，维度匹配且跨回合持续的"神经围栏"将利用压缩为两回合瞬态(0.999→0.058)，对偶的"自由补丁"证书对称地解决了虚构模式的失败(1.769→0.029)。在n维中，封闭壳使错误合成近乎确定(r(n)→0)而危险仍可被完全利用——罕见性和可达性是相互独立的两个轴。
AI.motivation: 代码世界模型(CWM)范式中，语言模型合成可执行世界模型供经典规划器搜索，模型通过重现采样轨迹被接受(即"采样门"认证)。两篇前作已确立此门认证错误的事实的定量法则：danger = play_cost × (1−rarity)^N。前作最后指出"从数据修复"是几何依赖的，并将机制定位于"模板先验"。本文接过幸存的那条轴——拓扑——并表明正确的表述不是模式的拓扑，而是其拓扑相对于认证过程和规划器所能到达的范围。这在"封闭模式"(环形冻结带包围高奖励幻影矿脉)上成为最简设置，因为其定义特征(洞)从外部观察不可见。
AI.method: 方法包含四个层面：①**理论核心**(第3节)：定义可达查询集ℛ，提出"门商"命题(Proposition 1)——以确定性被接受的模型仅在ℛ上与真值一致，超出部分为规范(Proposition 1)；证明闭合环上错误拓扑的填充圆盘伪影既不可被任何采样门证伪又在规划时逐位无害(Proposition 2，配对种子MPC逐回合确认)；通过共同随机数耦合证明接触率r(γ)单调非增(Proposition 3，44000次检查零违规)和连续性(Proposition 4，Hölder-1/2模量)，直接内入口率r_int的单调性通过"漏斗缺陷"修正(Corollary 2，17500×低于效应尺寸)；正性由见证管证明(Proposition 6，Lean机器检查)。②**最小化仪器**RingField2D：2D推力-阻力装置，含环形冻结带(内半径3.5，外5.0)，环绕幻影矿脉；三个预注册旋钮：通道宽度γ弧度、通道朝向、起始侧；n维推广ShellField-n采用球面壳S^{n-1}。③**LLM合成**：三个家族(GPT-5.x mini/large、Qwen、Claude)，使用前作协议(40次rollouts，ε=10^{-9}，至多5次细化)，行为审计(81×81状态网格上的步进偏差集分类)将合成伪影分为盲/点/弧/环/盘/补/无界填充。④**缓解策略**：维度匹配的"神经围栏"(将违规链接为切向延伸段并跨回合持续)+对偶的"自由补丁"(在模型被证伪为过于悲观处局部解冻想象)。所有确定性结果在Lean 4/mathlib中形式化(Paper3Ring库，无sorry)。
AI.result: **核心实证结果**：(1)同一填充圆盘伪影在三种状态下行走：γ=0时不可证伪且play_cost=0.000(逐位等价于真值)，γ=0.6/1.2面向时以~10^{-3}/转移率被证伪且play_cost=0.343/0.220，从内部起始时以0.77-0.97被瞬时证伪。(2)隐藏通道(相同β₁=0)在所有测量上观察上等同于闭合环(play_cost=0.999)，而面向通道在γ≈0.1-0.15处崩溃play_cost 1.09→~0——β₁相同，危险相反。(3)三个LLM家族在外部证据上零家族修复环(A-C单元0/20正确编码模式)；内部起始时模型能建立正确拓扑(闭环/盘)，但修复受参数限制——中位内半径误差固定在0.5(整数"4.0")，不受证据剂量影响(40-320次rollouts零通过)；仅有的门认证内部恢复(1/20)使用盘补形式，其单一参数(真实内半径)锚定于奖励规范。(4)点围栏对环无效(接触率1.0)；维度匹配+持续的神经围栏将play_cost从0.999→0.058(仅2回合瞬态，之后与真值规划器等回报)；自由补丁将虚构模式的play_cost从1.769→0.029(从回合1起近真值回报)。(5)持久同调传感器在γ≤1.2下报告β̂₁=1(真值β₁=0)，所建立伪影拓扑跟随摘要而非真值；翻转发生在γ≈1.8；剂量加四倍时假环率从1/5升至3/5——更多证据强化错误拓扑报告。(6)n维时r(n)几何崩溃(每维因子0.411)，n=4和n=6接触率1/600，n=5时为censored零；真值-MPC在每个n≤6处仍以play_cost≈1.0被完全利用。(7)非分离实心圆环(TubeField3D)：同稀有度、同拓扑，仅管位置改变——on-axis时play_cost=0.898，hole on-axis时play_cost=0.019——证实危险是路径相对的，而精确不可证伪是分离相对的。
AI.conclusion: 采样门认证f限制在可达查询集ℛ上——仅此而已，别无其他。在封闭模式上，该商不再是形式而成为整个故事：错误拓扑伪影可被每个门不可证伪且在运行时逐位无害；同一伪影，旋钮一转，变得可证伪且有代价；同一遗漏，通道转离规划器方向，拓扑不变而危险恢复完全。认证性、正确性和后果性是关于模型错误相对于可达性所处位置的三个不同陈述——永远不是关于模式本身的。对实践者而言：无法到达的围栏是无法认证的围栏，也是在其保持不可达时无法被伤害的围栏；危险恰好存在于遗漏与有能力的规划器最优路径相交之处，并随通道容许一步而越过拐点。修复若可能，需要两件可预先测量的事情：来自边界远侧的证据(内部可达性)和证据传感器在操作采样密度下的拓扑分辨率实际能看到要修复的结构。在任一缺失处，合成循环将做我们在每个测试家族中所做之事：在规范区域中写出看似合理的代码——而门将认证它。三个原则组织的经验总结：危险是拓扑相对于可达的，修复是参数绑定和传感器绑定的，缓解必须匹配错误的维度和方向。

title: Blog: Survey of Optimizers
summary: Neural-network optimization in 2025-2026 is no longer well described as a succession of new Adam variants. The design space has expanded from coordinates to matrices and layers, from fixed training horizons to policies over time, and from mathematical update rules to state representations that must survive sharding and low-precision computation. This survey organizes recent optimizers and training optimization methods along four largely independent axes: temporal estimation, update geometry, horizon management, and representation and systems. It connects the spectral normalization of Muon, the historical matrix statistics of Shampoo and SOAP, adaptive and hybrid matrix methods, memory-efficient optimizers, schedule-free training, small-batch corrections, and quantized optimizer states. The central empirical conclusion is deliberately non-triumphal: matrix-aware methods represent a genuine advance, but there is no context-independent replacement for AdamW. Rankings change with model scale, data-to-parameter ratio, batch size, schedule, parameter partition, tuning budget, and whether the target metric is tokens, FLOPs, wall-clock time, or memory. The practical consequence is a compositional view of optimizer design and a stricter protocol for evaluating optimizer claims.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于2025–2026年神经网络优化器领域的综合性调研文章。作者提出四个相对独立的分析维度——时间估计（temporal estimation）、更新几何（update geometry）、训练周期管理（horizon management）以及表示与系统（representation and systems）——来重新组织当代优化器的设计空间。核心论点是：矩阵感知方法（如Muon的极分解、Shampoo/SOAP的Kronecker白化）确实是实质性进展，但不存在能普遍替代AdamW的优化器；优化器的优劣完全依赖于规模、数据参数比、批量大小、调度策略、参数路由、精度等多重协议条件。文章还涉及内存高效优化、免调度训练、小批量修正以及量化优化器状态等主题，最终倡导一种"组合式"的优化器设计视角和更严格的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 传统上优化器选择被视为一个简单菜单（SGD/Adam/AdamW），但2025–2026年的研究格局已发生根本变化：优化器设计从坐标级标量更新扩展到矩阵与层级几何，从固定训练时长扩展为时序策略，从纯数学更新规则扩展为必须适应分片与低精度计算的状态对象。已有研究数量激增但缺乏统一框架，且不同论文的实验协议不一致导致结果难以比较。作者旨在提供一个功能性的分类法和更严格的证据评估标准，帮助从业者理解优化器设计空间并避免不当的横向比较。
AI.method: 文章采用"功能轴"分类法而非按名称罗列方法。提出优化器栈的四元组抽象（𝒯时间估计、𝒫几何设定、𝒬表示、ℛ更新规则），将每种优化器定位到这四个独立维度上。建立了三层证据评级体系：规模证据（scaled）、受控证据（controlled）、新兴证据（emerging）。通过对比性表格（11个）系统梳理：时序估计家族（AdEMAMix、MARS、Cautious、SPAM、ADOPT等）、矩阵几何家族（Muon、Shampoo、SOAP、SPlus、COSMOS、AdaMuon、NorMuon、Mousse等）、内存高效家族（Adam-mini、APOLLO、GaLore2、SWAN、SCALE等）、低精度家族（COAT、SOLO、8-bit Muon、ECO、STQuant等），并分析五类预算（tokens、FLOPs、墙钟时间、内存、梯度评估）下的不同赢家。文章使用统一的公式符号（如Muon的Newton–Schulz迭代、Schedule-free插值、误差反馈机制等）来解剖各方法的本质差异。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 矩阵感知优化器在小规模可获得约1.4×令牌效率，但随模型规模增大增益收窄至约1.1×；Muon在短数据比占优，SOAP类方法在长数据比占优。(2) 单纯的谱归一化（如Muon）在训练早期和短数据比下表现强，但长训练周期通常更利于方差自适应方法。(3) 优化器排名在中间检查点与最终检查点之间可能反转，协议本身就是声明的一部分。(5) Muon对量化具有特殊容忍性（极分解会减少尺度误差影响），而Adam的分母结构使其对低精度更敏感。(6) AdEMAMix在1.3B模型101B令牌上可匹配AdamW在197B令牌上的表现。(7) Muon可匹配AdamW基线，训练FLOPs约为52%。(8) 8-bit Muon相对全精度Muon可减少74%优化器状态内存，相对FP32 AdamW减少86%。文章还给出了十条按实际约束条件出发的起点决策指南。
AI.conclusion: 2025–2026年的优化器格局应被理解为从"标量更新规则"向"组合式训练策略"的范式转变。时间估计决定哪些历史梯度可信；矩阵几何决定层应如何移动；时序策略决定进度何时显现；表示决定状态能否在低精度下保持意义。矩阵感知复兴（Muon、SOAP、SPlus及其衍生）是核心科学发展，但不存在能普遍替代AdamW的单一优化器。优化器的实际选择日益取决于参数块类型、训练时长、精度与系统预算的匹配度。作者呼吁从选择品牌名转向设计与评估一个完整的优化器栈，并采用更严格的、可复现的评估协议。

title: Characterizing the I/O Behavior of HPC Applications through Modeling and Simulation
summary: Parallel applications process large amounts of data, leading to intensive parallel I/O operations. These operations can exhibit different levels of complexity, including, among others, multiple I/O access patterns, data staging, and contention risks. Therefore, in order to exploit high-performance computing (HPC) systems efficiently and optimize the I/O performance, it is crucial to consider the I/O behaviour of the HPC applications. In this work, we have developed a framework that reproduces the I/O access pattern of real applications in a simulated environment provided by ElastiSim, a batch-system simulator for rigid, malleable, and evolving workloads. The simulated applications are generated based on I/O traces captured from real applications provided by the HPC Input/Output (HPCIO) analysis repository. The HPCIO analysis database includes traces combined with information about real applications' performance across different parallel I/O libraries and layers of the I/O stack. We have conducted detailed case studies of real-world applications' traces to demonstrate how the proposed modeling framework can provide insights into the performance characteristics of I/O applications, including the I/O congestion analysis based on the application's I/O access pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ElastiSim的建模框架，将HPCIO仓库中的真实应用I/O trace复现到模拟环境中，用于分析HPC应用的I/O行为（包括I/O拥塞和访问模式）。通过四个真实用例（QePh、QeC、Nek5000、WaComM++）以及Jacobi和EpiGraph的跨平台验证，证明了框架可高精度（最高98.8%）再现真实I/O行为，并支持I/O干扰与拥塞分析。
AI.motivation: HPC并行应用产生大量并行I/O操作，其性能受I/O访问模式、数据分布及多应用竞争共享文件系统的影响。准确建模和预测I/O行为对于优化存储架构、调度算法和资源分配至关重要，但现有方法在跨平台trace复现和拥塞分析方面存在不足。
AI.method: 框架包含五个阶段：(1) 应用轮廓算法，从HPCIO的Darshan摘要中分析native trace，计算每个时间间隔的CPU和I/O时长；(2) native到simulated轮廓转换器，使用CPU性能比R_cpu和I/O带宽比R_io调整时间；(3) 采样算法，按采样窗口对间隔数据进行比例分配，生成模拟I/O trace；(4) 应用模型校准（Algorithm 1），通过迭代调整Flops使模拟应用在ElastiSim中产生与采样trace一致的I/O模式；(5) 模拟执行与对比验证。模拟基于ElastiSim/SimGrid离散事件仿真器，参考平台包含4300节点（48核/节点）和250 GB/s PFS带宽。
AI.result: 框架在Jacobi和EpiGraph的跨平台验证中达到最高98.8%和98.1%的I/O相位执行时间精度。I/O干扰分析显示：QePh和WaComM++的吞吐随并发作业数增加而下降；均匀数据分布下节点数增加导致严重拥塞，分布式数据模式拥塞较轻；当I/O密集型作业（QePh和Nek）占工作负载比例从10%升至50%时，I/O降级更早发生且幅度更大（PFS带宽250 GB/s成为瓶颈）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够高精度地在模拟环境中复现真实HPC应用的I/O行为，为I/O感知调度、存储架构评估和拥塞分析提供有效工具。未来工作将扩展至可延展（malleable）作业的I/O调度、引入burst buffer以及使用Extra-P等工具构建更精细的性能模型。

title: TerraceMoE: A Cost Model for Hierarchical MoE All-to-All Communication
comment: Preprint. Communication-level predictions only; step-level extrapolation is disabled by a failed validation gate. Fused-kernel figures are hypothetical sensitivity estimates. Code and executable gates released
summary: Hierarchical two-hop dispatch can reduce slow-fabric traffic in expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts training, but it adds a second collective and an arrival-side operator chain. We present a cost model for screening that trade at the communication-call level, bounded by validation gates that withdraw a capability in code when they fail rather than reporting a caveat. At a reference geometry with 16 groups of 8 ranks, $q=3$, $H=2048$, and 4096 tokens per rank, the corrected effective breakeven hierarchy ratio is 3.98 for the measured PyTorch arrival chain, 1.49 for a hypothetical fused target, and 1.10 at zero implementation overhead. These are ratio-only sensitivity results, not deployment predictions: platform A measures 1.03, platform B has no separated fast/slow measurement, and neither machine measured here reaches the hierarchical regime. Four communication-level corpora pass their gates; a drift probe and the step-level gate fail. The latter failure is enforced in code, so we make no training-throughput prediction. The enabling routing constraint fixes per-token fan-out and per-selected-group quota, while aggregate per-peer counts remain data-dependent. Its measured validation-loss cost is small but nonzero (+0.0034 nats); downstream equivalence is reported with incomplete estimator provenance and is therefore not independently reconstructible from the artifact. Code, calibration constants and the validation gates are at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出TerraceMoE，一个用于分层MoE（混合专家）集合通信的代价模型，旨在训练前以通信调用级别筛选分层两跳dispatch是否值得部署。该模型由代码绑定的验证门控制，失败时移除能力而非添加注释。在参考几何下，校正后的有效收支平衡层级比为3.98（实测PyTorch到达链）、1.49（假设融合目标）、1.10（零实现开销）。四组通信级语料通过验证门，漂移探测和步骤级门失败。路由约束使两跳dispatch可表达，其验证损失代价小但非零（+0.0034 nats）。
AI.motivation: MoE训练中所有到所有的集合通信是步骤时间的主要组成部分。分层两跳dispatch可通过在慢速fabric上发送去重副本来减少跨域流量，但增加了第二次集合和到达端算子链。问题是：在构建昂贵的实现之前，能否从基本原语的微基准测试中预测这种重构是否值得？现有模型通过报告平均精度来验证，但对否定判决无法问责。
AI.method: 1. 单个集合调用的成本模型：采用Hockney形式，带饱和带宽，参数α（固定成本）、β∞（饱和带宽）、x_{1/2}（半性能消息大小）。2. 两跳策略成本：Hop A（慢速级）+ Hop B（快速级）+ t_splits（分割获取）+ c_chain·Tk（到达链，即代表rank上的本地张量工作）。3. 路由约束：每token扇出限制为M个组，每组配额为k/M个专家。4. 验证门设计：Tier-1（拟合质量）、Tier-1b（独立基准族，含C2-C5）、Tier-2（端到端步骤时间），门失败时移除特定能力。5. 在两台机器（A和B）上实例化，使用六个语料和一个完整构建作为验证实例。
AI.result: 1. Tier-1门通过：中位相对误差4.1%，最差24.5%。2. Tier-1b门部分通过：C2-C4通过（1.9%-8.0%中位误差），C5失败（15.1%中位，-9.1%偏差）。3. Tier-2门失败：MAE 0.135，0/6在容差带内，代码强制不输出步骤级预测。4. 有效收支平衡层级比：测量链3.98，假设融合1.49，零开销1.10。5. 到达链占两跳开销最大项，其灵敏度贡献2.88层级比，而额外集合贡献仅0.17。6. 路由约束验证损失+0.0034 nats（无损失边际的3.4%），所有24个配对种子差值为正。7. 端到端测试：7个几何中5个符号一致，1个基阶层级测得1.0355（p≈0.017）构成测量未中。8. 撤回512秩处1.94比值的先前声明，因唯一覆盖该范围的语料是模型拟合最差的语料（40%中位误差）。
AI.conclusion: 在目标机器上，如果目标的常数在负载的消息大小下被测量且通信级门通过，分层MoE dispatch可在通信调用级别被筛选。当前数据不支持步骤时间或训练吞吐量的判决：步骤级门失败。到达链是该校准中主要的局部灵敏度，而非已证明的跨平台原因。路由约束T-Route提供有界的每token扇出和配额；其验证损失效应小但非零，下游等价性记录不可独立重建。机器B显示相同函数形式可在机器特定重新拟合后保留可接受拟合；但它不是样本外迁移测试。覆盖范围是主要限制：仅机器A有测量的层级比1.03，机器B的比值未解析。表中高于1.03的每行都是合成比值灵敏度，而非分层集群的观察。需要在分层区域测量的机器、通信级保留集和重叠感知步骤仪器来加强该声明。模型对非均匀快速域（如Frontier）的拒绝是诚实的输出而非数字。

title: Learning-Augmented Heuristics: Simple, yet Smart, Robust and Interpretable Cache Eviction
summary: Caching is widely used across the system stack to improve performance and efficiency, with eviction algorithms at its core. Existing cache eviction policies fall into two broad categories: static heuristics (e.g., 2Q, S3-FIFO) and smart algorithms (e.g., ARC, LRB). Smart caches can adapt to workloads and have the potential to achieve higher efficiency and robustness than static heuristics. However, we find that existing smart caches suffer from objective mismatches and instability. We introduce Learning-Augmented Heuristics (LAH), a framework that learns the cache-level parameters of static heuristics. By decoupling the data and control planes, LAH supports simple, high-speed data reads and writes on the data plane, while performing occasional asynchronous learning on the control plane using cache-level features. We demonstrate the effectiveness of LAH through S4-FIFO, a Smart S3-FIFO cache eviction algorithm. We pre-train a single model on 4,140 production traces and embed it in S4-FIFO to learn optimal cache parameters. On 1,035 evaluation traces, S4-FIFO improves the mean efficiency by 26% compared to S3-FIFO and by 8% compared to 3L-Cache, the best state-of-the-art algorithm. S4-FIFO is also robust---increasing miss ratio over FIFO by 0.8% on the worst trace, whereas 3L-Cache increases FIFO's miss ratio by 8.8%. Finally, S4-FIFO's decisions are also interpretable: a language model can provide a rationale for why a particular configuration was chosen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出学习增强启发式（LAH）框架，通过解耦数据面与控制面，对静态启发式缓存淘汰算法（如S3-FIFO）的参数进行离线预训练学习。其具体实现S4-FIFO在大规模生产trace上实现了比S3-FIFO更高的平均效率提升和强鲁棒性，同时保持启发式级别的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能缓存淘汰算法（如LRB、3L-Cache）采用对象级（object-level）+每次未命中（per-miss）学习策略，存在目标不匹配（优化代理指标而非真实缺失率）、不稳定性、对噪声敏感、运行时开销大以及可解释性差等问题。静态启发式（如S3-FIFO）虽简单高效但参数固定，无法适应多样化的负载。作者观察到现有智能缓存算法在"学习粒度"和"预测频率"两个维度构成的四个象限中，仅探索了三个象限，周期性缓存级学习这一象限尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出学习增强启发式（LAH）框架，核心思想是将机器学习用于配置简单启发式的少量语义化参数，而非取代缓存机制本身。具体实现S4-FIFO通过以下方式实现：（1）增强S3-FIFO的五个参数（小队列大小ρ_S、幽灵队列大小ρ_G、跳过比率κ、小-主队列提升阈值τ_S、幽灵-主队列提升阈值τ_G），通过网格搜索和贪心集合覆盖将168个候选配置降至18个代表性配置；（2）提取73维缓存级特征向量，包括三个队列的20-bin直方图、命中率、效用差距、幽灵压力、一次性对象比例、扫描强度等；（3）训练梯度提升决策树（GBDT，20棵树，最大深度9）作为"基础模型"，采用以FIFO为锚点的代价敏感损失函数，避免分类错误带来的严重性能退化；（4）离线预训练后通过m2cgen导出为无依赖的C/C++/Go/Rust等代码；（5）控制面异步、零样本推理，选择参数后通过延迟队列重平衡完成切换。
AI.result: 在4140条生产trace上训练、1035条评估trace上，S4-FIFO的大缓存平均缺失率比S3-FIFO降低26%，比3L-Cache降低8%；在最差trace上仅比FIFO高0.8%，而3L-Cache高8.8%；在第10百分位trace上减少FIFO缺失率4.2%（大缓存）和3.6%（小缓存）；吞吐量与S3-FIFO、LRU、2Q等启发式相当，远高于3L-Cache（平均慢17.3倍，最高274倍）；top-1预测准确率约60%，top-3约80%；LLM在配对配置选择任务中准确率达83%-86%，表明决策具有可解释性。
AI.conclusion: LAH框架通过解耦数据面与控制面、采用周期性缓存级学习与简单GBDT模型，在保持启发式简单性与吞吐量的同时，显著提升了缓存淘汰效率与鲁棒性，并具备良好的可解释性。该工作表明，学习简单启发式的少量语义化参数是引入机器学习到核心缓存系统的有效路径，未来可推广至LRU、2Q、ARC、LeCaR等其他可参数化的启发式。

title: Great Expectations: Benchmarking the Real-World Performance of RVV 1.0 in HPC
comment: Accepted for International workshop on RISC-V for HPC at ISC26
summary: Following the ratification of the RISC-V Vector Extension (RVV 1.0), new commercially available silicon has been adopting the extension. This paper revisits the question of RISC-V viability for High-Performance-Computing (HPC) by benchmarking the latest RVV 1.0-capable hardware (SiFive X280 (Tenstorrent Blackhole), SpacemiT X60 (K1) and X100/A100 (K3), and T-Head C920v2 (Sophon SG2044)). We assess these platforms using standard HPC benchmarks (BLAS, FFTW, HPL, HPCG) and synthetic workloads (STREAM, FMA throughput) and compare them to a state-of-the-art HPC ARM64 chip (NVIDIA Grace). Our findings show that while RVV 1.0 delivers significant performance improvements over scalar execution, hardware-specific implementation challenges remain. We detail these performance characteristics and discuss the remaining hurdles for RISC-V, including RVV, to become a mainstay in the HPC landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文对四款商用 RISC-V RVV 1.0 处理器（SiFive X280、SpacemiT X60/X100/A100、T-Head C920v2）进行了全面的 HPC 性能基准测试，并与基于 ARM Neoverse V2 的 NVIDIA Grace 进行了对比。结果表明 RVV 1.0 相比标量执行有显著提升，但各平台存在微架构瓶颈（端口争用、内存带宽限制），整体性能仍落后于成熟的 ARM 架构，但跨代际的快速进步显示 RISC-V 在 HPC 领域具有竞争力潜力。
AI.motivation: RISC-V 及其向量扩展（RVV 1.0）于 2021 年被批准，旨在通过向量长度无关（VLA）编程模型实现高性能计算的可移植性。然而，RISC-V 在 HPC 领域的实际可行性尚未得到充分验证，尤其缺乏对多种商用 RVV 1.0 硬件的全面对比评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统评估当前可用的 RVV 1.0 处理器在真实 HPC 工作负载下的性能特征。
AI.method: 方法包括：（1）合成基准测试（FMA 吞吐量测试，测试不同 vfmacc/vle 比率；STREAM 内存带宽测试）；（2）标准 HPC 基准测试（BLIS/OpenBLAS 实现的 BLAS 含 GEMM、FFTW 1D DFT、HPL、HPCG）。测试平台覆盖四种 RVV 1.0 处理器和 NVIDIA Grace ARM64 参考系统，通过分块参数调优、循环并行化参数扫描等手段优化各平台性能。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）所有处理器在纯 FMA 链上均达到峰值，但在 FMA/load 混合时出现显著减速，SpacemiT 系列存在 VFPU/VLSU 端口争用；（2）STREAM 显示 RISC-V 内存带宽受实现质量影响大，segment 加载/存储仅 X280 能达到理论峰值，Grace 在内存带宽上领先；（3）BLAS GEMM 中，SpacemiT K3（X100/A100）以 75-80% 峰值效率领先，Sophon SG2044 绝对值最高（FP64 559.6 GFLOP/s）；（4）FFTW 中 SG2044 在 L1 缓存大小下领先（6 GFLOP/s），Grace 领先 3-5 倍；（5）HPL 中 SpacemiT X100 多线程性能最佳（83.64 GFLOP/s），但 Grace 单核即达 46.37 GFLOP/s；（6）HPCG 中 A100 计算性能最佳，但内存带宽仅 X100 达 0.49 GB/s 远低于 Grace 的 6.77 GB/s。总体而言，RISC-V 平台效率在 30-80% 区间，与 Grace 存在 2-14 倍性能差距，但代际改进显著（X100 较 X60 提升 1.5-3.4 倍）。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出 RISC-V RVV 在 HPC 中具有可行性和快速发展的潜力。SpacemiT K3 代表了重要的代际飞跃，而 Sophon SG2044 证明了大规模核心扩展的可行性。然而，要弥合与成熟 ARM 架构（如 Grace）的差距，需要双管齐下：一方面扩大核心数量，另一方面消除内部流水线和带宽瓶颈。随着这些设计理念的成熟与融合，RISC-V 有望成为 HPC 领域具有竞争力的力量。

title: Memory-efficient GPU pipelines for real-time non-line-of-sight reconstruction
summary: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging reconstructs scenes hidden around a corner from indirect light recorded by a single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD). A single reconstruction is a large inverse problem: billions of photon timestamps must be binned, moved through memory, transformed and inverted. As SPAD arrays raise acquisition throughput, reconstruction becomes the limiting stage. We rebuild the GPU execution of two established wave-based algorithms, f-k migration and phasor-fields, for both streaming and offline processing. On the phasor-fields side we assemble the ring-and-radius kernels of previous work once and offline, using the analytic Fourier transform of a ring, so the propagation kernel never exists in dense form at runtime, reducing the memory and bandwidth. We reorganize the pipeline of both algorithms with fused kernels, warp-level photon binning, batched transforms, CUDA graph replay, and FP16 storage applied only where it reduces the actual bottleneck. Our implementations are up to 42x faster than the reference streaming pipeline and up to 14x faster than the fastest published GPU baseline, all while using a fraction of the memory (down to 2.5%), enabling vastly larger and finer reconstructions on the same hardware, or comparable ones within a much lower memory budget. We report an ablation of each implementation choice and propose three denoising strategies enabled by the resulting frame budget for next-generation NLOS video processing.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非视距成像(NLOS)中基于SPAD的实时重建计算瓶颈，重构了两种主流波基算法(f-k迁移与相量场)的GPU流水线。在相量场方面，利用环的解析傅里叶变换离线构建径向核，避免运行时密集核重建；在两种算法中均采用融合核、warp级光子分箱、批处理变换、CUDA图回放和按需FP16存储等优化。流式重建速度比参考管线提升42倍，比最快GPU基线提升14倍，显存占用降至2.5%，并提出了三种去噪策略。
AI.motivation: 随着SPAD阵列采集吞吐量提升，NLOS重建成为系统瓶颈。已有GPU加速方案存在核重建耗时、大量中间缓冲占用显存等问题，无法满足下一代高分辨率、低时延重建需求，亟需更高效且内存友好的实现。
AI.method: 1. 流式采用生产者-消费者CUDA图回放架构；2. 相量场用环的解析Fourier变换(J₀贝塞尔函数)离线构造径向传播核ρ×f×d，运行时通过像素-半径查找表与线性插值采样，避免密集核重建；3. f-k迁移在Stolt重映射阶段逐体素在线插值并融合循环移位；4. 光子分箱采用warp-per-photon布局，每个warp覆盖不同频率；5. 共享频谱的双分支MoE融合(相量场作置信门，f-k迁移作幅度)，并提出DDA、相干加权合并等时域去噪策略；6. 按需使用FP16仅用于相量场存储核，f-k迁移保持FP32以规避cuFFT约束。
AI.result: 在nlosbox1动态数据集上：流式相量场达448.5 FPS（显存0.27 GB），比Nam et al.基线快42倍、显存仅其8.2%；f-k迁移(无填充)达919.85 FPS，填充版81.4 FPS。面对PttR，多平面重建在Z场景快7.7倍、office场景快14倍，显存仅其2.5%。office场景峰值显存：本文0.22 GB vs PttR 12.7 GB。720³体积下本文方法可重建而PttR发生OOM。离线端相对原MATLAB实现平均加速98.3%（f-k）和96.1%（相量场）。MoE(β=0.3)将背景噪点从~10⁻²降至7.4×10⁻⁶，背景-目标对比度达60981，峰速仍保持230 FPS。PSNR达37 dB（相量场）/57 dB（f-k）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明NLOS重建的优化必须围绕GPU数据流整体改造：减少中间缓冲、融合算子、利用径向对称、降低精度于真正瓶颈处。径向核表示将显存占用与空间分辨率解耦，是面向未来高分辨率SPAD阵列与超大数据集的关键路径。但无单一优化支配所有场景——填充与精度的取舍、密集核与径向核的精度差异均需依应用场景权衡。未来工作应聚焦SPAD-GPU异构集成、更高效的传播核表示以及兼顾时域细节的帧间降噪策略。

title: HARTS: Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Hybrid-Attention Models over Arbitrary Rollout Trees
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often produces irregular rollout trees with shared histories. Training root-to-leaf trajectories independently recomputes these shared prefixes. Existing systems primarily target full-attention models and lack dense, differentiable hybrid-attention execution compatible with activation recomputation. We present HARTS (Hybrid-Attention RL over Tree Structures). HARTS jointly plans microbatches, data-parallel (DP) replica assignments, and microbatch-slot schedules using non-replay compact-token work after prefix compression. For chunkwise linear attention, a linear-time algorithm coordinates chunk-boundary state recovery and replay and produces the minimum number of sequential linear-attention calls under our packed execution model. HARTS preserves the chunkwise state partitioning of trajectory-wise training: it does not repeat projections, MLP/MoE computation, or final outputs, and performs only bounded state replay for numerical alignment. Per round, HARTS batches all branches into one packed call, propagates gradients through differentiable state handoffs, supports activation recomputation, and restores per-token log-probabilities. For deterministic, no-token-drop top-$k$ MoE routing, semantic multiplicities restore MoE-objective token weights and load statistics. Existing RL objectives retain their interface. To our knowledge, HARTS is the first system to demonstrate arbitrary-rollout-tree prefix-sharing speedups on a real hybrid-attention model. On an Agentic RL workload generated from SWE-bench tasks, HARTS achieves $4.81$--$4.87\times$ forward/backward/gradient speedup with activation recomputation across multiple parallel configurations. Its numerical differences are comparable to baseline self-rerun variation, and its reward trend is similar to the baseline over the first 120 steps of $\tau^3$-Bench training.

AI.tldr: HARTS是一个针对混合注意力模型（MLA+KDA）在智能体强化学习中处理任意rollout树前缀共享的训练系统，通过前缀感知的microbatch规划、线性注意力的最小调用调度和紧凑执行的语义保留，实现了4.81–4.87倍的F/B/Grad加速。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习的rollout树结构使得多条轨迹共享大量前缀token，传统的逐轨迹训练方式会重复计算这些共享前缀，造成大量冗余计算。现有树结构训练系统（如Tree Training、AReaL-DTA）主要针对全注意力模型，无法有效处理混合注意力模型中线性注意力的分块状态传播约束，也无法同时支持激活重计算。
AI.method: HARTS包含三个核心组件：(1) 前缀感知的microbatch规划器，联合优化microbatch成员、DP副本分配和slot调度，以非回放的紧凑token工作量作为度量；(2) 线性注意力的最小调用规划器，使用线性时间算法协调分块边界状态恢复和回放，在指定的紧凑执行模型下产生最少的序列调用次数；(3) 紧凑到语义的执行层，保留RL目标接口和MoE语义，通过语义多重性恢复路由器损失和专家负载的token权重。
AI.result: 在Ling-3.0-tiny混合注意力MoE模型（MLA+KDA）和SWE-bench生成的智能体RL工作负载上，HARTS实现了5.62–5.63倍的非回放紧凑行压缩比，转化为4.81–4.87倍的F/B/Grad加速和4.39–4.63倍的Core加速。均值token级全词汇logit余弦相似度超过0.9997，τ³-Bench前120步训练奖励趋势与基线相似。规划质量方面，HARTS比OR-Tools减少3.28%的紧凑工作量，规划速度快7.24–9.73倍。
AI.conclusion: HARTS是首个在真实混合注意力模型上演示任意rollout树前缀共享加速的系统。它通过联合设计规划、执行和语义保持三个层面，在保持数值精度和训练效果的同时实现了显著的计算加速。该方法的效益预期随模型规模增大而扩大，因为前缀共享节省的计算量随模型增大而增长，控制开销增长较慢。

title: Grounded Checklist Partial Credit for Agent Skill Trajectories
summary: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks in interactive environments, yet their evaluation commonly relies on task-level success rates by reducing an entire execution trajectory to whether the task passes an official verifier. This binary score hides partial progress and is particularly limited for procedural agent skill evaluations, since a skill can alter execution without changing the final outcome. While checklists provide finer-grained evaluation by scoring individual task requirements, costly manual authoring and unreliable automatic generation make trustworthy evaluation difficult to scale. To address these challenges, we introduce Grounded Checklist Partial Credit (GCPC), a human-governed and LLM-instantiated partial-credit evaluation of agent trajectories. Humans define reusable rules once, from which an LLM instantiates a task-specific checklist grounded in the task instruction and official verifier. To keep judgment tied to evidence, a judge scores each item from execution log evidence alone and abstains when evidence is missing. A separate scripted step then applies the official verifier outcome to the score. Across a 4,455-trajectory, deduplicated SkillsBench evaluation population, GCPC better discriminates official PASS and FAIL outcomes than holistic judging on the shared subset (AUC 0.689 vs. 0.619). Human evaluation on 96 trajectories from 12 tasks shows that GCPC aligns more closely with human assessments of progress. Applied to 1,946 matched with/without-skill pairs, GCPC exposes the effects hidden by pass@1: among 879 pairs whose binary outcome does not change, 20.9% improve by more than 0.10 while 18.7% regress by the same margin. The GCPC pipeline also transfers to Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench, demonstrating applicability beyond skill-conditioned evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Grounded Checklist Partial Credit（GCPC），一种由人类规则治理、由大语言模型实例化执行的智能体轨迹细粒度评估方法。它通过生成与任务指令及验证器一一对应的检查清单，对执行轨迹中各项要求是否满足进行有据可循的逐项评判，并允许在证据不足时弃权，从而在保留二元 pass@1 评估的同时揭示被其掩盖的部分进度与程序性技能的真实影响。
AI.motivation: 当前对长链路语言模型智能体的评估普遍采用基于验证器的二元 pass@1 指标，将整条执行轨迹压缩为通过或失败。该指标无法反映部分完成进度，且对程序性技能评估尤为不足——技能可能改变执行过程却不改变最终结果。同时，检查清单式细粒度评估面临"可扩展性–可信度"两难：人工编写成本高、不可扩展，而纯 LLM 自动生成的清单存在覆盖不全、粒度不一、易受打分偏差影响等问题。
AI.method: GCPC 将评估拆分为清单合成与轨迹打分两个阶段：1）合成阶段由人类专家一次性定义可复用的清单条目合约、来源归属要求以及机械验证门控，并设计五类需求审计方案；LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6）在仅看到任务指令与官方验证器的前提下生成冻结的任务专属清单，每条条目附带逐字引文与三类验证路径（assertion/generated/judge），并通过确定性校验器拒绝不可追溯的条目。2）打分阶段由另一模型（GPT-5.4-mini）逐项依据执行日志中可见的证据独立判定 Yes/No/Abstain，证据不足时弃权而非判失败；之后由脚本端以确定性方式应用官方验证器结果（PASS 时覆盖 assertion 类条目为 Yes，并追加一个官方结局端点条目）。最终输出三项指标：清单部分得分（满足项/可判定项）、Perfect（无任何条目被判 No）以及证据覆盖率。
AI.result: 在 4,455 条去重的 SkillsBench 轨迹上，GCPC 在与整体性评判相同的子集上 AUC 达 0.689，高于整体性评判的 0.619（配对 ΔAUC = +0.056，97.1% 自助样本为正）。在 96 条轨迹、12 个任务的人工评判中，GCPC 与人类两两偏好一致率达 0.730，高于整体评判（0.613）、TICK（0.691）与通用清单（0.569），且与人类进度评分的 Spearman 相关性（ρ=0.382）也显著高于整体评判（0.218）。在 1,946 对匹配的有/无技能轨迹中，879 对二元结果未变（FAIL→FAIL），但其中 20.9% 在 GCPC 上提升超过 0.10、18.7% 同样程度回退；当二元结果变化时，GCPC 中位数变化方向与之一致。同一流程可零改动迁移至 Terminal-Bench 2.0（585 条目，98.8% 有效）与 SWE-bench Verified（336 条目，94.9% 有效），打分 Krippendorff α 在两个独立样本上分别达 0.905 与 0.937。消融实验表明：任务专属清单、官方结局端点、弃权机制以及五类审计方案均各自贡献了不可替代的鉴别力或可信度。
AI.conclusion: GCPC 通过将可复用的人类规则与任务专属的 LLM 实例化相结合，提供了一种可审计、可扩展且有据可循的细粒度评估流水线，弥补了二元评估在衡量部分进度与程序性技能效果上的盲区。其设计在区分能力、人类一致性、揭示被 pass@1 掩盖的改进与回退、以及跨基准迁移等方面均优于整体性评判与既有自动清单方法；但其信息量受限于任务指令、验证器与执行日志所能暴露的证据，且不宜直接用于强化学习奖励信号，以免因逐项可引用目标触发 Goodhart 定律式的博弈。

title: Image Augmentation as Test Generation for Deep Learning-Based Image Retrieval Systems
summary: Ensuring the reliability of deep learning-based image retrieval systems is a software engineering challenge. This paper presents a dual contribution: (1) a literature review of augmentation and generation techniques which resulted in the identification of 50 techniques which we organized into a ten-category taxonomy, and (2) a large-scale empirical study that evaluates these techniques as test generators for embedding-based image retrieval systems. Augmented images are embedded using Amazon Titan and OpenCLIP, and evaluated across four analytical dimensions: (1) embedding-space similarity, (2) embedding uncertainty measured via four estimators, (3) semantic realism scored by LLaVA, and (4) retrieval failure rate. Experiments are performed on three datasets: CIFAR-10, ImageNet-1K, and a dataset from an industrial partner (March Networks). Across all evaluated datasets and embedding models, and under the single severity level tested for each technique, weather simulation and SaSPA are the image augmentation/generation techniques that produce the highest embedding uncertainty and failure rates while maintaining a favorable balance between performance stability, visual realism, and augmentation effectiveness. The results we discuss are configuration-specific and may shift under milder or stronger perturbation settings. In contrast, GAN-based augmentation techniques are among the lowest in realism, indicating the presence of synthetic artifacts and perceptual inconsistencies that reduce their suitability to produce realistic test inputs. Overall, our findings provide practical guidelines for selecting augmentation techniques that maximize test diversity while preserving realistic image characteristics, thereby enabling the construction of comprehensive and effective test suites for image retrieval systems while reducing the cost of manual data labeling through the use of metamorphic testing.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于深度学习的图像检索系统的可靠性测试挑战，提出了双重贡献：(1) 对2020-2025年间图像增强与生成技术进行系统文献综述，识别出50种技术并组织为十类分类法；(2) 大规模实证研究将这些技术作为基于嵌入的图像检索系统的测试生成器，在三个数据集(CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1K、March Networks工业数据集)上使用Amazon Titan和OpenCLIP两种嵌入模型，从四个分析维度(嵌入空间相似性、嵌入不确定性、语义真实感、检索失败率)进行评估。结果表明天气模拟和SaSPA在保持性能稳定性、视觉真实感和增强效果之间取得最佳平衡，能产生最高的嵌入不确定性和失败率；而基于GAN的增强技术在真实感方面表现最差。
AI.motivation: 基于深度学习的图像检索系统广泛应用于安全监控、工业检测等关键场景，但输入条件复杂多变（低光、雨雾、传感器噪声等），确保系统可靠性是软件工程挑战。手动测试成本过高且面临测试预言问题，需要自动化方法生成多样化测试输入。变质测试可通过语义保持变换关系绕过人工标注的预言问题，但哪些增强技术最适合作为测试生成器尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 方法包括两部分：(1) 遵循Kitchenham和PRISMA 2020指南的系统文献综述，从88篇候选论文中筛选56篇，识别50种增强技术并构建十类分类法（几何变换、光度变换、噪声注入、选择类、滤波操作、自混合、样本混合、GAN、扩散模型、对抗扰动）；(2) 大规模实证研究，将每种技术作为测试生成器，通过变质关系（增强后图像应检索同类别图像）评估。使用Amazon Titan和OpenCLIP ViT-H/14作为嵌入模型，从四个维度评估：检索失败计数（混合效应逻辑回归分析）、嵌入空间相似性（余弦相似度）、嵌入不确定性（色散度、成对距离、马氏距离、KNN集成协议四种估计器）、语义真实感（LLaVA作为自动评判）。使用加权评分（失败率0.4、真实感0.4、稳定性0.2）综合排名。
AI.result: 关键发现：(1) 检索失败方面，Weather模拟、Dimension Reduction、Neural Style Transfer、Shuffle产生最高的失败率和不确定性，而KeepAug、RICAP、MixGen失败率最低；(2) 嵌入相似性方面，Shuffle、Weather、Dimension Reduction位移最大，PCA Jitter、Auto Contrast、Gamma位移最小；(3) 不确定性方面，马氏距离(ρ=0.67)和集成不确定性(ρ=0.47)与失败率显著正相关，而色散度和成对距离相关性弱且不显著；(4) 语义真实感方面，Sharpen、Brightness、Contrast、SaSPA最高，Shuffle、NST、DCGAN、FGSM、IP-Mix最低；GAN技术真实感最差；(5) 类别排名：Diffusion(0.6837)、Photometric(0.6817)、Self-Mix(0.6773)前三，Sample Mix(0.5482)最低；(6) 个体技术层面，Weather模拟和SaSPA在故障暴露与真实感之间取得最佳平衡，OpenCLIP总体比Titan更脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过系统文献综述和大规模实证研究，为基于嵌入的图像检索系统的测试生成提供了实用指南：天气模拟和SaSPA是最佳测试生成器候选，能在保持视觉真实感的同时最大化测试多样性；GAN类增强由于合成伪影不适合产生真实测试输入；故障暴露能力与图像质量是两个独立甚至相互矛盾的目标，需要联合考虑。提出的变质测试框架可有效降低手动数据标注成本。该研究为安全关键部署场景下的深度学习图像检索系统提供了系统化的测试方法论，填补了自动化鲁棒性测试与嵌入空间分析的研究空白。

title: Predicting LLM Performance from Prompt Linguistic Features: An Empirical Study in Requirements Engineering
summary: Background. LLM outputs are highly sensitive to prompt formulation: small wording changes can substantially affect output quality. This matters in software engineering, where prompts guide requirements analysis, code generation, and artefact synthesis. Poor formulations yield unreliable artefacts, yet practitioners lack principled ways to assess a prompt before inference, making selection depend on costly LLM calls and trial-and-error refinement. Aims. We investigate whether measurable linguistic properties of prompts can predict LLM performance before inference, enabling low-cost prompt selection and refinement, validated on binary requirements classification targeting F1, F2, precision, and recall. Method. We generate 9,000 linguistically controlled prompt variants from 100 initial prompts by varying 30 linguistic metrics, evaluated with five open-source LLMs on 625 annotated requirements. Regression predictors are trained via stratified 10-fold cross-validation with permutation-based significance testing; feature importance analysis identifies cross-LLM and model-specific predictors. Results. Linguistic features significantly predict prompt performance across all targets (R2 in [0.38,0.42], q<0.05). Syntactic and morphosyntactic features drive most predictive signal; cross-LLM predictors include compound dependency distribution, conjunction density, and word/sentence length, reflecting sensitivity to domain vocabulary and complex structures. Conclusions. Results suggest practical implications for prompt engineering, including overlap between linguistic patterns that reduce LLM performance and those that increase human comprehension difficulty, and the irrelevance of lexical variety as a quality dimension. More broadly, linguistic profiling combined with standard regression provides an effective, interpretable, low-cost prior before costly optimisation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究提示词的语言学特征能否在大语言模型(LLM)推理前预测其性能,以二元需求分类为验证场景。结果表明句法与形态句法特征可显著预测提示词性能(R²≈0.38–0.42),且跨模型高度一致,为提示词工程提供了一种低成本、可解释的预筛选信号。
AI.motivation: LLM输出对提示词措辞高度敏感,而软件工程领域(尤其是需求工程)缺乏在推理前评估提示词质量的系统性方法。当前提示词工程要么依赖模板化经验规则,要么依赖计算昂贵的自动提示词优化(APE),缺乏一种轻量级、可解释的预筛选机制。论文假设提示词的可测量语言学属性可作为LLM性能的预测因子,从而在推理前辅助提示词选择与优化。
AI.method: 采用知识寻求型实证研究,分两阶段:Stage 1通过Qwen3:32B对100个初始提示词进行受控改写,沿30个语言学指标(覆盖原始文本、句法树结构、动词谓词结构、从属关系)的minimize/equal/maximize三个目标生成9000个提示词变体,使用Profiling-UD工具提取124个语言学特征;Stage 2用5个开源LLM(Qwen2-7B、Falcon3-7B、Granite-3.2-8B、Ministral-8B、Llama-3-8B)在PROMISE-NFR数据集(625条标注需求)上评估每个变体的F1/F2/Precision/Recall性能,采用5种回归模型(DT/LSVM/RF/GB/MLP)配合分层10折交叉验证与置换检验进行预测建模,通过置换特征重要性分析识别跨LLM及模型特定的预测因子。
AI.result: 语言学特征对所有四个性能指标均具有显著预测能力(R²∈[0.38,0.42],q<0.05);Random Forest表现最佳(平均R²=0.405);句法关系(R²=0.375)与形态句法信息(R²=0.331)是单组最强的预测因子;最稳定的负面预测因子包括复合依存密度(dep_dist_compound)、字符/词比率(char_per_tok)和连词密度(dep_dist_conj);跨LLM特征排序一致性高(Spearman ρ∈[0.86,0.95]),跨性能指标一致性更高(ρ≥0.97);词汇多样性(TTR)普遍无关(平均排名>95),表明词汇丰富度并非提示词质量的决定因素。
AI.conclusion: 提示词的语言学结构(尤其是句法与形态句法特征)是LLM性能的可靠预测因子,其预测模式与人类语言理解难度的已知模式存在重叠;语言学分析可作为低成本、可解释的预推理信号,补充而非替代昂贵的APE优化流程;实际建议包括简化定义、避免长句、减少复合名词短语与长枚举,同时不应将词汇多样性作为优化目标;未来工作应扩展至更多任务、闭源/大规模LLM,并将语言学预测因子集成到APE工具链中作为评分函数。

title: Operationalizing Regulations into Code: A Model to Enhance Governance and Compliance in LLM Selection for Software Engineering
summary: Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) can improve developer productivity, but it also introduces security, privacy, and compliance risks during model selection. Regulations and frameworks such as the EU AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (RMF), the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), and ISO/IEC 42001 establish obligations that are often difficult to translate into operational criteria for technical decision-making. This paper proposes a model to support governance and compliance in LLM selection for software engineering projects. The model is developed through Design Science Research (DSR) and is structured in three layers: (i) regulatory requirements, (ii) organizational governance capabilities, instantiated by a multi-criteria decision matrix with knock-out and weighted scoring criteria, and (iii) productivity and sustainability outcomes, operationalized by the LLM governance assessment protocol (PAG-LLM). A regulatory feedback loop connects operational results back to the normative layer, enabling iterative refinement of the model. A pilot evaluation with 20 adversarial scenarios based on Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the OWASP Top 10 suggests distinct risk profiles between commercial cloud-based LLMs and local open-source LLMs. The results provide preliminary evidence that regulatory disqualification logic, particularly K.O. criteria, can prevent the selection of technically competitive models that nonetheless pose unacceptable compliance risks, demonstrating the feasibility of governance-oriented LLM selection in software engineering projects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于设计科学研究（DSR）的三层模型，用于在软件工程项目中选择大语言模型（LLM）时实现治理与合规性的操作化。该模型将欧盟AI法案、NIST AI RMF、GDPR、LGPD和ISO/IEC 42001等法规要求转化为多准则决策矩阵的K.O.和加权评分标准，并通过LLM治理评估协议（PAG-LLM）进行对抗性评估。试点评估对比了商业云端LLM和本地开源LLM，结果显示K.O.准则可有效防止选择技术上虽具竞争力但存在不可接受合规风险的模型。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在软件开发生命周期（SDLC）中的快速集成，由此产生的不安全代码生成、敏感信息泄露及合规违规等风险日益突出。现有法规（如欧盟AI法案、GDPR、LGPD、ISO/IEC 42001）虽规定了相应义务，但其高度抽象性使得软件工程师和管理者难以将其转化为模型选择过程中的可操作技术准则。因此，亟需一个将监管义务转化为可衡量技术决策标准的框架，以在LLM集成前进行系统性治理评估。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）的五阶段迭代方法（Hevner等人，2004），结合多准则决策分析（MCDA）原则。模型架构包含三层：(1) 法规要求层，整合欧盟AI法案、NIST AI RMF、GDPR、LGPD和ISO/IEC 42001五大框架；(2) 组织治理能力层，通过五维MCDA矩阵（含K.O.硬约束和加权评分标准）实现，使用加权求和模型（WSM）计算加权风险指数（IRP）；(3) 生产力与可持续性结果层，通过包含20个对抗性场景（基于CWE和OWASP Top 10映射）的PAG-LLM协议进行实证评估。此外设有反馈回路将操作结果反哺至规范层。
AI.result: 试点评估对比了商业云端LLM（LLM A）和本地开源LLM（LLM B）在20个对抗性场景下的表现。LLM A在15/20场景中表现优异，但因K.O.5（管辖区风险，不符合LGPD）而遭淘汰；LLM B虽在数据主权（K.O.5）和架构保障（K.O.4）方面占优，却因K.O.3（提示注入抗性失败，场景S07）而被排除。两者IRP分别为8.72和7.13。结果表明：若无K.O.门控机制，LLM B可能仅凭IRP被选中；K.O.准则在防止高风险模型选择方面具有核心作用，能揭示传统性能基准无法捕捉的治理风险权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该模型初步证明，将监管要求操作化为LLM选择中的技术决策准则是可行的。K.O.排除逻辑能够阻止选择技术上具竞争力但存在不可接受合规风险的模型。模型的主要价值在于将法规义务转化为可在LLM选择阶段应用的技术标准，而非事后合规审查。局限性包括评估规模较小（仅两个模型、20个场景）、权重方案有待专家验证。未来工作包括扩展PAG-LLM至更多LLM、与安全和法律专家共同验证权重，以及在巴西技术组织中进行案例研究以评估实际应用效果。

title: Decoupling is a Necessity: Transformation-Agnostic Decompiled Code Recovery under Optimization and Obfuscation
summary: Reverse engineering is essential for software security analysis and vulnerability detection. Decompilation, the process of lifting binaries to high-level pseudocode, is central to this task. However, production binaries are hostile environments: aggressive compiler optimizations and adversarial obfuscation jointly mangle control structures, obscure variable intents, and disguise high-level program logic. Consequently, existing LLM-based decompilation tools frequently suffer from structural collapse and semantic hallucinations. We present ReSource, the first multi-phase LLM framework designed for transformation-agnostic source recovery. To tackle these intertwined distortions, ReSource conceptualizes the binary-to-source discrepancies into three orthogonal tiers, namely lexical, syntactic, and semantic, and decouples the recovery process accordingly. First, to ground the LLM and prevent logic drift, it retrieves empirical priors from a curated Semantic Distortion Database. Second, to resolve control-flow flattening, it integrates a lightweight predictor to reconstruct the source-level structural skeleton. Finally, a contextual lexical deduction stage refines identifiers to restore human readability. Evaluated on a massive benchmark of over 80,000 decompiled-source function pairs across three optimization levels and four obfuscation techniques, ReSource achieves an 83% Top-5 source retrieval accuracy and an average similarity score of 0.66. By maintaining robust semantic identifiability where state-of-the-art baselines (DeGPT, LLM4Decompile, and FidelityGPT) severely overfit or degrade, ReSource provides a scalable and reliable foundation for downstream security analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReSource框架，针对经激进编译器优化与对抗性混淆处理后的反编译代码，首次提出多阶段LLM驱动的"变换无关"源代码恢复方法，将二进制到源码的差异解耦为词法、句法、语义三层进行修复。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的反编译工具在面对激进优化（如O3）和对抗性混淆（如控制流平坦化CFF）的真实生产环境二进制时，因过度依赖表层序列到序列模式匹配，会出现严重的结构性崩溃（structural collapse）和语义幻觉（semantic hallucinations），无法支撑下游安全分析任务。
AI.method: ReSource是一个多阶段LLM框架，包含三个协同阶段：(1) 引导式语义恢复阶段——构建语义失真数据库（Semantic Distortion Database），通过解编译语义签名（DSS，四维：语法、变量依赖、控制流、上下文角色）进行失真感知的细粒度检索，为LLM提供经验先验；(2) 结构导向修复阶段——基于CodeT5微调的轻量级控制流预测器，从失真代码预测源码级控制流骨架，反向恢复被平坦化的结构；(3) 词法与风格终化阶段——通过约束于前述先验的prompt引导LLM联合进行标识符精化、语法清理、语义澄清与风格统一。整体采用"解耦"思想，将三种正交失真分层处理而非端到端映射。
AI.result: 在超过80,000个反编译-源码函数对的基准（覆盖3个优化级别O1-O3与4种混淆技术BCF/CFF/SPLIT/SUB）上，ReSource取得平均Top-5源代码检索准确率83%，平均代码相似度0.66。在混淆场景下Obf-AVG Top-1达70%、Top-5达84%，显著优于DeGPT（Top-5 65%）、FidelityGPT（Top-5 77%）和LLM4Decompile（Top-5 61%，混淆下骤降至51%）。消融实验证实语义模块与结构模块呈现正交互补：去掉任一模块均导致性能下降，全流程83%严格优于最佳消融变体的81%；同时揭示LLM4Decompile等端到端微调方法在混淆下存在严重过拟合失效。
AI.conclusion: ReSource通过将二进制到源码差距解耦为词法、句法、语义三个正交维度并显式引入经验语义先验与预测性结构骨架，证明了对优化和混淆的"变换无关"鲁棒反编译是可行的。该工作确立了语义保真度（通过检索准确度衡量）相较于BLEU等浅层指标的优越性，为连接敌对二进制环境与成熟源码级静态分析工具链提供了可扩展基础。未来工作方向包括：函数间上下文与全局状态推理、自定义/专有混淆方案的数据库扩展，以及通过更严格的功能等价性验证方法。

title: CC4M: Code Clone Analysis and Visualization for Microservices
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. To appear in Proceedings of the 42nd IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME 2026), Tool Demonstration Track
summary: Microservice architecture supports software evolution by decomposing a system into small, loosely coupled services that can be deployed independently. Contrary to the expectation of high modularity, prior studies have reported that code clones exist across service boundaries, some of which are co-modified in the same version. Such clones may require changes to be propagated across service boundaries, thereby undermining service independence and increasing maintenance costs. However, existing tools do not support microservice-aware clone analysis. We present CC4M, a microservice-aware clone analysis and visualization tool. CC4M detects and enriches clone pairs with service-boundary, co-modification, file-category, and metric information. The enriched clones are visualized in an interactive scatter plot with explicit service boundaries, supporting metric-based filtering to prioritize clones with potentially higher maintenance impact. Using an open-source microservice application, we illustrate how CC4M helps identify the potential impact scope of code changes. A demo video and the tool are available at this https URL and this https URL , respectively.

AI.tldr: CC4M是一款面向微服务架构的代码克隆分析与可视化工具，通过整合微服务边界识别、共修改历史和文件类别信息，帮助开发者识别跨服务克隆及其维护影响。
AI.motivation: 现有克隆检测和可视化工具按文件系统或程序结构组织信息，缺乏对微服务边界的感知能力，无法区分服务内与服务间克隆对，也未整合历史修改耦合信息，难以识别影响可维护性的关键克隆。
AI.method: CC4M采用CLAIM从Docker Compose和Dockerfile中识别微服务边界，使用CCFinderSW检测Type-2克隆对，通过Git历史追踪共修改事件，并结合基于路径模式的文件分类（Test/Config/Data/Logic）。定义了服务跨度（service span）、共修改频率（co-modification frequency）和共修改片段比例（co-modification fragment ratio）等指标，通过统计视图、散点图（含服务边界标识）和指标视图三种可视化界面支持探索。
AI.result: 在7个开源微服务系统（含41服务、287,745行代码的Train Ticket等）上演示了三个使用场景：识别跨服务业务逻辑重复、发现数据实体不一致更新风险、评估重复性共修改带来的维护负担。结果显示该工具能有效定位跨服务克隆及其历史共修改模式。
AI.conclusion: CC4M填补了现有克隆分析工具在微服务边界感知方面的空白，但存在Type-2克隆检测范围有限、依赖Docker配置、受CLAIM识别准确率（82.0%）影响等局限。未来工作将集成MSCCD等支持Type-3克隆的检测器，并通过开发者实证研究评估工具实用性。

title: RESTCov: A Tool for Structural Coverage Analysis of REST APIs
summary: REST APIs are widely used in modern software systems, but developers and testers often lack visibility into which parts of an API specification are exercised by a test suite. Traditional coverage analysis usually relies on source-code instrumentation, which is impractical for REST APIs that are distributed, externally maintained, and hence accessible only through black-box execution. This paper presents RESTCov, a lightweight tool that computes structural REST API coverage from an OpenAPI specification and observed HTTP request/response logs, reporting coverage across paths, operations, parameters, media types, status codes, and status classes. RESTCov produces both machine-readable results and a human-readable HTML report, helping users inspect coverage gaps, diagnose specification-log mismatches, and evaluate REST API test suites without requiring access to the implementation. Screencast: this https URL Repository: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RESTCov工具，这是一个轻量级的REST API结构覆盖率分析工具。它通过OpenAPI规范和HTTP请求/响应日志进行黑盒覆盖率分析，无需源码插桩，覆盖路径、操作、参数、媒体类型、状态码及状态类等多个维度，并生成JSON和HTML两种格式报告。
AI.motivation: 传统代码级覆盖率分析需要源码插桩，但REST API通常是分布式的、由外部维护的黑盒系统，无法获取源码。开发者和测试人员缺乏对测试套件覆盖了API规范哪些部分的可见性，且难以发现规范与实际实现之间的漂移（specification-implementation drift）。
AI.method: RESTCov的工作流程：(1)解析OpenAPI规范，提取文档化的路径、操作、参数、响应码和媒体类型；(2)读取请求/响应日志对，重构观测到的HTTP流量；(3)将文档化路径模板编译为正则表达式（将路径参数替换为通配符），与请求路径进行匹配；(4)基于匹配的请求记录观测到的规范元素；(5)聚合成多维度覆盖率指标，输出JSON文件和HTML报告。匹配要求精确匹配（包括大小写、尾斜杠、编码），HTTP方法则大小写不敏感。未匹配的请求单独报告用于诊断规范-日志失配。
AI.result: 在Petstore API演示中：14个路径(100%)、20个操作(100%)、25个参数(100%)全部覆盖；但请求内容类型覆盖率为81.8%，响应内容类型86.8%，状态码仅38.9%，状态类65.2%。报告成功识别出双编码斜杠（%2F%2F）等客户端伪迹导致的未匹配请求。RESTCov已在5个生产API（含Google Drive和Spotify）的对比研究和工业环境中得到应用，对各类OpenAPI文档展现出良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RESTCov是一个实用的黑盒REST API覆盖率分析工具，支持多个结构维度，通过JSON和HTML两种输出格式帮助用户识别覆盖率缺口、诊断规范-日志失配、检测规范与实现漂移。其核心优势在于无需源码插桩，并统一汇总未匹配请求。局限性在于：演示仅用单一API、未验证行为正确性、当前仅支持请求/响应文本文件对（尚不支持HAR/JSONL）。

title: From Architecture to Binary: Ensuring Cross-Domain Consistency in Model-Based Airborne Software Development
comment: 10 Pages, Preprint for 45th AIAA DATC/IEEE Digital Avionics Systems Conference (DASC). Accepted for Publication
summary: This paper presents an airborne software development approach for manned and unmanned aerial vehicles aimed at reducing inconsistencies across system, model-based functional, and embedded software domains. In environments influenced by standards such as ARP-4754B and DO-178C, these inconsistencies typically stem from insufficient enforcement across domain boundaries rather than missing process definitions. Building on a previously proposed toolchain centered on a relational interface database, we identify recurring failure modes and propose a repository-centered implementation to address them, tailored to small, resource-constrained teams operating without heavyweight process overhead. Each domain is assigned a primary repository with cross-repository references and dedicated CI pipelines that generate, update, and validate the exchanged artifacts. Automated interface updates, differential change notifications, and consistency checks propagate changes with minimal manual effort and surface inconsistencies before the time-consuming code-generation and compilation steps. An initial implementation in an ongoing experimental project is described, with qualitative feedback from its early use.

AI.tldr: 本文针对航空嵌入式软件开发中系统、功能、嵌入式三个领域之间因缺乏跨领域一致性强制机制而导致的不一致问题，提出了一种以Git仓库为中心、结合CI流水线的轻量级解决方案。通过为每个领域分配主仓库并利用子模块引用与自动化校验，将不一致尽早暴露在耗时的代码生成与编译之前。
AI.motivation: 在遵循ARP-4754B与DO-178C标准的航空软件开发中，跨系统/功能/嵌入式领域的不一致并非源于流程定义缺失，而是缺乏跨领域边界持续强制执行的机制。这些不一致（如同名参数漂移、数据类型不一致、ICD XML与模型版本错位等）通常要到集成测试后期才被发现，导致20–60分钟的Simulink构建失败，造成高昂的返工成本。该工作面向小型、资源受限的团队，旨在以轻量级机制替代重量级流程门控。
AI.method:
1. **三领域仓库划分**：为系统域、功能域、嵌入式域分别设立主仓库（接口仓库、功能集成仓库、软件集成仓库），并以Git子模块实现跨仓库版本锚定。
2. **接口仓库（系统域）**：作为dBricks（单一事实源）到下游的唯一桥梁，包含三条分支（dBricks镜像/dev/master），通过结构化差异比较将变更分类为物理端口、函数、函数参数、数据类型、传输层五类，并向对应域发送定向邮件通知。
3. **功能集成仓库**：通过MATLAB例程执行"接口-模型一致性"与"数据字典一致性"校验，在合入前进行阻塞式代码生成，特性分支上则进行非阻塞的dry-run。
4. **软件集成仓库**：作为最终编译入口，执行五步流水线（工具版本兼容性→接口兼容性→函数源码生成→传输层代码生成→二进制编译），所有步骤在Docker容器化环境中严格阻塞执行，并在编译前检测跨仓库接口兼容性。
5. **支持性仓库**：将mrails、tlcodegen等工具及硬件支持作为子模块引用，以保证工具版本一致。
6. **单位/缩放规约**：规定所有函数参数使用SI单位，缩放与类型转换由自动生成的传输层代码完成。
AI.result: 在TUM飞行系统动力学研究所的有人轻型运动飞机项目中进行了初步实现：接口仓库已完整实现，功能集成与软件集成流水线的接口校验阶段也已落地。定性反馈显示，邮件通知机制显著减少了功能域手动识别接口变更的工作量；dBricks的ICD导出实现自动化后消除了系统域的反复延迟来源。但完整架构尚未投入生产，量化效率评估留待未来更广泛的部署。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明：将以Git仓库为中心的设计与CI流水线相结合，可在不引入重型流程门控的前提下为小型团队提供跨领域一致性保障，仓库从被动存储升级为强制执行领域交互的核心组件。差异化的变更通知、接口兼容性预检、容器化构建环境共同消除了多处历史失效模式。未来工作方向包括：功能集成仓库提交后自动触发完整集成流水线、跨仓库接口版本基线统一化、跨设备通信一致性校验、以及与架构模型的更深集成以消除手动转入dBricks的环节。

title: Adaptive Strategy Generation for Boundary Value Exploration Beyond Numeric Inputs
summary: Software behavior often changes abruptly at boundaries between input regions, and these transitions are known to be fault-prone. Boundary Value Exploration (BVE) automates boundary discovery by searching for pairs of similar inputs that nevertheless trigger different program behaviors. Existing automated BVE techniques rely on mutation operators hand-engineered for each input type, or even for each function under test, which has confined their use to numeric inputs. We present ABEX, an agentic LLM-based framework that replaces operator engineering with adaptive strategy generation: specialized LLM agents propose, select, and execute boundary-exploration strategies, guided by execution feedback and a quality-diversity (QD) archive. Because strategies are expressed in natural language, they can encode both type-level and function-specific knowledge, and effective strategies can even be stored and reused. We evaluate ABEX in a black-box setting on 20 functions with numeric, string, array, and mixed inputs. On numeric functions, ABEX outperforms a state-of-the-art QD method on 10 of 11 functions, with average QD-scores 11.7x higher. On non-numeric functions, addressed here for the first time in automated black-box BVE, ABEX discovers domain-aligned boundary behaviors for all subjects. Mutation testing shows the discovered boundaries are fault-revealing: with equally sized test suites, ABEX reaches an average mutation score of 86.2% versus 61.9% for the QD baseline, and kills nine times as many hard-to-detect stubborn mutants. An ablation study identifies adaptive strategy generation as the primary driver of these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ABEX框架，利用智能体LLM自适应生成边界值探索策略，通过质量-多样性（QD）归档和执行反馈指导，替代手工设计的变异算子，首次将黑盒BVE扩展至字符串、数组和混合类型输入。在20个测试对象上，数值输入QD-score平均提升11.7倍，变异测试中杀死顽固变异体数量约为基线的9倍。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化边界值探索（BVE）方法依赖手工设计的变异算子，且需针对每种输入类型甚至每个被测函数定制，导致其应用局限于数值输入。而现实软件多涉及字符串、数组等结构化输入，其边界行为依赖于领域特定语法和函数语义，手工算子难以扩展。
AI.method: ABEX采用三层智能体架构：(1) 战略层Coordinator基于停滞信号和策略成功率统计，决定重复、选择或请求新策略；(2) 战术层Ideator和Strategy Generator，前者评估候选方向与现有策略池的功能新颖性和预期收益，后者将idea扩展为可执行自然语言策略；(3) 操作层Explorer依据策略调用LLM生成N=10个输入对，按MAP-Elites规则更新归档。策略以自然语言表达，可编码类型级和函数级知识，涵盖生成/变异两种模式与通用/上下文感知两种类型，归档使用SETBVE的四维行为描述符。
AI.result: 在11个数值FUT上，ABEX在10个上QD-score最高，平均18.7，约为单提示LLM基线的2.8倍、SETBVE的11.7倍。在10个非数值FUT（字符串、数组、混合）上首次实现黑盒自动BVE，全部发现领域对齐的边界行为。等测试规模下，ABEX平均变异得分86.2% vs SETBVE 61.9%，杀死顽固变异体数量约为基线9倍。消融实验表明自适应策略生成是关键驱动力（QD-score提升6.8倍）。三种LLM（GPT-5.1/mini、Gemma-4、Qwen-3.5）均能有效工作。
AI.conclusion: ABEX证明基于LLM的自适应策略生成可作为通用机制替代手工算子工程，将BVE从数值域扩展到异构输入类型。生成策略扩展覆盖广度，变异策略提升边界质量，两者协同是关键。未来工作包括改进行为描述符、引入动态停止智能体、以及评估策略库跨FUT的可重用性。

title: Where Does Balance Break? Boundary Discovery for Game Balance Testing under a Finite Simulation Budget
summary: Software testing often relies on assumptions such as reproducible executions and stable correctness criteria. However, many modern software systems exhibit non-deterministic executions and large behavior spaces, making exhaustive exploration impractical and single-run judgments unreliable. These characteristics make it difficult to identify where acceptable behavior ends and problematic behavior begins. Competitive multiplayer games represent a challenging instance of such systems, where balance must be maintained so that no single strategy dominates. Even small parameter changes can trigger abrupt balance disruption, yet detecting such failures requires repeated simulations under non-deterministic outcomes and high-dimensional parameter spaces. In this paper, we formulate game balance regression testing as a boundary-discovery problem under a finite simulation budget. The objective is to efficiently identify inputs near the boundary that separates balanced and unbalanced regions. To address this problem, we propose BBExplorer, which combines multi-directional candidate generation, budget-aware two-stage screening, and adaptive step-size shrinkage for boundary refinement. Experimental results on two games with different levels of complexity show that the approach is strong in low-dimensional settings and remains effective in higher-dimensional ones. It also exhibits stable boundary behavior across unseen random seeds and threshold settings. These results indicate that BBExplorer is effective for practical balance regression testing and, more broadly, for boundary-oriented testing in non-deterministic, budget-constrained systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将游戏平衡回归测试建模为有限仿真预算下的边界发现问题，提出BBExplorer方法，通过多方向候选生成、预算感知两阶段筛选和自适应步长收缩三个组件，在两个游戏（Turnbased和Generals）上验证了其在低维和高维设置中均能有效定位平衡边界，且对随机种子和阈值变化具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 竞争性多人游戏的平衡测试面临行为空间大、执行非确定性、参数维度高的挑战，使得全面探索不可行且单次运行判断不可靠。开发者需要了解平衡破坏开始的位置——即平衡与不平衡区域之间的边界——而非单一最优配置。现有的基于优化的方法只能给出单点推荐，无法刻画安全区域的范围和形状边界信息对补丁回归测试和CI护栏至关重要，但在非确定性评估和有限仿真预算下识别边界极为困难。
AI.method: 方法核心包含：(1) 问题形式化——将游戏平衡回归测试定义为边界发现问题，给定有限预算B和起点集X₀，目标是生成尽可能多的满足|f̂ₚ(P⁽ⁱ⁾|P̄)−b|≤ε的边界邻近测试输入；(2) BBExplorer算法——结合三个组件：多方向候选生成（每个轴的正负方向生成至多2d个候选）、预算感知两阶段筛选（Stage A用Nₛcr次仿真做粗筛选取top-k，Stage B用N_full次仿真做精确评估选择下一个搜索中心）、自适应步长收缩（Δ_{t+1}=γΔₜ，γ∈(0,1)实现从粗探索到细定位的过渡）。
AI.result: 实验在两个游戏上进行对比：低维Turnbased（2D/3D）和高维Generals（3D/4D/5D），对比Random和Fixed-Delta两个基线。Turnbased 3D中BBExplorer发现率R=1.000（Random仅0.067，p<0.0001，Â₁₂=0.967）。Generals 5D中BBExplorer保持R=0.500，而Fixed-Delta仅0.067、Random仅0.017。种子移位分析显示均差+0.014±0.027，最差退化仅−0.026。阈值移位分析显示在b∈{0.40,0.50,0.60}下平均R=0.533。所有额外实验总耗时约2.7小时。结论：BBExplorer在低维表现强劲且在高维保持优势，对种子和阈值变化鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 本文将平衡回归测试形式化为有限仿真预算下的边界发现问题，提出BBExplorer方法，通过多方向候选生成、两阶段筛选和步长收缩三个组件，有效定位平衡边界。实验证明结构化搜索结合自适应细化在非确定性条件下对边界定位有效。未来工作包括扩展搜索策略和在更复杂参数空间及实际游戏设置中评估该方法。

title: Sustainability of Open-Source Machine Learning Robustness Assessment Tools: A Repository Mining Study
summary: Robustness evaluation is essential for deploying machine-learning (ML) systems in real-world settings, where models may face adversarial perturbations, distribution shifts, and other operational stressors. Many open-source tools, including Adversarial Robustness Toolbox, Foolbox, and Robustness Gym, support robustness testing and evaluation. However, little is known about how these tools are maintained, publicly engaged with, and sustained over time, even though practitioners may rely on them to select evaluation dependencies, reproduce robustness assessments, and provide evidence for AI assurance. We present an empirical study of the open-source robustness tooling ecosystem. Starting from a curated seed set derived from prior work, we systematically searched GitHub and identified 28 robustness-tool repositories. We analyzed repository artifacts to characterize observable community engagement, maintenance activity, and project longevity using established software-engineering metrics. Our results show that engagement and maintenance are unevenly distributed, with sustained activity concentrated in a small subset of repositories. At the data collection date of January 21, 2026, five repositories were classified as active, 22 as inactive, and one as archived. These findings highlight the need to treat robustness tools as evolving software systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对GitHub上28个开源机器学习鲁棒性评估工具的仓库挖掘研究，分析了其社区参与度、维护活跃度和项目寿命，发现维护活动高度集中于少数工具，绝大多数工具已处于不活跃或归档状态。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型的鲁棒性评估在部署中至关重要，但现有研究多关注鲁棒性的定义与算法层面，鲜有研究将这些评估工具视为需要持续维护的"软件系统"来考察其可持续性。开源鲁棒性工具的可信度不仅取决于其实现的攻击/防御方法，还取决于它们是否随ML框架与对抗技术演进而持续更新。研究者旨在填补这一空白，为AI保障（AIBOM）及工具选型提供实证依据。
AI.method: 采用观察性仓库挖掘方法。首先基于已有比较分析确定11个种子工具集，再通过43个关键词在GitHub上进行系统检索补充，经过去重与人工筛选最终得到28个工具。统一数据采集日期为2026年1月21日，提取提交、贡献者、issue、PR、星标、watcher、fork等仓库级指标。使用Kaplan-Meier生存分析评估项目寿命，通过双侧Mann-Whitney U检验对比活跃与不活跃仓库的12项维护特征，并辅以9个关键词匹配分析维护相关issue与PR的主题。
AI.result: 研究识别出28个2016-2025年发布的开源ML鲁棒性工具，以学术来源（78.6%）和Python实现为主，主要聚焦深度学习模型（46.4%）和逃避攻击（89.1%）。在数据采集日，仅5个（17.9%）仓库活跃，22个（78.6%）不活跃，1个（3.6%）归档。社区参与度（星标、watcher、fork、PR）高度集中在ART、CleverHans、Foolbox、TextAttack、AdvBox、PromptBench等少数工具。Mann-Whitney U检验显示活跃与不活跃仓库在12项维护特征中的9项存在差异（p≤0.05），经Holm校正后仍有6项显著。关键词分析显示维护工作主要涉及API变更、变更日志、重构、弃用与向后兼容。Kaplan-Meier分析估计180日不活跃的中位时间为40.63个月（约3.39年），一年后保持活跃的概率为92.44%，五年后降至30.42%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了开源ML鲁棒性工具生态中维护活动高度集中的现象，表明历史可见性与项目年龄不能单独用于推断持续维护状态。研究建议将鲁棒性工具视为随时间演进的软件依赖进行管理，在AI保障文档（如AIBOM）中记录工具版本、仓库标识、维护状态、观测日期、支持的框架版本和依赖环境等信息。未来研究应在更大规模工具生态上复现该研究，并通过分析下游依赖与维护者访谈进一步衡量实际采用情况与维护动态。

title: Recovering Software Architecture Intent from Historical Work Items using Generative AI: A Mixed-Methods Industry Case Study
summary: Software architecture is often only partially captured in code, while much of the design intent lives in evolving project artifacts. In agile projects, work items, user stories, and related tracking documents preserve valuable traces of that intent, but they rarely support direct architectural analysis. This work investigates the recovery of C4 architecture diagrams from historical agile work items using an LLM-based pipeline. The semi-automatic five-step workflow employs a prompt chain, bidirectional traceability, and Chain-of-Thought reasoning to transform unstructured Azure DevOps work items into visual artifacts. Evaluated on two industry projects, we use a mixed-methods design combining qualitative expert interviews with a quantitative stability analysis. Practitioners perceive the generated architectural baselines as accurate and highly useful for system comprehension. Strictly bound by their input data, the artifacts mirror the documented intent, thereby surfacing discrepancies and architectural drift when compared to the implemented reality. Quantitatively, the workflow exhibits high stability for architectural entities but lower stability for their relationships, with relative variance compounding across generation steps. The proposed workflow demonstrates the practical viability of LLM-assisted architectural recovery based on development process artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对传统代码级软件架构恢复（SAR）无法捕获设计意图、易受架构侵蚀干扰的问题，提出了一条基于大语言模型（LLM）的五步半自动流水线，将历史 Azure DevOps 工作项（如 Epics、Features、User Stories）转换为 C4 模型中的系统上下文图（Level 1）与容器图（Level 2）。研究通过与一家欧洲技术咨询公司合作的混合方法案例研究，结合定性专家访谈与定量结构稳定性分析，验证了该流水线在工业环境下的实用性与局限性。
AI.motivation: 软件架构常因需求变更和人员流动而发生架构侵蚀（Architectural Erosion），实现层面的代码逐渐偏离原始设计意图。传统 SAR 方法直接从源代码重构架构边界，但实证研究表明其准确率低、且捕获的是被侵蚀的实现而非逻辑设计。同时，企业虽有将 AI 用于架构任务的意愿，但实践中受 LLM 非确定性制约难以落地。因此，本文旨在探索一种绕过代码噪声、直接从敏捷工作项中提取"已记录意图"（as-planned intent）的可行路径。
AI.method: 1. 五步流水线：(1) 通过 Azure DevOps REST API 提取 Epics/Features/User Stories/Tasks；(2) 预处理为结构化 Markdown；(3) LLM 1 生成 C4 Level 1 系统上下文 JSON（采用 CoT、One-shot、负向约束、JSON Schema 与 linked_work_items 双向溯源）；(4) LLM 2 在 Level 1 基础上生成 C4 Level 2 容器图 JSON（强制 ID 一致性）；(5) Pydantic 校验后转换为 PlantUML 渲染。模型：Azure OpenAI GPT-5.1，temperature=0.01，固定 seed=42。2. 混合方法评估：定性部分对三位资深实践者进行半结构化访谈并做主题综合；定量部分对两个工业项目（Project A 89 项，Project B 193 项）各独立运行 n=10 次，以节点数与边数的最小值、最大值、均值、中位数、众数、标准差与变异系数衡量结构稳定性。
AI.result: 定性结果形成四个统一主题：(T1) 输出被认为准确但严格受限于输入数据，能暴露已记录意图与实现之间的偏离（包括未执行意图与未记录实现）；(T2) 将基线创建从小时级缩短至分钟级，但外部/客户场景需人工校验；(T3) 认知摩擦源自 PlantUML 渲染而非 LLM 语义；(T4) 可作为持续文档化、设计里程碑起点与架构审计工具。定量结果：节点生成稳定性高（多数 CV<16%，SD<1.0），边生成稳定性显著较低（CV 高达 33%–38.3%），且变率沿 Context→Container 两阶段呈链式累积；边分布呈右偏，均值受高值迭代上拉。
AI.conclusion: LLM 辅助的架构恢复在工业场景下具备实际可行性，但受严格信任边界约束：流水线仅作为"内部工程基线"使用，外部应用必须经人工策展。其核心价值不在于输出理想架构，而在于作为"意图之镜"，使 as-planned 与 as-built 之间的架构漂移可视化，从而缓解历史设计知识流失。然而，节点稳定但边不稳定的结构特征，以及序列提示中的误差传播，提示未来需借助 RAG、多智能体自校正与标准化评估框架进一步提升可靠性与可扩展性。

title: A System-of-Systems Case Study for the Verification of Composed Digital Twins
summary: Current approaches to engineering dependable Digital Twins (DTs) of Cyber-Physical Systems lack practical guidance on how qualities such as relevance, verifiability, substitutability and fidelity may be formalised and verified. This need is amplified in Systems-of-Systems (SoS), where reliance is placed on the composition of DTs. The goal of this study is to identify foundational challenges that a framework for DT validation and verification should address in an SoS setting, and to investigate the formalisation of individual DT artefacts as a step towards compositional reasoning. We present a case study based on a DT-enabled greenhouse SoS modelled in VDM-RT (Vienna Development Method, Real-Time), including executable formal models, a property-based account of DT qualities, and an analysis of the obstacles arising when attempting to compose these artefacts at the SoS level. We consider how DT qualities may be operationalised as sets of verifiable properties. Formal modelling and analysis techniques and tools supporting their verification are identified. The study reveals how interpretations of DT qualities must adapt to different architectural roles and how local quality guarantees form assumptions for compositional reasoning. Full formalisation and verification of SoS composition is identified as future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将数字孪生（DT）质量属性形式化为一组可验证属性的方法，并以温室系统-of-systems（SoS）为案例进行研究。使用VDM-RT建立可执行的形式化模型，分析了在SoS层面组合DT时所面临的验证挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前数字孪生的可靠性验证缺乏将质量属性（如相关性、可验证性、可替代性和保真度）形式化并验证的实用指导。在系统之系统（SoS）中，DT的组合使问题更加复杂，因为单个DT的故障可能传播到依赖它的其他DT。现有框架多为描述性的，无法处理SoS组合下的验证义务变化。
AI.method: 采用VDM-RT（维也纳开发方法-实时）建立温室SoS的形式化模型，包括Pot模型、决策服务模型（DSM）和环境数字影子（EDS）。将四个核心质量属性（相关性、可验证性、可替代性、保真度）操作化为结构化的可验证属性集合，每条属性配备形式化表达和证据类型。通过VDM-RT的不变量、操作合约和证明义务生成进行形式化验证，并导出为FMI 2.0兼容的FMU以支持协同仿真。
AI.result: 研究揭示了三个关键发现：(1) DT质量的解释必须根据架构角色进行调整——可替代性在Pot模型中表现为行为一致性，在DSM中表现为决策影响保持，在EDS中则不适用；(2) VDM-RT形式化构造可导出为FMU同时保留验证证据，桥接了形式验证与工业协同仿真；(3) 组合验证面临保真度误差放大、相关性范围转移、可替代性演变为关系兼容性三大挑战。56个证明义务中约一半因FMI端口的运行时值而无法检查。
AI.conclusion: 本文为个体DT制品的严格质量验证奠定了基础，是迈向SoS环境中组合验证的一步。未来工作方向包括SoS层面的完整形式化、证明自动化工具支持以及智能制造、能源系统等领域的额外案例研究，以验证质量实例化模式的可推广性。

title: Rethinking Vulnerability Remediation as a Capacity Allocation Problem
summary: As AI accelerates vulnerability discovery, remediation throughput may become a greater constraint than prioritisation accuracy. This study evaluates vulnerability remediation as a flow-control problem using Apache Jira, Mozilla Bugzilla, Red Hat security errata, five public Jira organisations, and an npm dependency graph. Apache resolution times are strongly heavy-tailed, while 94-100% of arrivals in the primary issue trackers enter queues estimated to be at or above capacity. Queue-context models provide only moderate predictive discrimination and are largely matched by simple project-level baselines. Severity-to-speed discrimination varies substantially across systems. Flow-control analyses show larger operational effects: transitions from overloaded to draining queues are associated with shorter resolution times, severity-first sequencing reduces critical-item delay at fixed capacity, and capacity reservation can reduce prolonged critical-item delays. Owner-level analyses further show that available capacity is useful only when it is located where demand occurs or can be transferred through relevant expertise connections. These findings support treating vulnerability remediation as a flow-control and capacity-allocation problem rather than solely a ranking problem.

AI.tldr: 本文将漏洞修复重新定位为流量控制与容量分配问题，结合 Apache Jira、Mozilla、Red Hat、五个公共 Jira 组织及 npm 依赖图等公开数据，通过排队诊断、预测基线、治理梯度比较、所有者受限容量模型与依赖图结构分析，表明漏洞修复性能更多受队列状态、可用容量、所有权约束与专业技能连通性制约，而非排序精度本身。
AI.motivation: AI 加速漏洞发现使修复吞吐量可能成为比优先级排序更关键的瓶颈；现有研究多将漏洞管理视为优先级排序问题（CVSS/EPSS/BOD 26-04），而忽视了修复方是否拥有足够容量、专业技能与执行能力。本文旨在检验"修复延迟主要源自流量与容量约束而非排序精度"这一假设。
AI.method: 采用多层级混合方法：(1) 队列层——基于 Apache Jira（2000 issues）、Mozilla Bugzilla（2000）、Red Hat CVE（163）和 npm 依赖图（1021 包）进行 Hill 估计、Little 定律一致性检验、ρ 估计；(2) 预测层——评估优先级/AUC、队列上下文模型、Split Conformal 与 CQR 预测区间，使用 Winkler 分数；(3) 治理比较——跨 Apache/Mozilla/Red Hat 的严重度-速度 AUC 梯度；(4) 流量控制干预——历史 supercritical→draining 转换的 DiD、固定容量的排序重放（Counterfactual Replay）、Pollaczek–Khinchine + Cobham 框架的 Fast-Track 容量预留 M/G/1 模型；(5) 所有者层——跨 5 个 Jira 组织（Apache、Red Hat Jira、MariaDB、Qt、MongoDB）的专家资格借用网络，分析可行性提升；(6) 依赖图——npm 漏洞同配性与时序分析。
AI.result: Apache 解决时间强重尾（Hill α=2.24，均值/中位数=10.7×）；94–100% 的新工单进入 ρ≥1 队列；Little 定律相关性 r=0.73–0.83；死 WIP 因子≈1.8×。优先级预测 AUC 仅 0.505，队列上下文模型 AUC 0.66–0.69（与项目基线相当）；Conformal 覆盖率达 92.2%但区间过宽（最大 5223 天），Winkler 分数下非保形基线更优。严重度-速度 AUC 从 Apache 0.505、Mozilla 0.643 升至 Red Hat 0.785。Apache MESOS/FALCON 两次 draining 转换使解决时间减少 90–116 天；固定容量下严重度优先排序使关键项延迟降低 227（Apache）/59（Mozilla）天；25.4% 容量预留使 Apache 关键项平均驻留时间从 265 天降至 137.5 天。跨组织分析揭示四种容量移动机制：Siloed（Apache、Red Hat Jira）、Connected with slack（Qt，借用提升 85.3 pts）、Already provisioned（MongoDB）、Connected but saturated（MariaDB）。npm 漏洞同配性 +0.083（p=0.011），60% 时序为先基后依赖（p=0.019）。
AI.conclusion: 漏洞修复性能更多受队列状态、容量分配、所有权边界与专业技能连通性制约，而非仅依赖更精细的排序或预测模型。即使是优秀的风险评分（EPSS AUC=0.838）也只能决定处理顺序，无法解决总吞吐量不足或专业技能不可达问题。研究建议将修复视为流量控制问题：WIP 限额、容量预留、跨所有者路由应与排序信号共同设计；预测区间宽度需与覆盖率联合报告以反映真实可用性；并应进一步研究 Whittle 索引策略、动态分配、依赖感知修复模型与受控现场实验。

title: A Deeper Analysis of Block-Sparse Featurizers
summary: The recently introduced block-sparse featurizer (BSF; Fel et al., 2026) is similar to a sparse autoencoder (SAE), but its atomic unit is a small subspace (a block of directions) rather than a single direction. It is designed for features that live on low-dimensional manifolds, which are especially frequent in vision. This work studies the BSF's strengths and weaknesses, finding how it still somewhat suffers from classic SAE failure modes, like feature splitting and composition. We propose several architectural changes to the BSF, including a Tournament Top-K selection rule that significantly reduces feature splitting, and we also extend the block paradigm to the crosscoder.

AI.tldr: 本文对Block-Sparse Featurizer (BSF) 进行了深入分析，提出 Tournament Top-K 选择规则显著减少特征分裂现象，并将块范式扩展到 crosscoder 中。
AI.motivation: 经典的稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 基于线性表示假设，将特征视为激活空间中的单个方向。然而，许多特征实际上存在于低维流形上（如圆、螺旋等），导致 SAE 需要用大量方向去"拼接"（tiling）这些弯曲流形，产生特征分裂和组合等失效模式。BSF 的原子单元是子空间（块）而非单一方向，理论上更适合流形特征，但其在实际中的强弱尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1. 构建 "Manifold Zoo" 合成数据集（128个特征，64个线段+64个曲线流形，嵌入128维空间），用于受控实验；2. 对比 BSF 与参数匹配的 SAE（含事后流形恢复方法）；3. 进行10种子的稳定性测试；4. 扫描超参数（块数 G、稀疏度 k）分析分裂成因；5. 提出 Tournament Top-K：按块范数降序排列，通过几何重叠阈值（0.1 开启对决，0.5 永久胜出）让共享特征的块竞争；6. 提出混合维度块设计；7. 将块范式扩展到 crosscoder，结合 Dedicated Feature Columns (DFC) 解决合并问题；8. 在 DINOv3 和 CLIP 上做真实模型实验。
AI.result: 1. 在独立和相关性数据集上，BSF 均显著优于 SAE（平均 R² 0.77 vs 0.36），且不受概念共现干扰；2. BSF 在不同种子间大体稳定，但部分特征仍会分裂为接近正交的2个块；3. 超参数扫描未能消除分裂，Aux-K 和 k-annealing 也无显著帮助；4. Tournament Top-K 在最难的相关性数据集上将良好恢复的流形比例从 0.77 提升到 0.90；5. 混合维度块设计失败，特征在训练早期就锁定到错误尺寸的块；6. 在 DINO/CLIP 上的 BSF 实验显示大多数特征被多个块分裂；7. Block-DFC crosscoder 在合成数据上合并问题大幅减少；在真实模型上能恢复 82% 的 DINO BSF 块和 53% 的 CLIP BSF 块，EV 健康（0.71/0.66）。
AI.conclusion: BSF 在流形特征捕获上兑现了核心承诺，但仍无法完全摆脱 SAE 的经典病态——特征会分裂成块对（呈近正交补关系）。Tournament Top-K 利用分裂的几何结构显著缓解了此问题。混合块维度设计因早期锁定问题而失败。将块范式扩展到 crosscoder 时出现合并问题，可通过 DFC 部分解决。总体而言，BSF 是朝"面向数据生成过程的特征器"迈出的有希望的一步，但仍需进一步研究以彻底解决块分裂问题。

title: When Muon Meets Task Interference: A Spectral Perspective on Continual Learning and Model Merging
summary: Continual learning (CL) and model merging (MM) both aim to obtain a single model that performs well across multiple tasks, challenged respectively by catastrophic forgetting and weight-disentanglement error. In the literature, these difficulties are merely treated separately and mitigated through a variety of solutions, while the geometry induced by the base optimizer is treated as an implementation detail. In this work, we show that the two difficulties are in fact two instances of the same phenomenon: a parameter update useful for one task shifts the model's outputs on another. We formalize this shared phenomenon as \textit{task interference} and reduce it to a common layer-wise Frobenius inner product $\langle \Delta W_\ell, J_\ell(x)\rangle_F$. This quantity, in turn, is utilized to expose the role of the optimizer. We theoretically derive an upper bound that isolates the spectral norm $\|\Delta W_\ell\|_2$ as an optimizer-controllable factor of task interference, and a per-mode analysis shows that this bound tracks the dominant part of the empirical interference. Specifically, we then identify the recent Muon optimizer as a mechanism that regulates this factor by construction. Our work reveals that its elegant control on spectral norm tightens the interference bound for both CL and MM, positioning Muon as a principled optimizer-centric approach complementary to existing solutions. Our theoretcal analysis is well validated by experimental results. Replacing the AdamW optimizer with Muon improves accuracy by up to +5.02 points on the eight-task model-merging benchmark across three CLIP backbones. For continual learning, Muon also delivers uniformly positive gains across ten class-incremental protocols, three task-incremental protocols, and the 11-task MTIL benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示持续学习（CL）中的灾难性遗忘和模型合并（MM）中的权重解耦错误本质上都是任务干扰（task interference）的两种实例，并证明Muon优化器通过谱范数控制天然缓解两者。
AI.motivation: 现有CL和MM研究将灾难性遗忘和权重解耦错误分开处理，而基础优化器所诱导的几何性质通常被视为实现细节而被忽视。本文旨在探索优化器本身对两种范式困难的影响，并寻找一个原理化的、以优化器为中心的方法。
AI.method: 1) 在NTK线性化假设下，将CL和MM的输出漂移统一为层间Frobenius内积 ⟨ΔW_ℓ, J_ℓ(x)⟩_F；2) 推导出谱范数上界 ‖ΔW_ℓ‖_2 · ‖J_ℓ(x)‖_*（Theorem 1），将谱范数识别为优化器可控因子；3) 通过模态分析（Remark 1）证明该界有效追踪经验干扰的主导部分；4) 引用Theorem 2证明Muon是谱范数最速下降的闭式解，因此天然通过构造控制该因子。
AI.result: 实验在两个范式上验证理论分析：(1) 模型合并：在八个任务基准上，将AdamW替换为Muon，在CLIP ViT-B/32、ViT-B/16和ViT-L/14上分别获得+5.02、+3.42、+3.82绝对精度提升，权重解耦区域扩大，相对干扰降低；(2) 持续学习：在10个类增量、3个任务增量协议和11任务MTIL基准上，Muon带来一致正向增益。Muon将更新稳定秩提高约10-11倍，从而降低谱范数。
AI.conclusion: 本文将灾难性遗忘和权重解耦错误统一为同一个任务干扰问题，并通过严格的谱范数界表明Muon优化器通过其正交化机制天然控制干扰界，为CL和MM提供了一种原理化且与现有机制互补的、以优化器为中心的方法。未来工作将把干扰界推广到NTK之外，并在更大规模模型和更长任务序列上验证。

title: Dandelion: A Spherical Flower for Neural Simulation of Planetary Dynamics
summary: Many dynamical processes unfold on the sphere but the default scientific machine learning architectures are Euclidean. Applying these architectures on a regular lat-lon grid causes problems: Cartesian convolutions become distorted at high latitude; 2D FFTs in Fourier neural operators incorrectly assume double periodicity; Cartesian positional encodings in ViTs distort spherical geodesic distances. Recent work moves towards natively spherical primitives, including spherical convolutions (e.g., DeepSphere or DISCO), Spherical Fourier Neural Operators (SFNOs), and geodesic attention. Here we propose Dandelion, a spherical version of Flower, a warp-based neural PDE solver. Layers of Dandelion predict a tangent-plane displacement and transport features along great circles. We obtain a U-Net-like structure by implementing hierarchical pooling entirely in the spherical-harmonic domain. There are thus no convolutions: spatial mixing is achieved only through spherical coordinate changes, or warps. To compare Dandelion with existing spherical architectures, we release an evolving benchmark suite of challenging, natively-spherical PDE datasets including a modified Galewsky jet, anomalous chained turbulence, Cahn-Hilliard decomposition, spherical Riemann shocks, Held-Suarez dry atmospheric transport and global ocean dynamics. This new benchmark fills the gap in existing spherical datasets which are either too small and stylized, or much too large (ERA5) for model iteration. Dandelion is best or second-best on every dataset, and the gap to non-warp baselines widens with resolution: at $256\times 512$, Dandelion and Flower2D occupy the top two slots in both single-step prediction and rollout.

AI.tldr: 蒲公英（Dandelion）是一种原生球面神经PDE求解器，将Flower架构的warp操作从像素空间重定位到切平面并通过球谐变换实现分层池化，在新发布的六类球面PDE基准上全面优于FNO、SFNO及局部Transformer等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有科学机器学习架构多为欧氏设计，直接套用到经纬网格会导致卷积畸变、傅里叶变换错误假设双周期以及位置编码扭曲球面测地距等问题；同时缺乏适中规模的球面PDE基准来支持架构迭代。
AI.method: 将Flower的多头warp模块重写为切平面位移预测，利用Rodrigues公式沿大圆传输特征；U-Net池化完全在球谐域通过低通截断实现，剔除所有卷积式空间混合，仅保留1×1逐点映射。
AI.result: 在七个球面数据集上单步预测6/7最佳、20步自回归5/7最佳；相对Flower2D在rollout误差上削减1.5×–4.5×；计算开销远低于局部Transformer（128×256时为LS²的约15倍加速）。
AI.conclusion: 原生球面warp是替代卷积与谱全局混合的有效路径，配合新发布的适中规模基准可加速球面神经PDE求解器的研发。

title: More Data Cannot Break a Symmetry: Identifiability by Design
summary: Unsupervised representational alignment recovers a stimulus-by-stimulus correspondence from geometry alone, but the automorphism group of the stimulus geometry bounds what any such alignment can identify, before data exist. The obvious diagnostic for this degeneracy, the cheapest non-identity relabelling, ranks two published designs in the wrong order, because dense sampling creates near-duplicates whose transposition is nearly free.
